jobs.description:
At Sword, we’re building AI to heal billions and unlock humanity’s full potential. In doing so, we’re pioneering AI Care, a fundamentally new approach to healthcare built for medical reasoning, safety, and real-time treatment, not generic technology applied after the fact. As both a clinical-centric frontier AI lab and an applied AI platform, Sword is reimagining how care is delivered at scale, removing traditional barriers like appointments, waiting rooms, and stigma so more people can access the care they need—and ultimately get back to lives lived in full.

Since 2020, Sword has expanded across physical therapy, women’s health, cardiometabolic, and mental health, and is now moving beyond the session to a fully AI-native, 24/7 care program that brings physical activity, therapeutic exercise, psychotherapy, nutrition, and behavior change into one connected experience. More than 700,000 members across three continents have completed over 10 million AI sessions, helping 1,000+ enterprise clients avoid more than $1 billion in unnecessary healthcare costs. Backed by 42 clinical studies, 44+ patents, and more than $500 million raised from leading investors including Khosla Ventures, General Catalyst, and Founders Fund, Sword is defining a new standard for healthcare.

AI Proficiency at Sword

AI fluency is a core expectation at Sword. Every candidate is assessed against our three-level framework — be ready to share real examples of how AI is already part of how you work.

  • Explorer (Level 1) — Uses AI daily to boost personal productivity

  • Builder (Level 2) — Creates workflows and tools that elevate the whole team

  • Integrator (Level 3) — Embeds AI into products and processes at scale

Every hire must demonstrate at least Level 1. The expected level will vary depending on the seniority of the role.

Role

Sword Health is looking for a Marketing Manager to join our marketing team and lead the creation of the marketing materials that speak directly to our members. You will own how Sword shows up in front of members across our products and a wide mix of acquisition channels, including email, direct mail, toolkits, landing pages, and paid media. This role sits at the center of a cross-functional group of designers, clinicians, copywriters, and marketing operations partners, and is responsible for turning a deep understanding of member needs into content that drives engagement and enrollment. We are looking for a creative, data-driven, and member-centric marketer who can manage multiple channels at once, move quickly, and keep improving results over time.

What you’ll be doing

  • Lead the end-to-end creation of marketing materials for Sword Health members across our products and channels, including email, direct mailers, toolkits, paid media, and more
  • Translate member insights, needs, and motivations into clear, compelling messaging and creative concepts tailored to each product and population
  • Partner closely with design, clinical, copywriting, customer success, and marketing operations teams to brief, develop, review, and launch materials on time and to Sword’s quality and compliance standards
  • Own the planning and execution of campaigns and assets across channels, ensuring a consistent, best-in-class member experience
  • Analyze the main performance metrics of each channel (e.g., open and click rates, enrollment conversion, CPA, and engagement) and turn the findings into clear recommendations
  • Design and run tests (messaging, creative, audiences, formats) and apply the learnings to continuously improve performance
  • Work with clinical partners to make sure content is accurate, empathetic, and aligned with Sword’s clinical approach
  • Work with marketing operations on audience segmentation, targeting, and campaign deployment
  • Report on campaign and channel performance to internal stakeholders, and surface learnings that can scale across products and channels
  • Stay close to the member voice by using feedback, research, and data to shape future content and strategy

What you need to have

  • 3–5 years of experience in a marketing role, ideally in B2C, lifecycle, or growth marketing; digital health or B2B2C experience is a plus (but not required)
  • Experience creating and managing marketing materials across multiple channels (e.g., email, direct mail, paid media, and/or toolkits)
  • Ability to understand member needs and translate them into effective messaging and creative
  • Strong project management skills, with the ability to plan, prioritize, and execute multiple initiatives at once
  • Strong analytical skills, with a proven ability to read channel performance metrics, draw insights, and act on them
  • Experience working cross-functionally with design, copy, clinical, and/or operations teams to deliver projects on tight timelines
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • A member-centric and growth mindset, with the ability to empathize with our patients and their challenges
  • Creative and strategic thinking, with a willingness to test new ideas and push boundaries
  • Collaborative with team members within and across US and international locations
  • Experience and desire to work in a fast-moving, high-growth environment

What we would love to see (Optional)

  • Experience in healthcare, digital health, or other regulated industries (e.g., familiarity with HIPAA and compliant member communications)
  • Hands-on experience with marketing automation or CRM platforms and with paid media platforms
  • Experience with A/B and multivariate testing and a data-driven approach to optimization
  • Experience working with B2B2C models, where you market to end users on behalf of client organizations

*The range below reflects base, variable, and equity for this role.

This is a starting point, not a ceiling — once someone joins and proves they're outlier talent, we adjust quickly to make sure their compensation matches their impact.

Job titles may span more than one career level, so actual pay depends on skills, qualifications, experience, location, and market demand, among other factors. The range reflects base salary plus any variable, bonus, or sales incentives, and our estimate of the value of private company stock options where applicable. It's subject to change, and future stock value isn't guaranteed. Sword also offers additional benefits beyond total compensation.

The Director of Applied AI Engineering will build and lead North's Applied AI team: a hands-on group that takes AI capabilities from prototype to production inside real business workflows. This is a delivery role, not a research role, measured by systems that are live, adopted, and safe to run in a regulated financial services environment. Welcome to MICE DESK

﻿

MICE DESK is the leading European company automating the sales process in the hospitality industry — and we are now expanding to the US.

We integrate with the systems hotels actually run on — Oracle OPERA Cloud, SIHOT, Guestline, Salesforce, Marriott's enterprise stack — which means our engineers work inside real hotel operations, not against sandbox APIs.

We are a Series A-stage company with a deliberately small team and real enterprise traction: major hotel groups across Europe run their group sales on Rocket. The people joining now shape the product, the deployment playbook, and the culture.
﻿

﻿﻿

The Role

Product Owners are how Rocket turns product direction into successful execution. You own specific product domains within the platform, ensuring engineering teams have clear requirements, priorities, and context needed to deliver high-quality features.

This is not a strategy ownership role. You work closely with Product Managers, Engineering, Design, QA, and customer-facing teams to translate product direction into actionable requirements, manage delivery, and ensure successful execution within your product area.

If you enjoy solving complex product problems, coordinating teams, and turning ideas into reliable software experiences, this is the role.

1. Backlog ownership and delivery execution.

Own delivery for assigned product domains across the MICE DESK platform. Manage and refine the backlog, prioritize work based on guidance from the Product Manager, customer input, and business impact, and ensure engineering teams have everything required to deliver successful features.

2. Requirements and feature definition.

Translate product direction and customer needs into clear, actionable requirements for engineering teams. Write user stories, acceptance criteria, and functional specifications while ensuring features are well understood before development begins.

3. Cross-functional collaboration.

Act as the connection point between Product, Engineering, Design, QA, and customer-facing teams throughout the development lifecycle. Support alignment on scope, priorities, delivery expectations, and successful feature releases.

4. Customer and product understanding.

Build a strong working understanding of customer workflows and operational pain points within your product domain. Support customer feedback collection, help validate solutions in partnership with the Product Manager, and provide insights that improve product execution.

5. Continuous improvement.

Improve product delivery through structured feedback, better processes, and execution-level insights. Surface opportunities for product enhancements to inform product strategy, support product discovery and experimentation led by the Product Manager, and contribute insights to long-term product planning.

What Success Looks Like

  • 3 months: You understand your assigned product domains, work effectively with Engineering and Product, and independently manage requirements, backlog refinement, and delivery processes.
  • 12 months: You own delivery across key product areas, engineering teams rely on your clarity and execution, and your work consistently improves feature delivery quality and customer outcomes.

    ﻿

    ﻿

Who You Are

Must-have

  • 4+ years of experience as a Product Owner, Product Manager, Business Analyst, or similar role in a SaaS or software product environment
  • Proven experience managing product backlogs and supporting software delivery
  • Strong ability to translate customer and product needs into clear requirements
  • Experience writing user stories, acceptance criteria, and functional specifications
  • Strong understanding of Agile product development methodologies
  • Experience working closely with engineering teams throughout the software development lifecycle
  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities
  • Experience using product management tools such as Jira, Confluence, Linear, or similar
  • Excellent English communication skills (B2–C1)
    ﻿
    ﻿

  • Experience in Hospitality Tech, CRM, PMS, or workflow automation platforms
  • Familiarity with UX principles and customer discovery techniques
  • Experience working with cross-functional, distributed teams
  • Exposure to analytics tools and product metrics
  • Experience in a high-growth startup or scale-up environment

  • Product & Delivery interview — backlog management, requirements definition, prioritization, stakeholder collaboration, Agile delivery, and real-world product execution scenarios
  • Founder / Product Manager interview — product vision, ownership mindset, collaboration style, and your role in executing MICE DESK's product direction

Why MICE DESK

  • Own delivery for meaningful product domains in an AI-native SaaS platform
  • Work closely with Product, Engineering, and founders to execute product direction

jobs.description:
Geode Health is a rapidly growing, national provider of outpatient mental health services. Our Mission is to “Transform mental health by making it more accessible, affordable and effective”.

Department: Patient Support Center – CareSync

Position Type: Full-Time | Remote | Hourly, Non-Exempt

Schedule: Monday–Friday, 7 AM–6:00 PM CT; flexibility to support new patient inbound coverage as needed.


Who We Are

Geode Health is a rapidly growing, national provider of outpatient mental health services. Our mission is to empower our patients to live healthier, more rewarding lives through accessible, affordable, and effective mental healthcare tailored to their needs. Our Patient Support Center is the front door to that care, often a patient’s first human connection with Geode and the first step in removing barriers between someone seeking help and the provider who can support them.


The Role

The Patient Engagement Specialist is a high-impact, outbound-first role at the heart of patient access and acquisition. You are the voice that reaches out to patients after they’ve been referred or expressed interest in care, helping them move from referral to a scheduled first visit. You’ll process incoming referrals, make timely and persistent outreach, and deliver white-glove support to the referring providers who trust us with their patients. You’ll also flex to answer new patient inbound calls when volume calls for it.


This is a fast-paced, goal-oriented environment for people who care deeply about both outcomes and experience. You’ll use strong virtual human connection, sound judgment, and follow-through to remove barriers to care, connect each patient to the right provider, and keep referring partners informed every step of the way. If you bring empathy, urgency, and a growth mindset, and believe every outreach is an opportunity to help someone take the next step, this role is for you.


What You’ll Do

Drive Outbound Engagement & Conversion

  • Proactively call referred patients and new patient leads, making first contact the same or next business day and following a structured outreach cadence until the patient is scheduled or the referral is closed.
  • Convert referrals and leads into scheduled first visits by matching each patient to the right provider using screening questions, insurance, provider preferences, and scheduling tools.
  • Guide hesitant patients toward a confident “yes” using empathy, reflective listening, communication frameworks, and sound judgment while removing barriers without pressure.
  • Set clear expectations for the first visit so patients arrive informed, comfortable, and ready to attend.
  • Meet individual and team targets for speed to first outreach, contact rate, and referral-to-scheduled conversion.

Process Referrals Accurately

  • Receive, review, and process incoming referrals from email, fax, phone, and partner channels promptly and accurately.
  • Confirm patient demographic and insurance information is complete and accurate; follow up with the referring office or patient to close any gaps.
  • Track each referral from receipt to first visit so status is clear to referring partners and internal teams.
  • Build and maintain working knowledge of accepted insurance plans.

Deliver White-Glove Support to Referring Providers

  • Serve as a responsive, reliable point of contact for referring provider offices, answering questions and sharing timely referral status updates.
  • Close the loop with referring providers by confirming receipt, sharing scheduling outcomes, and letting them know when another level of care may be a better fit.
  • Build trusted relationships with key partner practices so Geode is an easy, dependable place to send their patients.

Flex to Support New Patient Inbound Calls

  • Answer new patient inbound calls during peak volume or as assigned, with warmth, urgency, and a bias toward booking the first visit.
  • Partner with the Patient Support Center team to keep handoffs seamless for patients and providers.

Grow Through Coaching & Quality

  • Work toward individual and team goals for conversion, outreach timeliness, contact rate, quality, and documentation, using feedback and performance insights to keep improving.
  • Welcome regular call auditing and coaching as fuel for growth; apply feedback quickly and consistently.
  • Document every outreach attempt and interaction accurately in our systems with the right context and a clear next step.

Own the Patient & Provider Experience

  • Create a calm, personalized experience that helps patients feel confident taking the next step in care.
  • Protect patient privacy by maintaining strict confidentiality and following HIPAA and all privacy requirements.
  • Flex with changing workflows, volumes, and schedules while supporting the broader team as needs shift.

Who You Are

  • A hospitality-minded people person - you make others feel genuinely cared for and you love creating great experiences.
  • Energized by outbound outreach - comfortable making proactive calls and following up with persistence and care.
  • Motivated by goals and comfortable using feedback and performance insights to improve.
  • A persuasive, empathetic communicator who can navigate emotional or complex conversations with calm and confidence.
  • Organized and process-oriented - you track details closely and keep every referral moving.
  • Coachable and self-aware - you welcome feedback, know your strengths, and actively develop your areas of opportunity.
  • Passionate about mental healthcare and Geode’s mission to expand access to exceptional care.

What You Bring

  • 1–3+ years in a customer-facing, phone-based, or hospitality role; experience in a medical office, mental health, referral coordination, outbound calling, or sales/conversion is a strong plus.
  • Comfort working in a goal-oriented, quality-focused environment.
  • Familiarity with insurance plans and benefits, or the ability to learn them quickly (preferred).
  • Strong computer skills and the ability to navigate multiple systems while maintaining a warm, focused conversation with the patient.
  • A quiet, professional remote workspace and reliable connectivity.
  • Associate’s or bachelor’s degree preferred.

At Geode Health, we offer:

  • Competitive compensation

  • Flexible schedule

  • In-person and virtual patient visits

  • Comprehensive admin support (front office, accounting, finance, payroll, HR, etc)

  • Professional development opportunities

  • Clinical community, support, and leadership

  • Medical, dental and vision benefits

  • Life insurance

  • Short and long-term disability

  • Paid vacation and holidays

  • Matching 401k plan

  • State of the art technology

Why work for Geode Health?

At Geode Health, we take our commitment to patients and providers seriously. We focus every day on how to help patients across the United States get the best possible mental health care available. To achieve this, we focus on ensuring our providers have unmatched support and resources so that they can focus on providing great care. We are backed by KKR, a leading private equity firm with the experience and mission alignment to truly make an impact. Joining Geode Health will put you on the front-end of a rapidly growing movement to increase access and improve outcomes for mental health patients and providers across the nation.

At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.

As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.

Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.

The Account Manager develops account strategies, uncovers customer needs and market barriers, coordinates compliant Amgen resources, and translates field insight into enterprise strategy, evidence generation, tools and launch readiness. Position Summary

The Clinical Research Coordinator serves as a key member of a multidisciplinary research team supporting federally funded and foundation-funded research projects focused on cancer prevention, cancer control, health disparities, survivorship, and other health-related outcomes in rural and medically underserved communities throughout Ohio. This position is responsible for coordinating and implementing complex clinical and community-based research studies, with a particular emphasis on engaging participants in rural and Appalachian regions.


The Clinical Research Coordinator independently manages day-to-day research operations, facilitates participant recruitment and retention, maintains regulatory compliance, coordinates community partnerships, and ensures timely completion of study milestones. The position requires frequent interaction with study participants, healthcare providers, community organizations, and external collaborators across Ohio. Regular travel throughout rural Ohio is required.


Responsibilities

  • Coordinates multiple clinical, population-based, and community-engaged research studies.
  • Implements study protocols and standard operating procedures in accordance with sponsor, institutional, and regulatory requirements.
  • Oversees participant recruitment, enrollment, informed consent, data collection, and follow-up activities.
  • Schedules and conducts study visits in clinical, community, and virtual settings.
  • Maintains study databases and participant tracking systems.
  • Assists investigators with study startup, activation, and closeout activities.
  • Monitors study progress and ensures adherence to project timelines and deliverables.
  • Serves as a primary liaison between research teams and community partners across rural Ohio.

  • Assists with development and implementation of culturally appropriate recruitment and retention strategies.

  • Participates in study monitoring visits, audits, and sponsor reviews.
  • Tracks protocol deviations and assists with corrective action plans when necessary.
  • Collects, enters, verifies, and manages research data using electronic data capture systems.

The Director of Compliance will oversee compliance programs related to Renewable Fuel Standard, Canadian Clean Fuel Regulations (CFR), Low Carbon Fuel Standard (LCFS), 45Z Clean Fuel Production Credits, voluntary carbon markets, and sustainability certifications including ISCC and other future applicable frameworks. The role serves as the primary compliance authority for the organization and partners closely with Commercial, Operations, Engineering, Finance, Legal, Government Affairs, and external regulators.

Compliance Strategy & Leadership

Environmental Programs & Regulatory Compliance

  • Ensure compliance with EPA Renewable Fuel Standard (RFS), California LCFS, Oregon CFP, Canadian Clean Fuel Regulations, 45Z Clean Fuel Production Credit requirements, ISCC and applicable certification programs

Environmental Attribute Management

  • Establish controls over registry activities and environmental asset inventories.
  • Work closely with commercial and trading teams to support structured transactions and environmental commodity marketing activities.

Audit, Governance & Risk Management

  • Lead internal and external compliance audits.
  • Develop comprehensive compliance monitoring programs.
  • Maintain documentation standards sufficient to support regulatory examinations and transaction due diligence.
  • Identify emerging compliance risks and implement mitigation strategies.

Team Leadership

  • Lead and develop the compliance organization, including managers, analysts, and technical specialists.

  • Build organizational capability in regulatory reporting, carbon accounting, lifecycle analysis, and market compliance.
  • Foster a culture of integrity, accountability, and continuous improvement.

Regulatory Affairs & Stakeholder Engagement

  • Serve as primary company representative with regulators, certification bodies, auditors, and industry organizations.
  • Monitor regulatory developments and communicate impacts to executive leadership.
  • Support Government Relations activities with technical and regulatory expertise.
  • Participate in industry working groups and trade associations.

Qualifications

JOB DESCRIPTION:

We are looking for a Senior Cybersecurity Engineer to protect our people, data, and operations from modern threats, including those enabled by AI (Artificial Intelligence). You will serve as a technical authority on both sides of cybersecurity: defending against active threats, and designing and engineering cybersecurity into every layer of our technology environment. You will partner with IT, Legal, and business leaders to reduce risk across the enterprise.


How you will Own It:


Threat Defense

  • Lead investigation and containment of phishing, account compromise, and endpoint and network threats, correlating signals across endpoint, identity, email, and network data.
  • Monitor and triage alerts, and investigate anomalous identity and email activity, including suspicious sign-ins and business email compromise indicators.
  • Execute rapid response actions, such as disabling accounts, revoking sessions, and blocking indicators, and document root cause and remediation for leadership and auditors.
  • Develop and tune detections and response playbooks based on emerging threats, including AI-enabled attacks, and lessons learned from incidents.
  • Coordinate major incident response across IT, Legal, and external response partners, and strengthen readiness through tabletop exercises and post-incident reviews.
  • Perform forensic evidence collection and support legal holds and eDiscovery in partnership with Legal.
  • Share in an on-call rotation providing escalation coverage.

Cybersecurity Engineering

  • Architect and engineer cybersecurity solutions across the full technology stack, including endpoints, networks, identity, email and collaboration, cloud, applications, data, AI systems, and infrastructure, from requirements and design through implementation and lifecycle management.
  • Apply secure-by-design principles such as least privilege, defense in depth, zero trust, and segmentation, using threat modeling and architecture reviews, and maintain cybersecurity standards, reference architectures, and hardened baselines that are monitored for drift.
  • Design and govern identity and access controls with identity and infrastructure teams, including conditional access, network restrictions, privileged-access processes, and non-human identities.
  • Secure cloud and hybrid infrastructure through configuration standards, posture management, and guardrails that scale across environments.
  • Automate and codify cybersecurity controls, deployments, and workflows to reduce manual effort, variance, and risk.
  • Validate and release controls through testing, staged rollouts, and change management, operate cybersecurity platforms for resilience, coverage, and telemetry quality, and evaluate and integrate new technologies through proofs of concept.
  • Drive vulnerability and exposure reduction with infrastructure, cloud, and application owners, prioritizing by business impact and fixing root causes rather than applying one-off patches.

Risk & Governance

  • Assess AI and software vendors for cybersecurity, data protection, and governance risk, and deliver decision-ready recommendations.
  • Provide technical evidence and input for audits, framework maturity reviews, cybersecurity standards, and penetration-test remediation.
  • Manage cybersecurity vendor relationships, including renewals, service retainers, and roadmap input.

What you’ll Bring:

  • 5–8+ years in cybersecurity engineering, cybersecurity operations, or incident response.
  • Bachelor's degree in a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • Hands-on experience engineering, securing, and administering enterprise technology (endpoints, networks, identity, cloud, email, and applications) and cybersecurity platforms, along with incident response experience.
  • Working knowledge of NIST CSF, CIS, or ISO 27001.
  • One or more certifications such as CISSP, CISM, GIAC, or Security+.

You’re Good-to-Go if you have:


Sound judgment under pressure, clear communication with technical and non-technical audiences, discretion with confidential matters, a collaborative approach to influencing without formal authority, and the curiosity to keep pace with emerging technology and threats.


Added Fuel if you have:


  • Experience securing AI systems, or familiarity with AI governance frameworks such as the NIST AI Risk Management Framework.
  • Scripting, automation, and infrastructure-as-code skills (e.g., Python).
  • Cloud security experience across major cloud platforms.
  • Digital forensics and eDiscovery experience.
  • Threat hunting and third-party risk assessment experience.

How Success Is Measured

  • Threat defense: faster detection and response, and incidents closed with documented root cause.
  • Cybersecurity engineering: systems aligned to cybersecurity baselines, strong control coverage, timely remediation of critical vulnerabilities, and automation that reduces manual work and configuration drift.
  • Governance: strong audit outcomes and timely vendor risk decisions.

jobs.title: Annual Giving Officer
jobs.excerpt: Protect Democracy seeks a thoughtful, detail-oriented fundraiser to join our growing Partnerships team as an Annual Giving Officer.
jobs.description:
Protect Democracy seeks a thoughtful, detail-oriented fundraiser to join our growing Partnerships team as an Annual Giving Officer. This is a unique opportunity for a talented early-to-mid-career fundraising professional looking to expand their skill set and make an impact in the movement to protect our democracy. As Annual Giving Officer, you’ll steward a portfolio of mid-level donors and run the engagement tools to grow it, including across our grassroots and peer-to-peer fundraising programs.

About the position: In this role, you’ll be a key player on a small, highly collaborative and effective team. We seek to steward deep, long-term, trusting relationships with donors, engaging them as true partners in the broader democracy ecosystem. That approach has paid off: We’ve raised substantial unrestricted operating funds and built a solid financial runway, which lets us hire exceptional talent and launch high-impact interventions. These include 150+ legal actions, critical federal and state legislation, and creative solutions like VoteShield, which monitors and protects 160 million public voter records across 25 states.

About the organization: Protect Democracy formed in late 2016, recognizing that the global wave of authoritarianism had begun to erode American shores. We have since assembled a team of140+ expertswho have served under Democrats and Republicans and in the senior ranks of other nonprofit, political, or media organizations. Our team includes lawyers, policy experts, legislative advocates, media strategists, writers, data analysts, and software developers. We deploy litigation, legislative and communications strategies, technology, research, and analysis to stand up for free and fair elections, the rule of law, fact-based debate, and a better democracy for future generations. For this work, our team received a Skoll Award for Social Innovation and a MacArthur Fellowship.

This is a remote position based in the United States.* The priority deadline to apply for this role is October 29, 2026; we will review applications received after that date on a rolling basis.

The Annual Giving Officer will:

  • Manage a portfolio that currently has about 300 mid level gift partners—both institutional funders and individuals—leveraging technology to assist in regular communications, soliciting gift renewals, and customized cultivation plans where appropriate;

  • Aim to grow this portfolio of donors to 500 by 2028 through strong collaboration with Partnerships team members, active stewardship, and management of our newly launched peer-to-peer fundraising tool;

  • Write & distribute high-quality quarterly e-newsletter & bi-annual e-appeals to grassroots donors, mostly through synthesis of existing material;

  • Assemble high-quality materials and communications that reflect Protect Democracy’s voice and mission, including grant proposals, reports, and donor correspondence;

  • Represent Protect Democracy in external meetings with donors and trusted intermediaries;

  • Conduct prospect research to identify new high-capacity individuals and institutions aligned with our mission;

  • Collaborate with the Partnerships team to set and track ambitious fundraising goals, maintaining accurate and up-to-date records;

  • Independently seek opportunities to build and improve on Protect Democracy’s fundraising operations by closely examining needs, assessing possible solutions, and making concise recommendations;

  • Contribute to Protect Democracy’s programmatic work and culture.

The ideal candidate brings:

  • Three or more years of professional experience, including experience working directly with donors;

  • Demonstrated comfort and experience with identifying, cultivating, stewarding, closing, and renewing 4-5 figure gift opportunities;

  • Proficiency with fundraising tools and CRMs with a preference for Raiser’s Edge experience, and a desire to help our team use data and automation more effectively;

  • Ability to correspond persuasively and authentically with key stakeholders;

  • A solid understanding of the political and philanthropic landscape;

  • Excellent judgment, time management, and follow-through;

  • A growth mindset and collaborative orientation, including enthusiasm for giving and receiving feedback in all directions;

  • A nuanced understanding of our country’s political landscape, the authoritarian threat, and the reality that our democracy has never fully represented communities of color;

  • Unfettered enthusiasm for Protect Democracy’s cross-ideological and nonpartisan approach to protecting our democracy.

At Protect Democracy, we believe that diversity isn’t just a strength — it’s a necessity for tackling the complex challenges facing democracy. A broad range of backgrounds, perspectives, and lived experiences strengthens our ability to analyze problems, craft solutions, and drive meaningful change. We strongly encourage candidates from diverse backgrounds and from across the political and ideological spectrum to apply. If you meet most but not all of the criteria listed above but believe nonetheless you’d be a stellar match for the role and could grow into it, we want to hear from you. The Partnerships team thrives on having a variety of perspectives and expertise working highly collaboratively.

Compensation

The starting salary range for this role is $84,300-$94,000 (FLSA Exempt), commensurate with the candidate’s relevant experience, capabilities, and skills, and in alignment with internal equity.

About Protect Democracy

  • *Flexible location. We are a remote-first organization based exclusively in the United States, meaning our staff work within the US and primarily virtually. We also offer shared workspaces for those who enjoy working in an office environment. We are established for remote work in many states across the country, and while candidates based anywhere in the United States are welcome to apply, we may not be able to offer employment in your current location. If you proceed in the hiring process, we will discuss where you currently live and what is possible in our initial interview. All staff are also required to travel at least two times per year to team retreats, and this role also requires periodic travel. (Accommodations to this requirement will be made only in exceptional circumstances.)

  • Commitment to an inclusive workplace. Protect Democracy is an equal opportunity employer. We believe that a broad range of backgrounds, perspectives, and lived experiences strengthens our ability to analyze problems, craft solutions, and drive meaningful change. Protect Democracy encourages applications from all qualified individuals without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, national origin, marital status, citizenship, disability, or veteran status.

  • Phenomenal benefits. Our benefits package includes generous sick leave and a flexible vacation policy where we encourage team members to take 4-5 weeks every year, along with 12 paid holidays, 6 weeks of paid family medical leave, and 18 weeks of paid parental leave. We also offer a 401(k) plan with up to 6% employer match that vests immediately. Additionally, we cover employee medical premiums at 100% (with up to 95% coverage for dependents depending on plan selection), and employee and dependents dental/vision at 100%. All employees have access to long-term disability and life insurance, fertility benefits, a home office stipend, and bonuses at the discretion of the Executive Director.

  • Ample opportunities for personal & professional development. Candidates who do not meet all listed criteria should still apply, as our organizational structure focuses on providing mentorship and opportunities for professional growth.

To apply for this position, please complete the application linked below. As part of your application, you will be asked to answer a couple screener questions and upload a PDF of your resume. We are weighing responses to our short answer questions highly, so cover letters are truly optional for this role. Not including a cover letter will not be counted against you. That said, we have left the option in case there is something compelling you want to share that you don't believe will come across in your resume alone.

The priority deadline to apply for this role is October 29, 2026; we will review applications received after that date on a rolling basis.

Applications missing any of the required materials will be considered incomplete and not reviewed.

Important notes

  • Contact if you require specific accommodations at any point in the hiring process.

  • Keep an eye on your promotions/spam folders to avoid missed communication.

  • A note on fair hiring and automated tech: To help our small team review applications efficiently and fairly, we use automated screening tools to assist with resume and response review. Every candidate flagged by our system is reviewed by a member of our recruiting team; we never rely on automated scoring alone to make hiring decisions. If you have questions about this process, or need an alternative application path as an accommodation, reach out to us at .

  • We are unable to provide status updates for each application we receive. If you reach out and do not hear back, please know it is not for lack of appreciation or interest, but simply for lack of staff capacity to respond to individual inquiries.

  • The application will include a voluntary EEO survey so that we can monitor the applicant pool as a whole for representation and equal employment opportunities, and to evaluate our progress as an organization toward a diverse and inclusive workforce, which we believe is a pillar of a thriving democracy. The categories used by the EEO survey are limited and may not reflect your lived experience; please feel free to opt out of any of the questions. Your responses to this survey are entirely separate from your application materials, are not accessible to those responsible for hiring decisions, and will not affect your candidacy in any way.

Highlights

Join our small, high impact, remote team to build lasting donor relationships that protect democracy. Manage a 300-donor partner portfolio and help grow our grassroots and peer-to-peer programs.

jobs.description:
The Company

Serving the People Who Serve the People

Granicus is driven by the excitement of building, implementing, and maintaining technology that is transforming the Govtech industry by bringing governments and its constituents together. We are on a mission to support our customers with meeting the needs of their communities and implementing our technology in ways that are equitable and inclusive. Granicus has consistently appeared on the GovTech 100 list over the past 5 years and has been recognized as the best companies to work on BuiltIn.

Over the last 25 years, we have served 5,500 federal, state, and local government agencies and more than 300 million citizen subscribers power an unmatched Subscriber Network that use our digital solutions to make the world a better place. With comprehensive cloud-based solutions for communications, government website design, meeting and agenda management software, records management, and digital services, Granicus empowers stronger relationships between government and residents across the U.S., U.K., Australia, New Zealand, and Canada. By simplifying interactions with residents, while disseminating critical information, Granicus brings governments closer to the people they serve—driving meaningful change for communities around the globe.

Want to know more? See more of what we do here.

Job Summary

​The Manager, Customer Success leads the ANZ Success team and is accountable for helping customers realise measurable value from Granicus products and services. The role combines people leadership, portfolio oversight and disciplined execution to strengthen adoption, retention, customer advocacy and sustainable growth across our public sector customer base.

​This leader creates clarity and consistency across the customer lifecycle, coaches Customer Success team members to operate as trusted advisers, and partners closely with Sales, Implementation, Support, Product and Marketing. The role uses customer data, commercial insight and practical knowledge of the ANZ public sector to identify risk early, improve customer outcomes and help the existing customer base become a source of sustained retention, advocacy and growth.

What Your Impact Will Look Like

Essential Functions

  • ​​Lead, coach and develop the ANZ Success team, setting clear expectations for customer outcomes, portfolio discipline, quality, productivity and professional growth.
  • ​Create an inclusive, accountable team environment that encourages open communication, sound judgement, continuous learning and high ethical standards.
  • ​Own team performance across product adoption, customer engagement, value realisation, retention, risk management, well qualified growth opportunities and completion of agreed customer engagements.
  • ​Guide the team in using clear customer plans, structured reviews and agreed engagement rhythms that connect customer priorities to measurable outcomes.
  • ​Apply agreed guiding principles for customer segmentation and engagement so the level of service is aligned to customer value, complexity, risk and opportunity.
  • ​Lead the coordinated response for customers at risk, ensuring clear ownership, timely recovery plans, appropriate leadership visibility and effective cross functional action.
  • ​Manage escalations with professionalism and urgency, balancing customer advocacy, commercial context and sustainable outcomes for Granicus.
  • ​Maintain accurate portfolio, churn and renewal forecasts, and provide clear reporting on customer health, engagement, risk, retention and growth opportunities.
  • ​Build a strong working partnership between Customer Success and Sales, with shared customer context, coordinated engagement and early identification of qualified growth opportunities recorded in Salesforce.
  • ​Partner with Implementation Services, Support, Product and Marketing to improve onboarding transitions, adoption, issue resolution, customer communications and advocacy.
  • ​Use customer insights, usage data and feedback to identify trends, improve playbooks and inform product direction, service design and regional priorities.
  • ​Champion consistent use of systems, processes and documentation, balancing global standards with ANZ customer needs and public sector practices.
  • ​Represent Granicus in customer, partner and industry forums, strengthening trusted relationships and the company's reputation across the region.
  • ​Use approved AI enabled tools and automation to improve analysis, preparation, customer prioritisation, consistent service delivery and customer communication. Model responsible use by validating outputs, protecting customer and company information, and following Granicus privacy, security and acceptable use requirements.

Knowledge/Skills/Abilities

  • ​Proven people leadership, coaching and performance management capability, with the ability to set direction while enabling individual ownership.
  • ​Strong commercial judgement and understanding of the relationship between customer outcomes, adoption, retention, renewal confidence and growth.
  • ​Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, including confidence with senior customer and internal leaders.
  • ​Ability to interpret customer data, health signals and portfolio trends, turning insight into clear priorities and action.
  • ​Strong problem solving and escalation management skills, with calm judgement in complex or ambiguous situations.
  • ​Working knowledge of SaaS Customer Success practices, customer lifecycle management and scalable engagement models.
  • ​Ability to collaborate across functions and influence outcomes without relying on direct authority.
  • ​High standards of organisation, follow through, written communication, presentation and data quality.
  • ​Commitment to customer value, public sector impact, diversity of thought and continuous improvement.

You Will Love This Job If You Have

Experience/Credentials:

  • ​​Five or more years of increasing responsibility in Customer Success, account management, consulting, SaaS or a comparable customer facing discipline.
  • ​Demonstrated experience leading, coaching or developing customer facing professionals, through formal people management or substantial team leadership responsibility.
  • ​Experience owning customer retention, adoption, risk, value or growth outcomes across a portfolio.
  • ​Experience working with public sector, local government, community engagement, digital experience or civic technology customers is highly regarded.
  • ​Experience using Salesforce and Customer Success, analytics or business intelligence tools to manage priorities and report performance.
  • ​Tertiary qualifications or equivalent practical experience in business, technology, government, communications or a related field.​

Other Job Info

  • This role is performed primarily in a remote office environment using collaboration, customer management and analytics tools.
  • Flexibility may be required to support customers and colleagues across Australia, New Zealand and global time zones.
  • Travel may be required for customer meetings, team sessions and Granicus commitments.

Security Requirement:

  • Responsible for Granicus information security by appropriately preserving the Confidentiality, Integrity, and Availability (CIA) of Granicus information assets in accordance with the company's information security program.

Don’t have all the skills/experience mentioned above? At Granicus, we are trying to build diverse, inclusive teams. We do not have degree requirements for most of our roles. If you don’t meet every requirement above but are excited to learn more, we encourage you to apply. We might just be able to find another role that could be a perfect fit!

jobs.description:
At Sword, we’re building AI to heal billions and unlock humanity’s full potential. In doing so, we’re pioneering AI Care, a fundamentally new approach to healthcare built for medical reasoning, safety, and real-time treatment, not generic technology applied after the fact. As both a clinical-centric frontier AI lab and an applied AI platform, Sword is reimagining how care is delivered at scale, removing traditional barriers like appointments, waiting rooms, and stigma so more people can access the care they need—and ultimately get back to lives lived in full.

Since 2020, Sword has expanded across physical therapy, women’s health, cardiometabolic, and mental health, and is now moving beyond the session to a fully AI-native, 24/7 care program that brings physical activity, therapeutic exercise, psychotherapy, nutrition, and behavior change into one connected experience. More than 700,000 members across three continents have completed over 10 million AI sessions, helping 1,000+ enterprise clients avoid more than $1 billion in unnecessary healthcare costs. Backed by 42 clinical studies, 44+ patents, and more than $500 million raised from leading investors including Khosla Ventures, General Catalyst, and Founders Fund, Sword is defining a new standard for healthcare.

AI Proficiency at Sword

AI fluency is a core expectation at Sword. Every candidate is assessed against our three-level framework — be ready to share real examples of how AI is already part of how you work.

  • Explorer (Level 1) — Uses AI daily to boost personal productivity

  • Builder (Level 2) — Creates workflows and tools that elevate the whole team

  • Integrator (Level 3) — Embeds AI into products and processes at scale

Every hire must demonstrate at least Level 1. The expected level will vary depending on the seniority of the role.

Role

Sword is looking for an Advisor, Health Plans to own several of our most strategically important health-plan relationships. This is a senior individual-contributor role with direct accountability for revenue retention, member marketing access, relationship strength, and the account conditions that enable cross-sell and upsell.

You will act as the general manager of a concentrated payer portfolio. jobs.title: Оператор вихідної лінії контактного центру банку
jobs.excerpt: Райффайзен Банк — найбільший український банк з іноземним капіталом.
jobs.description:
Райффайзен Банк — найбільший український банк з іноземним капіталом. Більше 30 років ми створюємо та вибудовуємо банківську систему нашої держави.

У Райфі працює понад 5 тисяч співробітників, серед них одна із найбільших продуктових ІТ-команд, що налічує 900+ фахівців. Щодня пліч-о-пліч ми працюємо, щоб більш ніж 2,5 мільйона наших клієнтів могли отримати якісне обслуговування, користуватися продуктами і сервісами банку, розвивати бізнес, адже ми #Разом_з_Україною. 


Твої майбутні обов’язки: 

  • Здійснювати продаж банківських продуктів існуючим та новим клієнтам банку

Твій досвід та навички: 

  • Вільно володієш українською мовою
  • Маєш навички роботи з комп’ютером
  • Маєш додаткові засоби живлення та стабільний інтернет під час відключення світла
  • Готовий до роботи у напрямку телефонних продажів
  • Швидко навчаєшся та легко сприймаєш великий обсяг інформації
  • Легко знаходиш спільну мову з різними людьми
  • Вмієш ефективно працювати в команді
  • Можеш просто пояснювати складні речі

Пропонуємо те, що має значення саме для тебе: 

  • Конкурентна заробітна плата: гарантуємо стабільний дохід. Додатково, у нас діє реферальна програма винагороди за залучення нових колег до Райффайзен Банку.
  • Соціальний пакет: офіційне працевлаштування, 28 днів оплачуваної відпустки, додатковий «декрет» для татусів, та матеріальна допомога для батьків при народженні дітей.
  • Комфортні умови праці: гібридний формат роботи у м. Івано-Франківськ або віддалений формат роботи з можливістю працювати з будь якого куточка України, забезпечення сучасною технікою.
    (засоби живлення і стабільний інтернет забезпечуєш самостійно)
  • Wellbeing програма: для всіх співробітників доступні медичне страхування з першого робочого дня; консультації психолога, нутриціолога чи юриста; дисконт програми на спорт та покупки; family days для дітей та дорослих; масаж в офісі.
  • Навчання та розвиток: повний супровід на старті (онбординг); тренерський центр для розвитку навичок; доступ до понад 130 навчальних онлайн-ресурсів; програма менторства; онлайн-бібліотека.
  • Крута команда: наші колеги – це спільнота, де вітаються допитливість, талант та інновації. Ми підтримуємо один одного, вчимося разом та зростаємо. Ти можеш знайти однодумців у понад 15-ти професійних ком’юніті, читацькому чи спортивному клубах.
  • Кар'єрні можливості: ми заохочуємо просування всередині банку між функціями.
  • Програма підтримки захисників і захисниць: ми зберігаємо робочі місця та виплачуємо середню заробітну плату мобілізованим. Для ветеранів та ветеранок у нас діє програма підтримки, розвивається ветеранська спільнота Банку. Ми працюємо над підвищенням обізнаності керівників та команд з питань повернення ветеранів до цивільного життя. Райффайзен Банк відзначений як один з найкращих роботодавців для ветеранів (Forbes).

Чому Райффайзен Банк?  Наша головна цінність - люди і ми даємо їм підтримку і визнання, навчаємо, залучаємо до змін. Приєднуйся до команди Райфу, адже для нас ТИ маєш значення! 

    • Один із найбільших кредиторів економіки та аграрного бізнесу серед приватних банків 
    • Визнаний найкращим працедавцем за версіями EY, Forbes, Robota.ua, Stud-Point, Delo.UA, NV, Odgers, UAFIC
    • Найбільший донор гуманітарної допомоги серед банків (Червоний Хрест України, UNITED24, Superhumans, СМІЛИВІ) 
    • Одна з найбільших ІТ-продуктових команд серед банків країни 
    • Один із найбільших платників податків в Україні, за 2025 рік було нараховано 6 млрд гривень

Можливості для всіх:

    • Райф керується принципами, що фокусуються на людині та її розвитку, у центрі уваги понад 5 тисяч співробітників та 2,5 мільйона клієнтів  
    • Підтримуємо принципи різноманіття, рівності та інклюзивності.
    • Ми відкриті до найму ветеранів і людей з інвалідністю та готові адаптувати робоче середовище під ваші особливі потреби
    • Співпрацюємо зі студентами та людьми старшого віку, створюючи умови для зростання на будь-якому етапі кар’єри.

В Райфі ти маєш значення! 

Бажаєш дізнатися більше? – Підписуйся на нас у соц.мережах: Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn 

Твій рекрутер: Катерина Бубнова - Вікторія Онос -

Відгукуйтесь на вакансію, заповнюйте коротку анкету на нашому сайті і ми зв'яжемось з вами якнайшвидше!

Senior Account Executive – Enterprise B2B Sales & High-Ticket Deals

Position Type: Full-Time, Contract, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Eastern Time (EST)

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a Senior Account Executive to own the full B2B sales cycle and close complex, high-value deals with senior decision-makers.

This is a true full-cycle sales role — not a position focused solely on working inbound leads.

You’ll be responsible for:

  • Building and maintaining your own pipeline
  • Prospecting and engaging senior decision-makers
  • Running discovery calls and product demonstrations
  • Managing complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles
  • Negotiating and closing high-ticket B2B deals
  • Owning forecasting and revenue targets

If you have a proven track record in enterprise or mid-market B2B sales, consistently hit quota, and are comfortable selling directly to C-suite executives, this role is a strong fit.

What You’ll Own

Full-Cycle B2B Sales

Own the entire sales process from first contact through signed agreement:

  • Prospecting
  • Qualification
  • Discovery
  • Product demonstrations
  • Proposal development
  • Negotiation
  • Closing

Build relationships with prospective customers while maintaining momentum throughout complex buying cycles.

Manage multiple high-value opportunities simultaneously and take full ownership of moving qualified deals toward close.

Pipeline Generation & Management

  • Build and maintain a healthy pipeline of qualified opportunities.
  • Generate new business through proactive prospecting and follow-up.
  • Identify target accounts and relevant decision-makers.
  • Maintain disciplined follow-up across longer sales cycles.
  • Track opportunities, activities, next steps, and deal progression in Pipedrive or similar CRM platforms.
  • Maintain accurate pipeline visibility and forecasting.

Enterprise & Executive-Level Selling

Engage directly with:

  • C-suite executives
  • Business owners
  • Vice Presidents
  • Directors
  • Department leaders
  • Other key decision-makers and stakeholders

Understand business challenges, strategic priorities, buying motivations, and decision criteria.

Build credibility through consultative, value-driven conversations rather than transactional selling.

Complex Deal Management

  • Navigate multi-stakeholder buying processes.
  • Identify champions, decision-makers, influencers, and potential blockers.
  • Manage longer sales cycles and multiple approval stages.
  • Coordinate internal and external stakeholders throughout the deal.
  • Maintain momentum through procurement, negotiation, and final approval.
  • Develop clear strategies for advancing stalled or complex opportunities.

Discovery, Demonstrations & Value Selling

  • Run structured discovery calls to uncover business needs, pain points, priorities, and buying criteria.
  • Deliver compelling product demonstrations and sales presentations.
  • Tailor presentations to the prospect’s specific business objectives.
  • Clearly communicate ROI, business impact, and strategic value.
  • Position solutions as investments tied to measurable outcomes rather than simply products or tools.

Negotiation & Closing

  • Lead pricing and commercial conversations confidently.
  • Handle objections professionally and strategically.
  • Negotiate agreements while protecting deal value.
  • Identify and address barriers preventing prospects from moving forward.
  • Drive opportunities toward clear decisions and signed agreements.
  • Maintain strong relationships throughout the closing process.

Account Strategy & Revenue Growth

  • Develop account-level strategies for priority opportunities.
  • Identify expansion and repeat-business opportunities.
  • Understand target markets and buying patterns.
  • Prioritize opportunities based on value, probability, and strategic importance.
  • Take full ownership of individual revenue performance.

Forecasting & CRM Discipline

Maintain accurate CRM records covering:

  • Deal stage
  • Opportunity value
  • Next steps
  • Decision-makers
  • Expected close dates
  • Risks and blockers
  • Forecast probability

Provide reliable revenue forecasts and pipeline updates to leadership.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

Partner with:

  • Marketing
  • Product
  • Operations
  • Leadership

Coordinate internal resources to strengthen proposals, presentations, and deal strategy.

Share prospect feedback and market insights to improve messaging, positioning, and the overall sales process.

Market Intelligence & Competitive Positioning

  • Stay informed on competitors, market trends, and customer priorities.
  • Understand competitive alternatives prospects may be evaluating.
  • Incorporate relevant market insights into sales conversations.
  • Position the company effectively in competitive opportunities.
  • Share recurring market intelligence with internal stakeholders.

Required Experience & Skills

Non-Negotiables

  • 6+ years of B2B sales experience, ideally within enterprise or mid-market environments.
  • Proven track record of meeting or exceeding sales quotas.
  • Demonstrated experience closing high-value B2B deals.
  • Strong experience owning the full sales cycle from prospecting through close.
  • Experience selling directly to executives and senior decision-makers.
  • Strong understanding of complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles.
  • Experience building and managing your own pipeline.
  • Strong CRM experience with Pipedrive or similar platforms.
  • Excellent discovery, presentation, negotiation, and closing skills.
  • Strong written and verbal English communication.
  • Ability to work independently and take ownership in a remote environment.
  • Availability to work U.S. Eastern Time hours.

Nice-to-Have Experience

  • SaaS sales
  • Professional services sales
  • High-growth startup experience
  • Enterprise account management
  • 60–180+ day sales cycles
  • Multi-stakeholder enterprise deals
  • Consultative or solution-based selling
  • Account expansion and upselling
  • Experience with Zoom and Google Workspace
  • Familiarity with structured sales methodologies

What Makes You a Strong Fit

You:

  • Have consistently closed meaningful B2B revenue.
  • Are comfortable speaking with C-suite executives and business leaders.
  • Can create pipeline instead of relying entirely on inbound opportunities.
  • Know how to run discovery conversations that uncover real business needs.
  • Understand how to sell value and ROI rather than features.
  • Can navigate complex deals involving multiple stakeholders.
  • Are disciplined with CRM management and forecasting.
  • Know when to push a deal forward and when to uncover additional information.
  • Take ownership of your quota and revenue outcomes.
  • Thrive in performance-driven environments with significant autonomy.

What a Typical Day Looks Like

A Senior Account Executive’s day may include:

  • Prospecting into high-value target accounts.
  • Following up with active opportunities.
  • Running discovery calls with executives and senior stakeholders.
  • Delivering tailored demos and presentations.
  • Preparing proposals and business cases.
  • Handling objections and negotiating commercial terms.
  • Developing strategies for complex or stalled opportunities.
  • Collaborating internally on priority deals.
  • Updating Pipedrive and reviewing pipeline health.
  • Forecasting expected revenue and upcoming closes.
  • Researching target accounts, competitors, and market developments.

In short: you build pipeline, manage complex B2B opportunities, and turn qualified prospects into closed revenue.

Key Metrics for Success

  • Monthly and quarterly revenue closed
  • Quota attainment
  • Qualified pipeline generated
  • Pipeline coverage
  • Opportunity-to-close conversion rate
  • Win rate
  • Average deal size
  • Sales cycle length and deal velocity
  • Forecast accuracy
  • CRM and pipeline accuracy

Why This Role Stands Out

  • True ownership of the complete B2B sales cycle.
  • Opportunity to close complex, high-value deals.
  • Direct interaction with executives and senior decision-makers.
  • High earning potential tied to individual performance.
  • Significant autonomy and ownership over your pipeline.
  • Direct impact on company revenue and growth.
  • Fully remote environment aligned with EST hours.
  • Opportunity to grow into:
    • Enterprise Account Executive
    • Strategic Account Executive
    • Sales Manager
    • Sales Director
    • Revenue Leadership

Interview Process

  • Initial Phone Screen
  • Video Interview
  • Final Interview with Leadership
  • Background Verification

Spark Hire Intro Video

As part of the application process, you’ll be asked to complete a short Spark Hire intro video.

We’re particularly interested in hearing about:

  • Your B2B sales background and the types of solutions you’ve sold.
  • The typical deal sizes and sales cycles you’ve managed.
  • Your experience selling to C-suite and senior decision-makers.
  • Your approach to generating your own pipeline.
  • A complex or high-value deal you successfully closed.
  • Your quota attainment and sales performance.

Keep your responses clear, concise, and conversational. We want to understand how you communicate, sell, and approach complex B2B opportunities.

Completion of the Spark Hire intro video is required for your application to be considered.

Apply Now

If you:

  • Have 6+ years of B2B sales experience.
  • Have a proven record of hitting or exceeding quota.
  • Can build pipeline and close high-value opportunities.
  • Are confident selling to executives.
  • Thrive in complex, full-cycle sales environments.
  • Want direct ownership of revenue outcomes.

We’d love to hear from you.

Apply today and complete the required Spark Hire intro video to move forward in the hiring process.

jobs.description:
Business Development Representative (BDR) – B2B SaaS, Outbound Sales & Lead Generation

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Location: Colombia, Mexico, Brazil
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a Business Development Representative (BDR) to generate qualified opportunities and build a consistent B2B sales pipeline.

This is a quota-carrying, execution-focused sales role for someone who is comfortable prospecting every day, speaking with decision-makers, qualifying inbound opportunities, and turning cold outreach into booked meetings.

You’ll own both inbound lead qualification and outbound prospecting, using modern sales tools and multi-channel outreach across phone, email, and LinkedIn.

Your primary objective is simple: create qualified pipeline that turns into revenue.

If you have experience as an SDR or BDR, are confident cold calling U.S.-based prospects, and enjoy working toward measurable targets, this role is a strong fit.

What You’ll Own

Outbound Prospecting & Lead Generation

Build and execute targeted outbound campaigns using:

  • LinkedIn Sales Navigator
  • Apollo
  • ZoomInfo
  • Email
  • Cold calling
  • LinkedIn outreach

You’ll:

  • Research target accounts and decision-makers.
  • Build high-quality prospect lists.
  • Execute personalized multi-channel outreach sequences.
  • Cold call prospective customers.
  • Write compelling cold emails and LinkedIn messages.
  • Test messaging, sequences, and outreach strategies.
  • Follow up consistently with prospects.
  • Generate qualified meetings for Account Executives.

Inbound Lead Qualification

Respond quickly to inbound leads generated through:

  • Marketing campaigns
  • Website inquiries
  • Events
  • Other demand-generation channels

Conduct discovery and qualification conversations to understand:

  • Business needs
  • Pain points
  • Budget
  • Decision-making authority
  • Buying process
  • Timeline

Determine whether opportunities meet qualification criteria and move qualified prospects into the sales pipeline.

Discovery Calls & Meeting Booking

Conduct professional conversations with B2B prospects and decision-makers.

You’ll:

  • Ask effective discovery questions.
  • Identify business challenges and buying intent.
  • Understand prospect needs before positioning next steps.
  • Handle common objections confidently.
  • Qualify opportunities accurately.
  • Schedule qualified meetings and demos for Account Executives.
  • Provide clear handoff notes so AEs enter meetings with the right context.

CRM & Pipeline Management

Maintain accurate sales records using platforms such as:

  • Salesforce
  • HubSpot
  • Zoho CRM

Track:

  • Prospect activity
  • Calls
  • Emails
  • Qualification notes
  • Follow-ups
  • Opportunity stages
  • Meetings booked

Maintain strong CRM hygiene so the sales team has reliable visibility into pipeline activity and next steps.

Lead Nurturing & Follow-Up

Not every prospect will be ready to buy immediately.

You’ll:

  • Nurture early-stage opportunities.
  • Maintain structured follow-up cadences.
  • Re-engage prospects at the right time.
  • Track next steps and buying signals.
  • Ensure qualified prospects don’t disappear because of missed follow-ups.

Sales Collaboration & Optimization

Work closely with Account Executives and sales leadership on:

  • Pipeline reviews
  • Target account strategy
  • Qualification criteria
  • Prospect feedback
  • Objection patterns
  • Outreach messaging

Share insights from prospect conversations to help improve targeting and sales execution.

Continuously evaluate:

  • Reply rates
  • Connect rates
  • Meetings booked
  • Qualification rates
  • Lead-to-opportunity conversion
  • Pipeline generated

Use performance data to improve your outreach approach.

Required Experience & Skills

Must-Have

  • 2+ years of experience as a BDR, SDR, Inside Sales Representative, or similar B2B sales professional.
  • Proven track record of:
    • Meeting or exceeding quota
    • Booking qualified meetings
    • Generating sales pipeline
  • Hands-on outbound prospecting experience.
  • Confidence with:
    • Cold calling
    • Cold email
    • LinkedIn prospecting
  • Experience with prospecting tools such as:
    • Apollo
    • ZoomInfo
    • LinkedIn Sales Navigator
  • Experience using CRM platforms such as:
    • Salesforce
    • HubSpot
    • Zoho CRM
  • Strong discovery and lead qualification skills.
  • Excellent spoken and written English.
  • Comfortable communicating with U.S.-based prospects and decision-makers.
  • Highly organized with strong follow-through.
  • Metrics-driven and comfortable working toward activity and pipeline targets.
  • Resilient and comfortable handling rejection.
  • Ability to work remotely during U.S. business hours.
  • Based in Colombia, Mexico, or Brazil.

Nice-to-Have Experience

  • B2B SaaS sales experience.
  • Technology or professional services sales experience.
  • Experience running structured outbound campaigns.
  • Familiarity with sales methodologies such as:
    • SPIN
    • MEDDIC
    • Challenger
  • Experience working with Account Executives in a structured SDR/BDR organization.
  • Experience selling into U.S. businesses.
  • Experience prospecting senior decision-makers.
  • Familiarity with sales engagement and sequencing tools.

What Makes You a Strong Fit

You:

  • Are comfortable picking up the phone and starting conversations.
  • Know how to personalize outreach without sacrificing volume.
  • Understand the difference between booking meetings and booking qualified meetings.
  • Ask thoughtful discovery questions rather than immediately pitching.
  • Follow up consistently without needing reminders.
  • Stay motivated despite rejection.
  • Think in terms of pipeline and revenue, not activity alone.
  • Keep your CRM clean and accurate.
  • Take ownership of your numbers.
  • Constantly test ways to improve your conversion rates.

What a Typical Day Looks Like

Your day may include:

  • Reviewing new inbound leads and responding quickly.
  • Researching target accounts and decision-makers.
  • Building prospect lists using Apollo, ZoomInfo, and LinkedIn Sales Navigator.
  • Making outbound cold calls.
  • Sending personalized cold emails and LinkedIn messages.
  • Running discovery and qualification calls.
  • Following up with warm and previously contacted prospects.
  • Booking qualified meetings for Account Executives.
  • Updating CRM records and next steps.
  • Reviewing sequence performance and response rates.
  • Participating in pipeline reviews with the sales team.
  • Testing new messaging or prospecting approaches.

In short: you create qualified sales opportunities by combining disciplined prospecting, strong communication, effective qualification, and persistent follow-up.

Key Metrics for Success

  • 10–15 discovery calls per week
  • 8–12 qualified opportunities per month
  • Qualified meetings booked
  • Lead-to-opportunity conversion rate
  • Outbound response and connection rates
  • Daily and weekly prospecting activity
  • Pipeline generated
  • Meeting quality and AE acceptance rate
  • Consistency of prospect follow-up
  • 100% CRM data accuracy

Spark Hire Intro Video

As part of the application process, you’ll be asked to complete a short Spark Hire intro video.

We’d like to hear about:

  • Your experience as an SDR, BDR, or inside sales professional.
  • The types of B2B products or services you have sold.
  • Your experience selling into the U.S. market.
  • Your experience with cold calling, cold email, and LinkedIn prospecting.
  • How many outbound calls or touches you typically complete in a day or week.
  • Your average number of qualified meetings booked per month.
  • Your previous quota and how consistently you achieved it.
  • A specific example of an outbound opportunity you generated that ultimately contributed to revenue.
  • How you research and personalize outreach to a new prospect.
  • How you handle a prospect who says, “I’m not interested.”
  • How you determine whether a lead is genuinely qualified before booking a meeting for an Account Executive.
  • Your approach to following up when a prospect initially responds but then goes quiet.
  • Your experience with Apollo, ZoomInfo, and LinkedIn Sales Navigator.
  • Which CRM platforms you have used and how you maintain accurate pipeline records.
  • The prospecting or sales metrics you monitor most closely and why.

Keep your answers clear, concise, and specific. Wherever possible, include measurable results such as quota attainment, meetings booked, conversion rates, pipeline generated, or revenue influenced.

Completion of the Spark Hire intro video is required for your application to be considered.

Why This Role Stands Out

  • Direct impact on pipeline and company revenue.
  • Ownership across inbound and outbound lead generation.
  • Hands-on experience with modern B2B sales tools.
  • Clear, measurable performance expectations.
  • Opportunity to work with U.S.-based prospects and businesses.
  • Fully remote position.
  • High-growth sales environment.
  • Strong career progression into:
    • Senior BDR
    • Account Executive
    • Business Development Manager
    • Sales Development Lead

Interview Process

  • Application Review
  • Spark Hire Intro Video
  • Initial Phone Screen
  • Recruiter Interview
  • Client Interview
  • Offer

Apply Now

If you have strong BDR/SDR experience, are confident with cold calling, outbound prospecting, lead qualification, and CRM management, and have a track record of generating qualified B2B opportunities, we’d love to hear from you.

Apply today and complete the required Spark Hire intro video to move forward.
