jobs.excerpt: Position OverviewSolutions by Text (SBT) is seeking an Account Manager to own and grow a portfolio of existing customers with a primary mandate of revenue retention and a secondary mandate of account expansion through payments and new messaging use cases.
jobs.description:
Position Overview

Solutions by Text (SBT) is seeking an Account Manager to own and grow a portfolio of existing customers with a primary mandate of revenue retention and a secondary mandate of account expansion through payments and new messaging use cases.

This role is accountable for ensuring customers are operationally successful, commercially retained, and positioned to expand across SBT’s evolving product portfolio—including payments and non-collections use cases such as lifecycle marketing. The Account Manager will manage approximately 50 accounts, partnering closely with Customer Success to proactively manage risk, drive adoption, and deliver measurable revenue outcomes.

This position blends disciplined account management, data-driven expansion strategy, and cross-functional execution, and is critical to scaling SBT’s customer growth engine.

Key Responsibilities

Revenue Retention & Renewal Ownership (Primary Focus)

  • Own revenue retention for assigned accounts, with accountability for renewals, downsell prevention, and churn mitigation.
  • Proactively identify accounts at risk of contraction or churn using health signals, usage data, and Customer Success inputs.
  • Develop and execute retention action plans in partnership with Customer Success for at-risk accounts.
  • Lead renewal strategy, including pricing discussions, contract modifications, and value reinforcement tied to customer outcomes.
  • Maintain a rolling renewal forecast that clearly identifies:
    • Renewal timing
    • Expected outcome (flat, upsell, downsell)
    • Risk level and mitigation plan
    • Associated ARR impact

Account Growth & Expansion (Secondary Focus)

  • Execute structured account planning to identify expansion opportunities within existing customers.
  • Drive incremental ARR through:
    • Payments adoption and volume growth
    • Expansion into new messaging use cases, including lifecycle marketing and event-driven communications
  • Partner closely with the Payments team to:
    • Identify customers with payment traffic potential
    • Position and introduce SBT payments capabilities
    • Track payment adoption and revenue contribution
  • Translate customer business goals and usage patterns into concrete expansion proposals with clear ROI.
  • Maintain an expansion pipeline tied to account plans, renewal cycles, and customer maturity.

Customer Program Execution & Outcomes

  • Design and operationalize customer-specific programs that drive:
    • Product adoption
    • Usage growth
    • Event-driven revenue
  • Ensure customers are successfully launching and scaling new use cases in coordination with Customer Success.
  • Monitor program performance and adjust strategies based on results and customer feedback.
  • Act as the commercial owner of customer initiatives while Customer Success leads delivery and adoption.

Customer Success Partnership & Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Operate in tight alignment with Customer Success, with shared accountability for account health, retention, and growth.
  • Clearly delineate responsibilities:
    • Customer Success: adoption, onboarding, value realization
    • Account Manager: retention strategy, renewals, expansion, commercial outcomes
  • Collaborate effectively with Sales, Payments, Product, Marketing, Partnerships, and Finance to support customer objectives.
  • Ensure a seamless handoff and ongoing collaboration between Sales and post-sale teams.

Measurement, Forecasting & Process Excellence

  • Own accurate forecasting for renewals and expansion within assigned accounts.
  • Maintain high-quality CRM data, including:
    • Account health indicators
    • Renewal and expansion opportunities
    • Forecasted ARR
  • Track and report on key performance indicators tied to retention and growth.
  • Continuously improve account management processes to increase scalability, predictability, and customer impact.

Success Metrics

This role will be evaluated primarily on retention outcomes, followed by account growth and execution excellence.

Revenue & Customer Growth

  • Revenue Retention (GRR) for assigned accounts
  • Net Revenue Retention (NRR) contribution from expansion
  • Upsell and cross-sell ARR, with emphasis on:
    • Payments revenue
    • New messaging use cases
  • Organic new ARR growth
  • Event-driven revenue generated through customer programs

Account Management Performance

  • Renewal rate, retention rate and churn reduction
  • Accuracy of renewal and expansion forecasts
  • Health and coverage of renewal and expansion pipeline
  • Effectiveness of risk identification and mitigation plans

Operational & Program Effectiveness

  • Time-to-launch for new customer initiatives
  • Adoption and usage growth of new products and use cases
  • Consistency and scalability of account planning and execution.

Values Alignment

  • Serve as a trusted partner to customers and internal teams.
  • Embody SBT’s core values:
    • We Are Pioneers – proactively identifying new growth paths for customers
    • We Are Allies – deeply aligned with Customer Success and cross-functional partners
    • We Pursue Excellence – disciplined execution, accountability, and continuous improvement

Ideal candidate profile

  • 4-6 yrs Experience in a SaaS software company
  • 2-4 yrs Experience as an individual contributor with experience in sales, account management or customer success
  • Experience with retention, renewals, growing existing accounts
  • Experience (texting/payments/industry)
    • An individual with experience in texting or communications is strongly preferred
    • An individual with experience with payments capture and processing is preferred
    • An individual with experience in customer finance, lending, ARM and/or banking is preferred
  • Experience managing 20-30+ accounts simultaneously
  • Demonstrable evidence of success: Solid evidence of achievement against quota or KPIs for several years, including evidence of proactively creating expansion opportunities rather than only responding to inbound requests and identifying and mitigating account risk before it became visible to leadership
  • Administrative Capability
    • Ability to read and understand software contracts
    • Ability to understand and communicate several pricing models and options
    • Ability to lead structured pricing and contract negotiations that protect commercial outcomes without damaging trust
    • Ability to build and execute an account plan that prioritizes the highest-value opportunities and risks across a full portfolio, addressing multiple use cases within a business unit and/or additional business units
    • Ability to work effectively within Salesforce and other platforms
  • Attitudinal
    • Hungry, looking to grow into a sales role
    • Able to build relationships across multiple levels of a customer organization, including economic buyers and executives, not just a single day-to-day contact
    • Comfortable using usage, adoption, and outcome data to build a value narrative, rather than relying on relationship goodwill alone
    • Curiosity
    • Thick skin, as many customers are trying to get out of or change contracts
    • Good administrative skills – must document opportunities and closes effectively

What Will Set You Apart

The account managers who thrive in this role don’t just maintain their book; they treat it as a growth engine. A few things set them apart:

  • Own outcomes, not just relationships. You’re accountable for retention, renewal quality, adoption, and expansion together, and you don’t hand off a risk or an opportunity until it’s actually resolved.
  • See around corners. Rather than waiting for a customer to raise a need or a risk to become visible, you spot the signal early in usage data, in a stalled conversation, in a shift in the account and act on it before it becomes a renewal problem.
  • You build relationships that don’t depend on one person. You earn access to economic buyers and executives, not just their day-to-day champion, so a renewal or expansion conversation never stalls because one contact went quiet.
  • You make the business case, not just the ask. You can translate adoption data, ROI, and customer outcomes into a value story that holds up in a pricing or negotiation conversation and you do it without burning trust.
  • You run your portfolio like a business, not a to-do list. With roughly 50 accounts, you know which ones matter most this quarter and why, and operate on a proactive cadence rather than reacting to whatever surfaces first.

General Duties and Expectations

  • Adhere to the Company's Code of Conduct/Ethics.
  • Contribute to the professional culture within the office and the company
  • Project a professional and appropriate Company image in all dealings with clients, vendors, business partners and visitors.
  • Support the efforts of senior management and sales staff by maintaining business network of contacts as clients change roles and/or companies.
  • Ensure security of information in all matters pertaining to company, client, and consumer information.

About Solutions by Text

Solutions by Text (SBT) was founded with the mission to deliver impactful conversational messaging and convenient payment solutions. Built on wireless carrier industry best practices, SBT is the only compliance-first provider of enterprise texting solutions in the market. More than 1,400 consumer finance organizations, including leading brands in auto finance, banking and lending, trust SBT to ensure convenient, effective, and compliant relationships with their millions of consumers. SBT is headquartered in Dallas, TX with remote teams and offices throughout the United States.

Solutions By Text is committed to promoting the values of diversity and inclusion throughout the business. Whether it is through recruitment, retention, career progression or training and development, we are committed to improving opportunities for people regardless of their background or circumstances.

Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit .

Reddit is seeking an experienced, highly analytical International Payroll Lead to own and scale our global payroll operations across LATAM, EMEA, and APAC regions. As a key individual contributor with deep cross-functional influence, you will combine data-driven execution, meticulous attention to detail, and international tax compliance to support a rapidly growing workforce. Reporting to the Sr. Global Payroll Manager, this role will help to drive major strategic initiatives—including Workday enhancements and global payroll vendor implementations—to build scalable, best-in-class operational processes. The role partners closely with Payroll Vendors and internal teams across People, Finance, Tax, Legal, Treasury, Equity, and Internal Audit to deliver accurate, timely, compliant, and employee-centered payroll outcomes.

What You’ll Do:

  • Global Payroll Execution & Oversight:
    • Manage, audit, and execute multi-country payroll delivery across 15+ international countries, including payroll inputs, validation, approvals, funding coordination, reconciliations, statutory filings, and post-payroll activities ensure high accuracy and strict adherence to strict regional pay schedules.
    • Lead the payroll calendar and operating cadence across countries, proactively managing dependencies, cutoffs, exceptions, and risks to ensure employees are paid accurately and on time.
    • Partner with local in-country payroll providers to maintain strict adherence to regional pay schedules and statutory processing windows.
  • Compliance & Equity Management: Oversee global equity compensation payroll processing (RSUs, Stock Options) and ensure full regulatory compliance across international tax jurisdictions, localized statutory benefits, and reporting requirements.
  • Systems & Scaling Initiatives: Act as functional lead for payroll technology projects, leveraging Workday to automate workflows, optimize system configurations, build custom reporting, and partner with the Sr. Global payroll Manager to implement upcoming enterprise Global Payroll solutions.
  • Cross-Functional & Vendor Management: Partner with Benefits, People Operations, Legal, and Finance; manage external vendor relationships and third-party tax fulfillment partners to ensure seamless funds reconciliation and local tax compliance.
  • Process Controls: Establish, document, and enforce global payroll policies, SOX controls, and standard operating procedures to streamline audit readiness (401k, Workers’ Comp, Financial Audits).
  • Strategic Growth Projects: Support special business initiatives, including M&A integrations, new country market entries, and business-critical cross-functional launches.

What We’re Looking For:

  • Experience: 5–7+ years of progressive payroll operations experience in a high-growth, publicly traded tech company with a global footprint.
  • Education : Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience in payroll, accounting, finance, human resources, or a related field.
  • Systems Expertise: Advanced proficiency with Workday Payroll (reporting, configuration, integrations) and global payroll software platforms.
  • Technical & Analytical Skills: Advanced proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets (vlookups, index/match, pivot tables) for complex data analysis, reconciliation, and audit modeling.
  • Domain Expertise: Thorough understanding of global equity taxation, statutory compliance, international labor laws, and multi-currency payroll distribution.
  • Execution & Soft Skills: Strong problem-solving capabilities, high discretion handling confidential data, and exceptional communication skills to collaborate seamlessly across teams.

Bonus Points

  • Responding to internal, external, statutory, and financial audit requests, including preparation of reconciliations, control evidence, and supporting documentation.
  • Applying automation or AI tools to payroll operations, analytics, controls, case management, or knowledge documentation.
  • Providing high-quality customer service to employees and business partners across regions, cultures, and time zones.
  • Working in a publicly traded, technology, or high-growth company and supporting international expansion or payroll transformation.

How Success Will Be Measured

  • Operational Excellence: Accurate, timely, and compliant payroll delivery across the international footprint.
  • Audit & Governance: Strong controls, clean reconciliations, and audit-ready documentation.
  • Vendor Management: Reliable vendor performance and effective resolution of payroll issues.
  • Scalability: Scalable processes, improved automation, and clear country-level operating documentation.
  • Stakeholder Satisfaction: Trusted partnerships and a responsive, employee-centered service experience.

Benefits:

  • Comprehensive Healthcare Benefits and Income Replacement Programs
  • 401k with Employer Match
  • Global Benefit programs that fit your lifestyle, from workspace to professional development to caregiving support
  • Family Planning Support
  • Gender-Affirming Care
  • Mental Health & Coaching Benefits
  • Flexible Vacation & Paid Volunteer Time Off
  • Generous Paid Parental Leave

Pay Transparency:

This job posting may span more than one career level.

In addition to base salary, this job is eligible to receive equity in the form of restricted stock units, and depending on the position offered, it may also be eligible to receive a commission. Additionally, Reddit offers a wide range of benefits to U.S.-based employees, including medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k) program with employer match, generous time off for vacation, and parental leave. Overview

BerryDunn is seeking a Medicaid Policy Director to join our Medicaid consulting team. As part of our consulting team focused on state Medicaid agencies, you will leverage your state and federal Medicaid policy expertise to help Medicaid agencies implement new programs and administer their program. You will be the success partner for Medicaid agencies in building healthier communities and stronger futures.

You will work remotely, hybrid, or in one of our offices, helping clients nationally. You will report to and partner with management team members in our Medicaid team for both client work and career development. With a growth mindset, you will share your Medicaid expertise with those around you to help drive their development while also continuing to develop your own professional goals.

Travel Expectations: Travel to client sites can range up to 50%

You Will

  • Help clients implement new programs and manage their compliance with federal requirements by: analyzing, documenting, and presenting analysis to clients; planning for and implementing new guidance and programs; preparing applications for grants and additional funding opportunities
  • Partner with the team to share your Medicaid expertise while supporting client needs and also helping the team grow and develop in their knowledge of Medicaid
  • Engage in marketing and business development by applying your Medicaid policy expertise to the development and review of content and budgets, including the review of and feedback on content created by others in a way that supports the development of the full team

You Have

  • 15 plus years of professional experience, 10 years of which was in Medicaid, at least 4 years of which was in a state Medicaid agency with progressive leadership responsibility, or the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS)
  • Experience analyzing regulations and sub-regulatory guidance to inform the direction of the program along with managing projects and initiatives to implement program changes to comply with the regulation
  • Experience working with most Medicaid payment authorities such as waivers and the state plan
  • Experience successfully navigating the dynamics of the interests of all parties that are involved in the Medicaid program, for example members, providers, health plans, and federal partners
  • Ability to translate complex claims and billing requirements into actionable business, policy, and technical recommendations for clients.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication and team skills

Compensation Details

The base salary range targeted for this role is $160,000 - $180,000. This salary range represents BerryDunn’s good faith and reasonable estimate of the range of possible compensation at the time of posting. The salary of the finalist selected for this role will be based on a variety of factors, including but not limited to, years of experience, depth of experience, seniority, merit, education, training, amount of travel, and other relevant business considerations.

jobs.title: Experienced Consultant - Operational Planning / Production Planning with SAP
jobs.excerpt: Wir sind Skandinaviens erfolgreichste Unternehmensberatung mit mehr als 1800 Berater:innen und einer expandierenden Basis in Deutschland.
jobs.description:
Wir sind Skandinaviens erfolgreichste Unternehmensberatung mit mehr als 1800 Berater:innen und einer expandierenden Basis in Deutschland. Nach anhaltend starkem Wachstum in Dänemark, Schweden, Norwegen und der Schweiz bauen wir unsere Präsenz in Deutschland mit einem Büro in München und Hamburg weiter aus.

Wir unterstützen Menschen und Organisationen, sich den Herausforderungen der Zukunft zu stellen, und begleiten sie bei ihren Veränderungsprozessen. Um die bestmöglichen Ergebnisse zu erreichen, kombinieren wir analytisches Denken und intuitives Verständnis. Wir verknüpfen die neuesten Theorien mit Sensibilität für Menschen und Organisations-Dynamik. Nicht zuletzt beziehen wir aktiv die Menschen mit ein, die in die Veränderungsprozesse involviert sind – wir nennen das Collaborative Consulting. Seit mehr als 20 Jahren sind wir erfolgreich darin, mit unserem Ansatz positive Veränderungen zu schaffen.

Für unser Planning Excellence Team in Deutschland suchen wir neue Kolleg:innen (m/w/d) mit Erfahrung als Supply Chain Manager, Business Architect oder Solution Architect, die uns helfen, unsere Kunden fit für die Zukunft zu machen.

Der Inhalt Deiner Aufgaben variiert, umfasst jedoch im Wesentlichen Folgendes:

Wir suchen derzeit einen leidenschaftlichen und erfahrenen Operational Planning Consultant (m/w/d) mit Schwerpunkt SAP, der unser Team verstärkt. In dieser Rolle nutzen Sie Ihre Expertise in SAP Production Planning and Detailed Scheduling (PPDS) und Advanced ATP (aATP), um Lösungen zu entwerfen und umzusetzen, die die operative Exzellenz unserer Kunden vorantreiben. Sie spielen eine entscheidende Rolle bei der Gestaltung von Produktionsplanungsstrategien, der Optimierung von Planungsprozessen und der Verbesserung der Wettbewerbsfähigkeit unserer Kunden auf dem Markt.

Wir sind auf der Suche nach Menschen, die

  • Leitung und Management von SAP PP/DS Implementierungsprojekten und Sicherstellung einer erfolgreichen Durchführung und Kundenzufriedenheit.
  • Analyse der Produktionsplanungsprozesse der Kunden und Identifizierung von Optimierungsmöglichkeiten durch SAP PP/DS.
  • Entwicklung und Konfiguration von SAP PP/DS-Lösungen, die speziell auf die Bedürfnisse und Ziele unserer Kunden zugeschnitten sind.
  • Fachkundige Beratung zur Integration mit anderen SAP-Modulen (z.B. SAP IBP, SAP aATP).
  • Durchführung von Workshops und Schulungen, um die Teams der Kunden in der operativen Planung mit SAP weiterzubilden.
  • Zusammenarbeit mit den Interessengruppen zur Definition des Projektumfangs, der Ziele und der Ergebnisse.
  • Aktuelle Informationen über Branchentrends und Verbesserungen in SAP S/4HANA, um das Wissen über SAP-Lösungsangebote kontinuierlich zu erweitern.

Das bieten wir Dir:
Die Implement Consulting Group bietet einen hohen Grad an Gestaltungsfreiheit, mit gegenseitiger Verantwortung und Unterstützung zur kontinuierlichen Entwicklung unserer Fähigkeiten, um mit unseren Klienten herausragende Ergebnisse zu erzielen. Wir sind stolz auf unsere einzigartige Unternehmenskultur und unser Netzwerk von hochqualifizierten, leistungs- und hilfsbereiten Kollegen. Gemeinsam haben wir das Ziel, durch „Change with Impact“ die Welt der Beratung zu verändern.

Wir bieten zudem attraktive, leistungsbezogene Gehaltspakete und exzellente Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten.

Haben wir Dein Interesse geweckt, dann sende uns Deinen CV auf Englisch oder auf Deutsch zu.

We want to be the best place for the best people within Management Consultancy by being a powerhouse of expertise and energy.

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager
jobs.excerpt: The Customer Success Manager (CSM) serves as the strategic owner of the post-sale customer journey for Kleio, ensuring customers achieve measurable business outcomes through successful onboarding, adoption, value realization, renewal, and expansion.
jobs.description:
The Customer Success Manager (CSM) serves as the strategic owner of the post-sale customer journey for Kleio, ensuring customers achieve measurable business outcomes through successful onboarding, adoption, value realization, renewal, and expansion. Acting as the trusted advisor to customer stakeholders, the CSM partners closely with Sales, Product, Implementation, Engineering, and Support teams to accelerate time-to-value, drive platform adoption, monitor customer health, and identify growth opportunities. This role is responsible for transforming customer engagement into long-term recurring revenue by increasing retention, expanding usage across departments and use cases, generating customer advocacy, and delivering actionable product feedback that helps shape the future roadmap of Kleio.

Position Summary

Kofile is seeking an experienced and customer-focused Customer Success Manager (CSM) to lead customer adoption, retention, and growth for Kleio, Kofile's AI-powered document intelligence and engagement platform.

The Customer Success Manager owns the post-sale customer lifecycle—from onboarding and implementation through adoption, renewal, and expansion. This individual serves as a trusted advisor to customers, helping them achieve strategic business outcomes while maximizing the value realized from Kleio. The role collaborates closely with Sales, Product Management, Engineering, Professional Services, Support, and Customer Operations teams to drive measurable customer success and long-term recurring revenue growth.

The ideal candidate combines SaaS customer success expertise, strong executive communication skills, consultative problem solving, and a passion for helping customers succeed with AI-powered technologies. The role is expected to leverage customer onboarding programs, adoption scorecards, usage monitoring, business reviews, and customer success metrics to drive outcomes.

Key Responsibilities

Customer Onboarding & Adoption

  • Own the customer journey from implementation through ongoing adoption.

  • Support onboarding activities to accelerate time-to-value.

  • Develop customer success plans aligned to customer business goals and desired outcomes.

  • Deliver customer enablement, training, and adoption programs.

  • Monitor platform utilization, engagement, and adoption trends.

  • Drive adoption of new Kleio capabilities, AI features, and platform releases.

Customer Health & Retention

  • Build executive-level relationships with customer stakeholders.

  • Conduct Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) and success reviews.

  • Monitor customer health scores and renewal readiness.

  • Identify adoption risks and proactively execute mitigation plans.

  • Manage escalations and coordinate resolution across internal teams.

  • Drive customer satisfaction and long-term retention.

Growth & Expansion

  • Identify opportunities to expand Kleio usage across departments, users, and business units.

  • Partner with Sales teams on account growth strategies.

  • Support cross-sell and upsell initiatives.

  • Develop account expansion recommendations based on customer needs and usage patterns.

AI Value Realization

  • Help customers quantify and communicate business value achieved through Kleio.

  • Demonstrate operational efficiencies and productivity improvements.

  • Drive adoption of AI-powered search and interaction

  • Promote best practices for AI-enabled information management and knowledge discovery.

  • Ensure customers recognize measurable outcomes tied to their investment.

Product Feedback & Customer Advocacy

  • Collect customer feedback and communicate insights to Product Management.

  • Identify opportunities for customer references, testimonials, and case studies.

  • Support customer advisory programs and roadmap discussions.

  • Advocate for customer needs and priorities across the organization.

  • Contribute strategic input that informs future product direction.

Experience

  • 5+ years of Customer Success, SaaS Account Management, Professional Services, Consulting, or related experience.

  • Proven success managing enterprise customer relationships.

  • Demonstrated experience driving software adoption, renewals, and account expansion.

  • Experience conducting executive business reviews and strategic customer conversations.

  • Familiarity with SaaS subscription business models and recurring revenue metrics.

Skills

  • Exceptional relationship-building and communication skills.

  • Strong executive presentation and storytelling abilities.

  • Strategic thinking and consultative problem-solving.

  • Data-driven decision-making using usage and customer health metrics.

  • Ability to manage multiple accounts and priorities simultaneously.

  • Experience working cross-functionally across Sales, Product, Engineering, and Support.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with AI-powered software platforms.

  • Experience with AWS Cloud Services and Amazon Bedrock Suite is highly desirable.

  • Experience in GovTech, records management, archives, libraries, museums, or information management solutions.

  • Familiarity with enterprise search, metadata management, content services, or document intelligence platforms.

  • Experience supporting public sector and regulated industry customers.

  • Understanding of digital transformation and SaaS adoption programs.

Why This Role Matters

Customer Success is the operating system that transforms Kleio from a software sale into a long-term customer partnership. This role protects recurring revenue, accelerates adoption, expands customer value, strengthens customer advocacy, provides strategic input to product development, and creates a scalable foundation for long-term SaaS growth. Ultimately, the Customer Success Manager helps maximize customer lifetime value while driving sustainable revenue growth, increased Net Revenue Retention, and long-term enterprise value creation for Kleio.

Benefits:

As a full-time employee, you will receive access to the following benefits

  • Leadership and career development opportunities
  • Low cost insurance (medical, dental, vision, life & disability)
  • 401(k) plan (company matching)
  • Paid holidays
  • PTO
  • Paid maternity & paternity leave
  • Educational assistance
  • Business casual environment

At Kofile, we believe that government has infinite potential to do good and that all information residing within local governments should be preserved, digitized, and made available to all their employees and citizens. We partner with government agencies nationwide to help them meet their citizens’ needs by preserving the integrity and content of paper documents to ensure they will be available for use forever and modernizing information management through digitization and access systems.

Kofile has been a market leader in serving local governments for the last 10 years. We help local governments modernize operations and improve citizen access and engagement. Our solutions include a full suite of premium and software for record retention and recording applications. The company and its culture are built entirely around putting customers first. Our 3,000+ customers cover nearly half of the U.S. population, and customer loyalty is unsurpassed in the industry.

jobs.title: Network Engineer
jobs.excerpt: Woodard & Curran is an employee-owned engineering, science, and operations firm dedicated to clean water, a safe environment, healthy communities, and happy people.
jobs.description:
Woodard & Curran is an employee-owned engineering, science, and operations firm dedicated to clean water, a safe environment, healthy communities, and happy people. We foster an inclusive, collaborative culture that supports professional growth, flexibility, and meaningful work, empowering our employees to make a lasting impact on our clients, communities, and the planet.

Who are we looking for?

Woodard & Curran draws on the experience of hundreds of certified operators across the country, backed by the knowledge and skills of hundreds more engineers, scientists, and regulatory experts, to quickly tackle the most challenging operational issues and keep water and wastewater treatment plants running efficiently and in full compliance.  Woodard & Curran also aids employees in earning, upgrading, and keeping their certifications within the industry.

As our Operations & Management Strategic Business Unit (O&M SBU) grows, we are looking to add a new member to our technology team! The O&M Network Engineer is responsible for the design, implementation, installation, and maintenance of network infrastructure supporting remote locations across the United States, both remotely and on-site. This role ensures the reliable operation of network hardware, rapidly diagnoses and resolves technical issues, and protects both IT and OT environments through effective cybersecurity practices. The O&M Network Engineer maintains accurate documentation of network configurations, system changes, and issue resolutions to support operational transparency, continuity, and knowledge sharing. Additionally, the position contributes to the development of innovative solutions that improve the efficiency, reliability, and scalability of the O&M network infrastructure. Serving as a trusted technical advisor, the engineer communicates complex technical information clearly and effectively to O&M project teams and management. Above all, the role maintains a strong commitment to site safety and safe work practices.

The location for this role is flexible, and we are open to remote employment with the ability to travel as needed to our facilities across the country. Travel will vary between car and airline based on your location in relation to our projects. We anticipate up to 50% travel in this role. The travel requirements will fluctuate depending on project and client needs.

What will you be doing at Woodard & Curran?

    • Design, configure, implement, install, monitor and maintain LAN, WAN, and WLAN infrastructure with a focus on cybersecurity and safety and operational efficiency in an O&M plant environment, ensuring network safety and performance.

    • Maintain and optimize networking systems applying in-depth technical knowledge to ensure efficient, secure, and reliable network performance.

    • Implement and enforce cybersecurity principles and best practices, with a focus on protecting networks and systems while ensuring compliance with organizational standards.

    • Monitor traditional, cellular and satellite network performance, capacity and security, identify potential issues, and provide solutions to ensure networks are operating efficiently.

    • Troubleshoot and resolve complex network issues.

    • Maintain and update network documentation, diagrams, and procedures

    • Configure and implement networking technologies, including routing, switching, firewalls, VPNs and security protocols.

    • Communicate technical information in an easily understandable way to non-technical employees.

    • Update the IT ticketing and project management system with detailed notes regarding assigned tasks/resolutions.

    • Collaborate with other IT teams, vendors, ISPs and stakeholders to ensure network solutions meet business needs.

    • Keep abreast of the latest networking technologies/best practices, security, and trends.

    • May be involved in disaster recovery planning and implementation.

    • May participate in vendor selection and evaluation.

What will you need to succeed?

    • BS degree in Computer Science or equivalent.

    • A minimum of 5 years of hands-on network engineer experience.

    • Cisco Certified Network Associate (CCNA) or Cisco Certified Network Professional (CCNP) required.

    • Deep understanding of networking protocols (e.g., IPSEC, HSRP, BGP, OSPF, 802.11, QoS) and the OSI/TCP-IP models, hardware (Cisco, Pal Alto, Cradlepoint, Starlink, etc.) and network management/monitoring tools (Solar Winds, Wireshark, etc.).

    • In-depth understanding and practical knowledge of networking systems and hardware such as LAN, firewalls, routers, switches, access points, cybersecurity and principles and practices related to site safety.

    • Strong knowledge and understanding of cellular and satellite devices.  

    • Excellent time management, communication, troubleshooting, problem-solving skills and ability to work independently and in team environment.  

    • Ability to travel as needed for onsite network support.  Up to 50%.

    • Ability to work after hours, weekends, and holidays if necessary.

    • Cisco Certified Internetwork Expert (CCIE) and/or Certified IS Security Professional (CISSP) highly preferred.

    • Successful candidates will be required to complete a pre-placement background check, drug screen, and physical in order to complete the offer process.

Why would you choose Woodard & Curran?

    • You would be offered a generous total rewards package:

    • Competitive compensation.

    • Excellent Benefits to include retirement, generous paid time off, holidays, medical & dental insurance, flexible spending account.

    • Career growth.

    • Support and reimbursement in earning, upgrading, and keeping your licenses and certifications within the industry. Bonus potential for obtaining next level licensure.

Woodard & Curran offers a comprehensive benefits package. For more information about our benefits & workplace policies visit Benefit & Policy Information - Woodard & Curran.

Our no-code platform delivers the fastest time to market, lowest total cost of ownership, and simple, scalable management of AI agents for any CX use case. Netomi is seeking a Principal Customer Architect — the senior-most technical individual contributor in our Customer Engineering organization. You will own the technical arc of the accounts where the stakes are highest — first-of-kind deployments, peak-event scale, regulated industries — and set the architecture, governance, and quality standards the entire Customer Architect function operates by.

Getting an AI agent live is no longer the hard part. The hard part is what comes after the pilot: expanding from one use case to twenty, holding quality as policies and systems change underneath you, proving containment and CSAT to a CIO, and earning the right to the next set of journeys. Solving that repeatably, across every account, is the job. The Principal Customer Architect is where the hardest versions of that problem land — and where the patterns that solve them for everyone else get written.

You are deeply credible in a design review — able to read an execution trace, reason about why an agent chose the wrong tool, and design guardrails and evaluation strategy. You set the architecture and own quality sign-off; our Agentic Deployment team executes. Your leverage comes from architecture, judgment, and the standards you set for others: the reference architectures, evaluation frameworks, and playbooks the function deploys from. The operating principle: make deployments prescriptive and repeatable, not bespoke.

Responsibilities:

    Account Architecture:

  • Design the end-to-end agent architecture across the customer's journeys and channels — chat, email, voice, SMS, in-app — including agent decomposition, escalation and handoff design, and how autonomous and human-in-the-loop modes divide the work.
  • Design the integration blueprint against the customer's real stack: CRM and ticketing (Salesforce, Zendesk, ServiceNow), telephony and contact center, identity, loyalty and reservations systems, order and payments, and data platform.
  • Set the guardrail, governance, and observability architecture: define what the agent must never do, how that is enforced, how it is audited, and what the customer's compliance and risk teams see.
  • Set the architecture and governance standard the Agentic Deployment team executes against, and own quality sign-off before anything reaches production.

    • Technical Success Planning:

  • Author and maintain a Technical Success Plan per account: current-state architecture, target-state architecture, the sequenced roadmap between them, and the metrics defining success at each stage.
  • Define the measurement model with the customer up front — containment, resolution rate, CSAT/DSAT, deflection economics, handle time, escalation quality, cost per resolution — and hold both sides to it.
  • Run a recurring technical business review with customer leadership: what shipped, what it moved, what's next, and what's at risk.

    • Adoption & Technical Expansion:

  • Own the technical expansion path for land-and-expand: chat to email to voice to employee-facing, plus new intents, lines of business, regions, and languages.
  • Identify expansion opportunities from technical reality rather than wishful mapping, size the work honestly, and hand qualified opportunity to the account team.
  • Anticipate what breaks at the next order of magnitude — peak-event volume, new policy regimes, upstream system migrations — and get ahead of it in the roadmap.

    • Trusted Technical Advisor:

  • Hold the primary technical relationship with senior stakeholders: VP/Head of Customer Experience, Director of Contact Center Technology, enterprise architects, security and compliance leadership, and often the CIO.
  • Advise on the parts of the program Netomi doesn't own — knowledge base quality, policy clarity, agent operating model, org readiness — because agent performance depends on all of it.
  • Deliver hard technical news early and clearly. Credibility is built on accurate expectation-setting, not optimism.

    • Partner Co-Delivery:

  • Set the architecture and quality standard that SI delivery partners build against.
  • Certify and enable partner delivery teams; scale through them rather than absorbing all delivery work.
  • Maintain quality sign-off regardless of who executes.

    • Prescriptive Playbooks:

  • Contribute to vertical deployment blueprints — airline, insurance, gaming, media — covering reference architecture, guardrail configuration, evaluation packs, and expansion paths.
  • Turn what works in one account into prescriptive onboarding and day-2 playbooks the whole organization deploys from.

    • Product Collaboration:

  • Translate field observation into specific, evidenced, pattern-based product input — quantified, not anecdotal.
  • Be a named internal voice on enterprise requirements: security posture, deployment topology, model flexibility, and auditability.

    • Escalation & Incident Response:

  • Lead the technical side of escalations: quality regressions, integration failures, and incidents during peak events.
  • Drive root-cause analysis with Engineering and communicate it to the customer with precision and appropriate accountability.

    • Function-Level Technical Leadership:

  • Define and own the architecture, governance, and quality standards for the Customer Architect function: reference architectures, guardrail patterns, evaluation frameworks, and sign-off criteria.
  • Own the hardest technical problems in the portfolio — first-of-kind deployments, peak-event scale, novel compliance regimes — and convert their solutions into function-wide standards.
  • Mentor Senior and staff-level Customer Architects; act as the escalation point for architecture decisions across accounts.
  • Represent Customer Engineering's technical position to executive leadership, Product, and Engineering, and shape platform direction based on aggregate field evidence.

Requirements:

  • 12+ years in customer-facing technical roles — solutions architecture, technical account management, forward-deployed engineering, implementation architecture, or technical consulting — including sustained ownership of post-sales technical outcomes.
  • Recognized technical authority at prior companies: the architect others escalated to, with demonstrated ownership of the largest and most complex enterprise accounts at Fortune 500 scale.
  • Genuine technical depth: reads code and API documentation, reasons about distributed systems and integration architecture, debugs a failing data flow, and holds their own with a customer's principal engineer.
  • Working understanding of LLM-based systems — prompting, tool use, retrieval, evaluation, guardrails, failure modes — and judgment about where they are and aren't the right answer.
  • Consultative and prescriptive: builds playbooks, not one-offs.
  • Moves between a CIO conversation about business outcomes and an engineering conversation about trace-level agent behavior without losing either audience.
  • Comfort with ambiguity and a bias toward writing things down.
  • Track record defining architecture standards, methodologies, or playbooks adopted beyond your own accounts — at practice, function, or company level.
  • Experience influencing product direction at an enterprise software company through structured, evidenced field input.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience co-delivering through SI partners — enabling delivery teams rather than doing all the work directly.
  • CX, contact center, or conversational AI background — CCaaS, CRM/ticketing ecosystems, IVR and voice, workforce management.
  • Depth in a core vertical: airlines and travel, media and streaming, gaming and sports betting, financial services and insurance, or retail.
  • Familiarity with enterprise security and compliance — SOC 2, HIPAA, GDPR, PCI, ISO 27001 — without escalating to Legal for every question.
  • Experience designing evaluation frameworks or quality programs for non-deterministic systems.

Location: Remote UK/Euro
Reporting line: Chief Risk Officer

About Auros

Auros is a global digital asset liquidity provider operating 24/7 across centralised and decentralised markets. We run high-availability, low-latency systems where resilience and risk discipline matter. Security is treated as a core engineering and risk function, with direct engagement from senior leadership.

The Role

We're hiring a hands-on principal security engineer to implement and operate security controls across our infrastructure. This is a technical execution role where you'll be writing code, configuring systems, and shipping security improvements, not writing policies or managing people.

You'll work closely with Infrastructure and Engineering teams to harden our cloud environments, secure our CI/CD pipelines, and protect both corporate and production systems. The scope is broad, the environment is fast-paced, and you'll be expected to own problems end-to-end.

We believe security should enable the business, not obstruct it. You'll design controls that are effective but unobtrusive, security that works in the background without creating friction for engineers or traders.

What You'll Do

  • Implement and maintain security controls across multi-cloud environments (primarily AWS and Azure, with some GCP and AliCloud) and on-prem infrastructure
  • Own IAM strategy and implementation: design and enforce identity, access, and permissions models that are secure, scalable, and practical
  • Design and operate key management and custody security controls such as HSMs, secrets management, and secure key handling for trading operations

  • Juris Doctor from an ABA-accredited law school

  • 5+ years of experience practicing at a law firm and/or in-house
  • Substantive experience reviewing advertising and promotional claims, ideally for FDA-regulated products (drugs, devices, cosmetics, or dietary supplements)
  • Working knowledge of FDA and FTC advertising and promotion requirements and claim substantiation standards
  • Ability to make sound, practical judgments quickly in a dynamic, fast-paced environment with shifting priorities
  • Excellent communication and relationship-building skills with cross-functional partners

jobs.description:
About Reunion Marketing

Reunion Marketing is a dynamic and forward-thinking agency specializing in digital marketing for the Automotive industry. We drive success through data-driven strategies and innovative campaign management. Join our team of passionate professionals committed to delivering measurable results for our Automotive Clients.

About the Role

This is not a traditional SEO role.

We’re looking for a highly capable Senior SEO & Content Strategist who thrives at the intersection of SEO, AI-assisted content production, technical execution, and operational ownership. This is a hands-on role for someone who doesn’t just create strategy decks—they execute.

You’ll own organic search execution across a portfolio of clients, taking projects from idea to publish with minimal oversight. One hour you may be diagnosing ranking declines, the next you’re refining AI-generated content, building pages in a CMS, writing schema markup, or optimizing production workflows.

If you enjoy autonomy, solving problems quickly, and building efficient systems in fast-moving environments, you’ll fit right in.

What You’ll Be Doing

Own SEO Execution from Start to Finish

You’ll manage and execute organic search initiatives across multiple client accounts—balancing strategy, production, technical SEO, and delivery.

Lead AI-Assisted Content Production

  • Create and refine SEO-driven content using tools like ChatGPT, Gemini, and Jasper
  • Build scalable workflows that improve production speed without compromising quality
  • Evaluate AI output critically for accuracy, SEO value, and brand alignment
  • Produce location pages, service pages, blogs, and ad hoc SEO projects at scale

Build & Publish Pages Yourself

  • Work directly inside CMS platforms to build and launch pages
  • Use HTML and CSS to improve structure, readability, UX, and layout quality
  • Implement metadata, internal linking, schema, and on-page SEO best practices during production—not after the fact

Drive Operational Excellence

  • Own SEO production scheduling and workflow coordination
  • Monitor errors, identify bottlenecks, and proactively solve issues before they impact performance
  • Keep projects moving in a high-volume, deadline-driven environment

Collaborate Across Teams

  • Partner closely with SEO leadership, paid media, social, and operations teams
  • Step in as backup support for SEO leadership when needed
  • Help align organic initiatives with broader marketing and client growth strategies

What You Bring

You’re someone who can think strategically while still enjoying the execution side of the work. You’re resourceful, highly organized, and comfortable owning outcomes independently.

Required Experience

  • 4–6+ years of hands-on SEO execution experience (agency or in-house)
  • Proven experience writing SEO-focused content using AI tools like ChatGPT, Gemini, or Jasper
  • Experience building and publishing pages across CMS platforms
  • Strong track record improving rankings, traffic, conversions, or other organic KPIs

Technical & Analytical Skills

  • Strong technical SEO knowledge including indexing, crawlability, schema, and page experience
  • Working proficiency in HTML and CSS
  • Strong familiarity with Google Search Console, GA4, SEMRush, and Sheets/Excel
  • Ability to structure prompts and build AI-assisted workflows effectively
  • Confidence analyzing performance data and translating insights into action

You’ll Excel in This Role If You…

  • Prefer ownership over micromanagement
  • Can move quickly without sacrificing quality
  • Enjoy solving messy operational or technical problems
  • Think beyond templates and standard processes
  • Are naturally proactive and identify risks before they become issues
  • Like building systems that make work smarter and faster

What Success Looks Like

  • Content and pages ship on time and at a high quality standard
  • SEO production runs smoothly and efficiently
  • AI workflows create measurable efficiency gains
  • Organic performance improves consistently across client portfolios
  • Leadership and teammates trust you to own projects independently

Work Environment

  • Fully remote/home office environment
  • Fast-paced, collaborative, high-accountability culture
  • Lean team structure where individual contribution matters

Why This Role Is Different

Most SEO roles separate strategy, content, technical execution, and production into different teams.

This one doesn’t.

You’ll have the opportunity to operate as a true end-to-end SEO strategist and builder—leveraging AI, technical skill, and operational ownership to drive measurable impact for clients.

If that sounds energizing rather than overwhelming, we’d like to talk.

Our values guide how we support customers, collaborate with colleagues, develop products, and foster a culture of belonging. They define not just our actions, but what it means to be Dutonian.

  • Flexible work arrangements
  • Company equity*

  • Retirement or pension plan*
  • Generous paid vacation time
  • Paid holidays and sick leave

  • Company-wide hack weeks
  • Mental wellness programs

About PagerDuty

PagerDuty, Inc. (NYSE:PD) is a global leader in digital operations management. The PagerDuty Operations Cloud is an AI-powered platform that empowers business resilience and drives operational efficiency for enterprises. With a generative AI assistant at its core, PagerDuty empowers teams to detect and resolve issues in real time, orchestrate complex workflows, and drive continuous improvement across their digital operations. Trusted by nearly half of both the Fortune 500 and the Forbes AI 50, as well as approximately two-thirds of the Fortune 100, PagerDuty is essential for delivering always-on digital experiences to modern businesses

PagerDuty is Great Place to Work-certified™, a Fortune Best Workplace for Millennials, a Fortune Best Medium Workplace, a Fortune Best Workplace in Technology, and a top rated product on TrustRadius and G2.

Go behind-the-scenes on our careers site and @pagerduty on Instagram.

About Valiantys

Here at Valiantys, we are one of the world’s largest Atlassian partners, helping organizations work better through scalable, people-centered solutions. As an Atlassian Platinum Solution Partner with a global footprint, we support customers across industries as they adopt ITSM, Agile at Scale, and modern work management practices.
Our teams work at the intersection of strategy and delivery, partnering closely with customers to translate complex business challenges into clear, actionable solutions built on best practices and leading platforms.

Join Valiantys and be part of something extraordinary!

Job summary

Valiantys is looking for a Director, AI-Enabled DevOpsTransformation to drive sales and growth across a portfolio of Valiantys' strategic and enterprise accounts. They will act as a trusted advisor to CIOs, CTOs, CISOs, VPs of Engineering, and Platform leaders — translating their business goals into multi-year transformation roadmaps spanning SDLC modernization, AI-enabled delivery, DevOps architecture, and cloud infrastructure. They will own new logo acquisition and existing account expansion, facilitate executive alignment and value realization, and lead pursuit and delivery consultants to win and execute high-impact engagements.

What you’ll be working on

    • Own executive relationships across a portfolio of strategic enterprise accounts; serve as the single point of accountability for client outcomes, satisfaction, and growth.

    • Co-develop and execute account strategies that expand Valiantys' footprint across SDLC tooling (Atlassian, GitHub/GitLab), AI-enabled delivery, DevOps, and cloud infrastructure.

    • Lead solutioning for complex pursuits — partnering internally to scope DevOps, platform engineering, and AI-augmented SDLC engagements.

    • Shape and communicate target architectures spanning CI/CD, security, compliance, resilience, and AI copilots integrated into the delivery lifecycle.

    • Govern delivery quality in partnership with engagement managers; intervene on escalations and ensure architectural integrity.

    • Represent Valiantys in executive briefings, QBRs, industry events, and joint go-to-market activities.

    • Mentor consultants and architects, contributing to Valiantys' practice development in AI-enabled SDLC and DevOps.

      • Do you have what it takes to be our new Director, AI-Enabled DevOpsTransformation?

      • 10+ years in consulting, professional services, or enterprise technology roles, with at least 5 years in client-facing leadership (Client Partner, Engagement Director, or equivalent).

      • SDLC expertise: proven track record modernizing software delivery lifecycles — requirements, source control, CI/CD, test automation, release management, and value stream metrics.

      • AI-enabled delivery: demonstrated experience embedding AI/LLM capabilities (e.g., code assistants, agentic workflows, AI-driven testing, intelligent ITSM) into enterprise SDLC and DevOps practices.

      • DevOps Solution Architect background: hands-on or architectural depth in CI/CD pipelines, GitOps, container platforms (Kubernetes/EKS), IaC (Terraform, CloudFormation), and observability tooling.

      • Infrastructure expertise: strong foundation in cloud and platform infrastructure — networking, identity, security, scalability, and reliability engineering at enterprise scale.

      • AWS credentials: active AWS certification — minimum AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Professional or AWS Certified DevOps Engineer – Professional or equivalent in Azure or GCP.

      • Demonstrated ability to lead multi-million-dollar account portfolios and complex pursuits.

      • Excellent executive communication, commercial acumen, and consultative selling skills.

      • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field; advanced degree a plus.

      Preferred Qualifications

      • Experience within the Atlassian ecosystem (Jira, Jira Service Management, Confluence, Rovo).

      • Additional preferred certifications: Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA), ITIL, SAFe, HashiCorp Cloud Engineer.

      • Experience scaling AI platform capabilities (RAG, MCP, agent orchestration) in regulated industries.

      • Experience with or exposure to AWS industry specializations

      • Established network within AWS partner organizations and joint GTM motions.

      • Prior P&L ownership in a consulting or systems integrator environment.

        • Location: This role can be located in Canada or in the United States. We offer flexible remote working policy.

Why you should apply ?

Our team members are our greatest asset and we work hard to ensure that Valiantys is not only a great place to work, but also a platform for you to grow.

Sense. We're committed to giving you the level of information you need to make sense of your assignments. You will witness the impact of your actions.

Training. We will provide you with the necessary time and budget to help you develop your skills and continue to build your career.

Flexibility. We understand that life is all about balance and we offer you the flexibility and support to help you maintain balance across the different pillars of your life.

What we offer - Employee Perks & Benefits

  • Competitive compensation with an annual performance-based bonus
  • Comprehensive Health Insurance401(k) with Company Match
  • Generous Paid Time Off (PTO) - 4 weeks per year, plus public holidays
  • A flexible remote work policy
  • A multicultural and international team environment
To qualify, applicants must be legally authorized to work in Canada or the United States and should not require, now or in the future, sponsorship for employment visa status.

Valiantys is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status or any other characteristic protected by law. Valiantys provides a barrier-free workplace and embraces all qualified applicants with varied perspectives and backgrounds.

jobs.title: Channel Marketing Manager
jobs.excerpt: About UsSophos is a cybersecurity leader defending 600,000 organizations globally with an AI-driven platform and expert-led services.
jobs.description:
About Us

Sophos is a cybersecurity leader defending 600,000 organizations globally with an AI-driven platform and expert-led services. Sophos meets organizations wherever they are in their security maturity and grows with them to defeat cyberattacks. Its solutions combine machine learning, automation, and real-time threat intelligence with frontline human expertise from Sophos X-Ops to deliver advanced, 24/7 threat monitoring, detection, and response.
Sophos offers industry-leading managed detection and response (MDR) alongside a comprehensive portfolio of cybersecurity technologies — including endpoint, network, email, and cloud security, extended detection and response (XDR), identity threat detection and response (ITDR), and next-gen SIEM. Together with expert advisory services, these capabilities help organizations proactively reduce risk and respond faster, with the visibility and scalability needed to stay ahead of evolving threats.
Sophos goes to market with a global partner ecosystem, including Managed Service Providers (MSPs), Managed Security Service Providers (MSSPs), resellers and distributors, marketplace integrations, and cyber risk partners, giving organizations the flexibility to choose trusted relationships when securing their business. Sophos is headquartered in Oxford, U.K. More information is available at .

Role Summary

Sophos is seeking a Channel Marketing Manager to join our North America channel marketing team. At Sophos, we put partners at the center of how we go to market, and this role is critical to helping our partners drive growth while protecting customers from today’s evolving cyber threats.
In this role, you’ll work closely with Channel Sales and partner stakeholders across the U.S. and Canada to plan and execute partner marketing programs that drive pipeline, strengthen partner engagement, and support meaningful security outcomes. This is a hands-on, collaborative role for a marketer who enjoys turning strategy into action, delivering measurable results, and taking ownership of partner programs. This is an individual contributor role with no direct reports, where success is driven through ownership, cross-functional influence, and strong execution with partners. Success in this role looks like engaged, activated partners who consistently execute joint marketing programs that produce measurable pipeline and net-new customer growth.
Sophos offers a supportive, growth-oriented culture with a strong commitment to learning, collaboration, and internal career development—making this a great opportunity to build your channel marketing career in cybersecurity.
This role reports to the Director of Channel Marketing, North America

What You Will Do

  • Own partner marketing outcomes for a focused portfolio of high-priority partners in North America aligned to channel sales and regional marketing goals to drive pipeline and new customer growth. Priority partners may include national solution providers, strategic VARs, and high-growth regional partners across commercial, mid-market, and enterprise segments.
  • Plan and execute high-impact partner demand generation and go-to-market programs, leveraging established Sophos frameworks while identifying opportunities to adapt, optimize, or pilot new approaches with priority partners.
  • Work closely with channel sales, partner managers, field marketing, and product teams to deliver joint marketing plans that drive measurable partner-sourced pipeline, with a strong focus on net-new customer acquisition.
  • Build strong relationships with priority partners through deep engagement, enablement and consistent program execution that amplifies the Sophos value proposition.
  • Own partner marketing budgets and MDF, using performance data and partner insights to measure results, optimize programs, and maximize ROI.
  • Use AI-driven tools to streamline workflows, analyze partner performance, and scale execution across multiple partner programs without sacrificing quality or impact.
  • Expected travel: 15–20%

What You Will Bring

  • 3–5 years of partner or channel marketing experience, with hands-on experience supporting partner-led or co-marketing programs; experience working with national or strategic partners is a plus.
  • Experience designing, executing, and optimizing partner marketing programs that support pipeline growth and partner success.
  • Strong collaboration and project management skills, with the ability to work effectively with sales, marketing, and partner teams to deliver shared goals.
  • Comfortable using CRM and marketing platforms (Salesforce, PowerBI, Asana) to analyze partner performance, assess MDF ROI, and optimize programs based on pipeline and conversion data.
  • Experience using AI-powered tools and automation to improve efficiency, generate insights, and enhance execution across marketing programs
  • Clear, practical communication style to build trust with internal stakeholders and partners and translate marketing programs into actionable plans.
  • Intellectual curiosity with an interest in cybersecurity, AI-enabled security capabilities, and a desire to learn and grow in a partner-first environment.
  • BA/BS in Marketing, Business, Communications, or related field, or equivalent practical experience.
In the United States, the base salary for this role ranges from $95,000 to $158,000. In addition to base salary, we offer additional compensation including bonus eligibility and a comprehensive benefits package.  A candidate’s specific pay within this range will depend on a variety of factors, including job-related skills, training, location, experience, relevant education, certifications, and other business and organizational needs.

Ready to Join Us?

At Sophos, we believe in the power of diverse perspectives to fuel innovation. Research shows that candidates sometimes hesitate to apply if they don't check every box in a job description. We challenge that notion. Your unique experiences and skills might be exactly what we need to enhance our team. Don't let a checklist hold you back – we encourage you to apply.

What's Great About Sophos?

· Sophos operates a remote-first working model, making remote work the primary option for most employees. However, some roles may necessitate a hybrid approach. While we are a remote first organization, applicants must have legal authorization to work in the jurisdiction where the position is posted, without requiring employer sponsorship.

· Global fitness and trivia competitions to keep our bodies and minds sharp

Our Commitment To You

We’re proud of the diverse and inclusive environment we have at Sophos, and we’re committed to ensuring equality of opportunity. We believe that diversity, combined with excellence, builds a better Sophos, so we encourage applicants who can contribute to the diversity of our team. All applicants will be treated in a fair and equal manner and in accordance with the law regardless of gender, sex, gender reassignment, marital status, race, religion or belief, color, age, military veteran status, disability, pregnancy, maternity or sexual orientation. We want to give you every opportunity to show us your best self, so if there are any adjustments we could make to the recruitment and selection process to support you, please let us know.

Data Protection

jobs.title: Solution Deployment Manager
jobs.excerpt: Our Implementation team plays a key role in onboarding seamlessly new customers: they are working cross departments (Sales, Product and Customer Success) to understand and document client use cases and requirements and then translate them into the set-up and configuration of the 360Learning platform.
jobs.description:
Our Implementation team plays a key role in onboarding seamlessly new customers: they are working cross departments (Sales, Product and Customer Success) to understand and document client use cases and requirements and then translate them into the set-up and configuration of the 360Learning platform.
You will manage all phases of the implementation lifecycle, from sales turnover and kick off to handover to support. You will drive project management, define 360Learning platform architecture for our clients, facilitate integrations (flat files, API’s) and 3rd party apps, guide and provide assistance in order to ensure the successful deployment of their platform.
In addition, you will follow your customers' portfolio along their contract to increase product adoption, as well as to deliver Solutions complementary to the Product like platform audits.

Within 1 month, you will:

  • Become a Trello expert through our onboarding process
  • Understand our product offering through training
  • Master our platform and be able to support clients on basic requests through ticketing

Within 3 months, you will:

  • Start to onboard your own new clients:
  • Drive project management in order to ensure successful platform deployment from kick-off meeting, regular touchpoints until handover to support
  • Host functional and technical workshops with clients to support them in their platform customization and structuring

Within 6 months, you will:

  • Ensure the smooth 360Learning platform deployment for new clients
  • Successfully implement integration (SSO, third-party tools), deliver technical expertise on how to integrate their learning platform into their technical environment & troubleshooting
  • Be able to pitch the value of the 360Learning platform
  • Develop repeatable and scalable processes to improve project quality and delivery

Within 12 months, you will:

  • Onboard another Solution Deployment Manager
  • Contribute to our knowledge base to share best practices and lessons learned
  • Work with our partner ecosystem to strengthen the services proposed to our clients

The Skills Set

  • Minimum 4 years professional consulting experience, preferably in a customer facing role (Technical consultant, Technical Account Manager, Technical Project Manager, Implementation Project manager or Pre-sales Consultant)
  • Previous deployment experience of SaaS products, ideally HR related
  • Project management skills
  • Understanding and experience working with APIs, SSO configuration & troubleshooting
  • Solution-oriented, client-first mindset in everything you do
  • Ability to adapt to your audience, flexibility in tackling a conversation with highly technical stakeholders, and reducing complexity to more common terms with less technical stakeholders
  • Organized, structured, rational, analytical, able to manage priorities across multiple customer implementations
  • Fluent German, very good English proficiency (level B2)
  • Enthusiasm for our culture:

Interview Process

  • Phone Screen with our Talent Acquisition Manager
  • Discovery Meeting with Solution Deployment Manager Coach
  • Case Study with the Coach and a Solution Deployment Manager
  • Clarification Meeting with a future team colleague
  • Culture Fit Meeting with our Chief HR Officer
  • Offer !
    • ⇾ Get ready using our Knowledge Base:

What We Offer

  • Compensation: Package includes base salary, a variable component and equity 📈
  • Benefits: Work From Home perks, medical insurance, 1 month parental leave for the second parent.
  • Balance: Flexible hours, Total work from home possible anywhere in Germany 🏠
  • Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion: We have 6 active ERGs including Mental Health, Environmental/Sustainability, Women, Parents, LGBTQIA2S+, and Ethnic Diversity. Each group has at least one executive team member serving as a member of the group, bringing greater awareness to each group’s activities and providing a quick path to impact
  • Corporate Social Responsibility: Review our CSR Charter: 🌎🌏🌍
  • Culture: A framework that will help you make an impact - envision our way of working and our Convexity Culture: & find out more about the teams, product and processes 🚀👩🏻‍💻🏆

Who We Are

360Learning enables companies to upskill from within by turning their experts into champions for employee, customer, and partner growth. With our LMS for collaborative learning, Learning & Development teams can accelerate upskilling with the help of internal experts instead of slow top-down training. 360Learning is the easiest way to onboard and upskill employees, train customer-facing teams, and enable customers and partners–all from one place.
360Learning powers the future of work at 1,700 organizations. Founded in 2013, 360Learning has raised $240 million with 400+ team members across North America and EMEA.

Learning Includes Everyone.

In concert with our culture, 360Learning believes learning includes everyone and that means embracing the strengths of diversity, connectedness, and inclusion. Through conscientious efforts, our global footprint celebrates cultures, perspectives, and experiences from all over the world to support our platform that is built for all regardless of race, ethnicity, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, age, neurodiversity, disability status, citizenship, veteran status or any other aspect which makes an individual unique or protected by laws and regulations in the locations where we operate. Thus, 360Learning is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace, and we commit to continue this throughout our processes for recruitment, compensation, benefits, performance, promotion, and all other conditions and terms of employment. We want to learn from and with you!

jobs.title: Install Support Analyst
jobs.excerpt: The Install Support Analyst supports the successful implementation and onboarding of customers across FreedomPay's growing payments and commerce ecosystem.
jobs.description:
The Install Support Analyst supports the successful implementation and onboarding of customers across FreedomPay's growing payments and commerce ecosystem. This role works closely with customers, partners, internal technical teams, and project stakeholders to facilitate third-party interface integrations, software installations, system configurations, and deployment activities.

The ideal candidate is highly organized, technically curious, and customer-focused, with the ability to manage multiple projects and installation efforts simultaneously. This role will become familiar with a wide variety of payment technologies, point-of-sale systems, property management systems, web-based applications, payment gateways, and merchant-facing solutions. Success in this position requires strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and the ability to collaborate effectively across teams to deliver a seamless customer implementation experience. This role is required to be based out of your home office in Ireland.

Key Responsibilities:

    • Support the installation, configuration, and deployment of FreedomPay solutions and third-party integrations.
    • Coordinate implementation activities with customers, partners, project teams, and internal stakeholders.
    • Assist with the onboarding and activation of new customer environments, ensuring accurate setup and configuration.
    • Troubleshoot installation and integration issues, working across teams to identify and resolve roadblocks.
    • Conduct research, analysis, testing, and validation activities related to software implementations and system integrations.
    • Support a variety of technologies, including payment gateways, POS systems, PMS platforms, web portals, merchant applications, and related third-party solutions.
    • Document installation processes, procedures, and technical findings to support knowledge sharing and operational consistency.
    • Educate customers and partners on implementation requirements, system functionality, and best practices.
    • Follow established implementation methodologies, support processes, and standard operating procedures.
    • Partner with Technical Support, Product, Engineering, and Project Management teams to ensure successful customer outcomes.
    • Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives focused on implementation efficiency, quality, and customer experience.

Requirements:

    • Associate's or Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, MIS, Mathematics, or a related field.
    • 2-4 years of experience in software implementation, technical support, point-of-sale support, interface programming, troubleshooting, system configuration, or related technical roles.
    • Experience navigating and supporting POS and PMS platforms such as Oracle Opera, Micros POS, NCR Aloha, or similar hospitality and retail technologies.
    • Experience with payment processing, payment gateways, financial services, or related technologies preferred.
    • Experience managing multiple concurrent implementations/projects.
    • Experience working directly with customers during onboarding and deployment activities.
    • Basic understanding of APIs, networking, or payment integrations (if that's truly needed by the team).
    • Strong technical troubleshooting, investigation, and problem-solving skills.
    • Experience supporting software installations, system integrations, or customer onboarding projects.
    • Proficiency with web-based business tools such as Zendesk, Confluence, Jira, Atlassian, or similar platforms.
    • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including Excel, Word, and Outlook.
    • Ability to manage multiple priorities and projects in a fast-paced environment.
    • Strong aptitude for learning new technologies, systems, and business processes.
    • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to work effectively with technical and non-technical audiences.
    • Strong customer service orientation, active listening skills, patience, and attention to detail.
    • Willingness to travel approximately 10% as business needs require.
