jobs.title: Fractional HR & Talent Advisor (Contract)
jobs.excerpt: Hey, I’m Avery, Founder & CEO of Bloom.  We’re a workplace consultancy that partners with founder-led, growing small to mid-sized companies who are bold enough to prioritize strong people systems, early.
jobs.description:
Hey, I’m Avery, Founder & CEO of Bloom. We’re a workplace consultancy that partners with founder-led, growing small to mid-sized companies who are bold enough to prioritize strong people systems, early. The companies we work with know that building inclusive, high-performing workplaces doesn’t happen by accident. They’re invested. They care. They just don’t need a full-time HR hire (yet).

That’s where you come in.

This is a contract role (2-3 days per week) where you’ll act as a fractional HR partner for one of our clients, co-building, crafting, and implementing people systems that create the foundation for thriving, high-performing cultures. You’ll get to do meaningful, strategic work while still being hands-on with the day-to-day. And you’ll have the support of our Bloom collective beside you.

Who we are

At Bloom, we’re not your typical HR consultancy. We work with founder-led, purpose-driven companies who’ve made the smart choice to prioritize their people early. Most of our clients are small to mid-sized businesses (think 10–150 employees) that know building an intentional, inclusive culture doesn’t just happen—it takes work.
They care deeply about creating strong, scalable people systems that align with their values, but they don’t need a full-time HR hire just yet. What they need is an expert partner who can help them build it right the first time.

That’s where we come in.

We embed ourselves as fractional HR and DEI partners, providing leadership coaching, HR advisory, recruitment support, and the hands-on work of building policies, systems, and processes that are inclusive by design. Whether it’s making a client’s very first hire, designing progressive people policies, or guiding a founder through a tricky team challenge—we’re in it with them, doing the work that shapes high-performing, human-first workplaces. We don’t believe in band-aid solutions or corporate jargon. We believe in co-creating better workplaces with the people who are bold enough to build them differently.

About The Role

We're looking for a Sr. Talent & HR Advisor to join our team on a contract basis (2-3 days per week). This role is tied to a dynamic and ongoing client engagement, offering the opportunity to make a meaningful impact within a forward-thinking organization. This is a remote-first role open to candidates in Ontario, Canada, with occasional onsite client visits as needed.
Are you an experienced HR professional passionate about shaping workplace culture and driving talent strategy? We'd love to hear from you!

The Opportunity (Spoiler: You'll make a big impact)

  • Leading recruitment: Full-cycle hiring for client roles, with a focus on inclusive candidate experiences. In the first 6 months of the role, this will be a priority.
  • Co-building people systems: You’ll help design and implement HR policies, frameworks, and processes that align with modern, human-first workplaces.
  • Managing HR strategy: You’ll advise leaders on everything from hiring roadmaps to culture design to navigating tricky team dynamics.
  • Executing day-to-day HR tasks: Think onboarding, employee relations, policy updates, and more. Strategy and execution are both part of the work.
  • Coaching leaders: You’ll support founders and managers in becoming thoughtful people leaders.
  • Advising on people operations: From compensation frameworks to performance management systems, you’ll help build the foundation for sustainable growth.
  • Context-shifting with ease: No two days are the same. You’ll need to pivot between strategic advising and tactical execution regularly.

What You Bring to the Role

  • You’ve been the solo HR person at a growing company and thrived in that ambiguity.
  • Context shifting excites you—not overwhelms you. You can pivot with ease and stay grounded.
  • You’re passionate about supporting and uplifting small to mid-size business owners, knowing your work shapes their company culture.
  • You take a proactive, but not prescriptive approach—you ask questions to deeply understand each client’s unique needs.
  • You operate with a high level of integrity, consistently following through and completing tasks on time.
  • You thrive in autonomous environments, but also love collaborating with a values-aligned team.
  • You’re open to occasional onsite client meetings, but value flexible, remote-first work.
  • You’re a cautious optimist about the future of work, with a track record of implementing modern HR systems that challenge outdated norms.
  • You are discreet, trustworthy, and understand the importance of confidentiality.
  • You lead with humanity and empathy, knowing inclusion isn’t a checklist but a way of working.
  • You enjoy balancing big-picture strategy with getting things done.

What We're Looking For

  • Experience building and executing HR strategies in small to mid-size companies.
  • Comfort with acting as the primary HR partner while leveraging collective support.
  • Strong recruitment skills with an inclusive, human-first approach.
  • Ability to coach leaders and navigate sensitive conversations with care.
  • A strategic mindset with a bias for action and problem-solving.
  • Passion for inclusive workplace design and progressive people practices.
  • High trust, high integrity, and discretion.

Compensation + Location + Hours

  • $ - $ per hour . You will be joining Bloom via your corporation or as an independent contractor.
  • We are 100% remote and encourage folks to work where they can do their best work. That said, since we’re often meeting with clients, we expect contractors in the Bloom collective to conduct their work from a private, secure, and quiet space to ensure a distraction-free environment.
  • Clients assigned to this role will be in Eastern Standard time zone therefore the candidate will be required to work 9am-5pm ET.

The Interview Process

  • Initial screen: 30-min video interview with Sarah (HR & Talent Advisor)
  • Round 1: 45-minute video interview with Avery Francis (Founder and CEO)
  • Take Home Assignment
  • Round 3: Final video interview with Avery Francis (Founder and CEO)
  • Reference Checks
  • Offer

Application Timeline

  • Applications for this role will close on Friday, January 30, 2026 at 12:00 EST.

More about us: Fractional Work, Full Support

  • While you’ll be the face of HR for our client, you’ll never be on an island. At Bloom, we work fractionally but collectively. Our Advisors lean on each other, share resources, troubleshoot challenges, and learn together.
  • You’ll have input on the clients we work with and how we work with them. We don’t take on just anyone. Values alignment is a must—for us and for you.
  • Fractional work isn’t “less than”—it’s intentional. It’s for people who want meaningful work, variety, and flexibility without being tied to a single desk 40+ hours a week. It takes agility, autonomy, and a collaborative mindset. If that resonates, you’re in the right place.

Our use of AI in hiring

We believe transparency matters, especially as technology Bloom, we may leverage AI as a supportive tool when developing role descriptions, interview questions, take home assignments, and interview guides, where appropriate, with the goal of improving clarity, consistency, and accessibility for candidates. However, we do not use AI to source, assess, screen, or interview candidates. Every application is reviewed by a human, every interview is conducted by a human, and all hiring decisions are made by people, not automated systems. Human judgment, care, and accountability are central to how we hire.
We care deeply about offering all applicants a fair and consistent selection process. While we’d love to connect with every candidate individually, we’re unable to accommodate one-on-one conversations before the interview stage. Keeping our process structured helps us reduce bias and ensure we’re selecting facilitators based on skills, experience, and alignment with our mission.
Bloom is committed to equity and inclusion in our hiring. If you’re a person with a disability and require accommodations during the application process, please reach out to —we’ll work with you to meet your needs at every stage. We encourage applications from all qualified candidates, including those from historically marginalized communities.
We know there are many great opportunities out there, so we appreciate you considering Bloom as part of your journey.
Ready to grow? If so, apply!

jobs.excerpt: Sprinto is an Autonomous Trust Platform that centralizes trust requirements across security frameworks, vendors, and customers.
jobs.description:
Sprinto is an Autonomous Trust Platform that centralizes trust requirements across security frameworks, vendors, and customers.

Sprinto autonomously executes tasks needed to maintain trust across compliance, audits, risk management, vendor risk, privacy, and AI governance, enabling organizations to maintain a strong, reliable trust posture without draining operational bandwidth and resources on repetitive tasks.

Backed by top-tier investors such as Accel, Elevation, and Blume Ventures, we’ve raised$31.8M in funding to fuel our mission. Trusted by over 4,000 organizations across 75 countries, Sprinto helps organizations stay audit-ready, manage real-time risks, and scale fearlessly. With 300+ native integrations and AI-driven automation, Sprinto supports 200+ global security standards natively, including SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA, PCI-DSS, and more. Sprinto's extensible architecture enables organizations to build and support an infinite number of custom integrations and frameworks.

Founded in 2020 by second-time founders Girish Redekar and Raghuveer Kancherla, Sprinto powers compliance for organizations like Whatfix, Encora, Anaconda, Whatnot, Ultrahuman, WeWork, Everstage, AI Foundation, HackerRank, and many more.

Life as a Sprinter -

Nobody succeeds at Sprinto by staying in their lane.

We are organized around problems, not job titles. Sprinters take ownership beyond their role, solve hard problems, and care deeply about the impact they create. If something can be improved, fixed, or built, we don't wait for permission; we step in.

Being remote means we rely less on proximity and more on trust. We write things down, communicate openly, and move quickly because great teams aren't built by sitting together, they're built by pulling in the same direction.

We believe progress beats perfection, feedback is a gift, and doing the right thing matters, even when nobody is watching.

And while we move with urgency, we never move alone.

The mission -

We're hiring a Demand Generation Specialist who can own our account-based marketing motion on LinkedIn end to end, from account selection to pipeline, while also driving our presence on other paid social channels like Meta and Reddit.

This role is for someone who started in the trenches of LinkedIn Ads and evolved into ABM strategy. We're looking for a marketer who understands that ABM is not just uploading an account list and running ads. Someone who knows how to pick the right accounts, engage the full buying committee, sequence messaging across the funnel, and prove impact in pipeline terms, not impressions. And someone who understands that what works on LinkedIn won't work on Reddit or Meta, and can adapt targeting, messaging, and creatives to each platform's native behavior.

Where you'll leave your mark?

  • Own Sprinto's ABM motion on LinkedIn end to end: account selection, audience strategy, campaign execution, and pipeline reporting
  • Build and refine ICP and account tiers using firmographic, technographic, and intent signals
  • Plan and run multi-stage LinkedIn campaigns across awareness, engagement, and conversion for target account lists
  • Engage full buying committees, not just one persona, with messaging tailored to each role and funnel stage

Sophos is a cybersecurity leader defending 600,000 organizations globally with an AI-driven platform and expert-led services. Sophos is headquartered in Oxford, U.K. More information is available at .

Role Summary

We are seeking a detail-oriented and technically skilled Detection Engineer to join our X-OPS team. In this role, you will be responsible for analyzing advanced security threats—ranging from malware to complex web attacks—and translating threat intelligence into high-fidelity detections across our platform. Your work will help ensure our analysts and clients receive highly accurate, actionable alerts with minimal noise.
You will leverage data from over 40 third-party and internal sources, partner with our CTU Threat Intelligence team, and use a range of scripting and automation tools to strengthen detection capabilities. The ideal candidate is a hands-on security practitioner with a deep understanding of endpoint behavior, cloud behavior, and detection development who thrives in fast-paced, technical environments.

What You Will Do

  • Develop countermeasures to detect advanced threats based on research and intelligence from the CTU team.
  • Analyze endpoint behaviors and logs to design detections using multi-source telemetry.
  • Continuously refine and monitor detection rules to optimize the signal-to-noise ratio for alerts.
  • Research and implement alert handling for new device ingestions, ensuring high-value signal delivery.
  • Leverage internal tooling to distinguish native from standard integrations for detection accuracy.
  • Collaborate on the development of internal tools, automation, and detection infrastructure.
  • Act as a subject matter expert across departments including Product Management, Marketing, and Labs Research.

What You Will Bring

  • Strong passion for cybersecurity research and the ability to quickly learn emerging technologies.
  • Hands-on experience in scripting languages (PowerShell, Bash, Python) and use of Python data science libraries (e.g., NumPy, Pandas, Matplotlib).
  • Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines, testing frameworks, and automation principles.
  • Proficiency in analyzing logs from firewalls, proxies, and security infrastructure to identify anomalies.
  • Familiarity with event logs, traffic pattern anomalies, and threat hunting methodologies.
  • Strong understanding of endpoint detection, Linux/Unix and Windows OS internals, vulnerability identification, and workflow automation.
  • Forensic analysis of memory and disk images across various OS and file system types is a plus.
  • Experience in malware analysis, including static/dynamic techniques and reverse engineering (IA32/64, ARM binaries) is a plus.
  • Experience with event correlation and incident reconstruction using log data is a plus.
  • Network traffic analysis skills, including identification of anomalous or malicious traits is a plus.
  • Solid grasp of database querying, systems architecture, and process automation for operational improvements is a nice to have.

We are seeking a Product Manager to help drive the continued evolution of the Enterprise Health occupational health platform. The ideal candidate will have strong SaaS product management experience, a customer-first mindset, and the ability to translate complex enterprise workflows into intuitive, scalable solutions that deliver measurable customer and business value.

This role will lead product discovery, strategy, and execution for meaningful areas of the Enterprise Health product portfolio. Initial areas of focus may include core occupational health capabilities such as medical surveillance, case and injury management, compliance programs, absence management, reporting and analytics, and related workflows.

The Product Manager will partner closely with customers, Engineering, Design, Client Success, Product Marketing, regulatory and clinical stakeholders, and other Product Managers to deeply understand customer problems, identify high-value opportunities, and deliver solutions that strengthen Enterprise Health's position as a leading occupational health platform. This includes proactively identifying opportunities to apply AI, automation, and emerging technologies to improve workflows, user experiences, and customer outcomes.

Product Management at MIE is organized around coherent customer problems, workflows, and capabilities. Areas of ownership may evolve over time as customer needs, product strategy, and organizational priorities change. Product Managers are expected to develop deep expertise in the areas they own while maintaining a broad understanding of how those capabilities connect across the Enterprise Health platform.

jobs.description:
About Virtru:

While the rest of the security industry obsesses over locking data down to prevent it from being lost or stolen, we're doing something fundamentally different at Virtru. We're setting data free so that you can intentionally share it with others, but without sacrificing security, privacy, or control.

We've created both a suite of powerful data protection applications and an open platform that's sparking an ecosystem of innovation. Through the Trusted Data Format (TDF) open standard, we're not just protecting data; we're creating a new paradigm where security enables sharing rather than preventing it.

Think of us as the Android of data protection: a robust platform with an open core that developers and partners can build upon, coupled with our own best-in-class applications that showcase what's possible when you reimagine security from the ground up.

Backed by Iconiq Capital, Bessemer Venture Partners, Foundry Capital, and Tiger Global, we're helping Fortune 500 companies and government agencies discover that true data security means having the freedom to share, collaborate, and innovate — without compromise.

Compensation: $50-80/hour

Hours: 10-20 hours/week

Team & Position Details:

As a Contract Technical Writer, you will report to a Solutions Architect on Virtru's Standards team. Virtru actively contributes to the development of international data-centric security standards across US, NATO, and FVEY bodies. This role accelerates our standards document production and ensures Virtru's contributions meet the rigor and formatting conventions of multinational standards organizations. Your writing will directly shape how allied nations protect and share sensitive data.

As a Technical Writer, your responsibilities will include:

  • Draft and refine technical prose for international cryptographic key management and data security standards, ensuring compliance with NATO and allied publication conventions (e.g., ADatP, ACP formatting).
  • Document interoperability test plans, results, and technical findings for bilateral partner engagements and multinational exercises.
  • Prepare technical white papers, position papers, and briefing materials supporting government research partnerships and standards body meetings.
  • Translate engineering feedback and subject matter expert input into publication-ready, standards-quality language.
  • Support preparation of written contributions for recurring virtual and in-person standards writing sessions.
  • Prepare test scenario descriptions and technical reports for multinational interoperability exercises.
  • Draft response documents for standards community review and comment periods.
  • Assist in producing reference documents that unify Virtru's technical positions across multiple standards engagement tracks into a coherent narrative.

Skills that will help you thrive in this role:

  • Demonstrated experience writing or editing technical standards, specifications, or policy documents for government or multinational organizations.
  • Strong command of precise, unambiguous technical prose — the kind found in RFCs, STANAGs, or MIL-STDs.
  • Ability to work from engineering notes, meeting recordings, and SME interviews to produce publication-ready drafts.

Nice to haves:

  • Experience with NATO standards processes (STANAGs, ADatPs, Allied publications) or Five Eyes/CCEB publication conventions (ACPs).
  • Background in cybersecurity, zero trust architecture, or cross-domain solutions.
  • Familiarity with cryptographic concepts, key management, and/or data security at a conceptual level.
  • Active or recently held US security clearance (Secret or above).

Virtruvian qualities that will set you up for success:

  • Thinking outside of the box to respectfully challenge your teammates and managers in the pursuit of excellence
  • Strong sense of urgency with an action-oriented mindset
  • Able to collaborate and adapt to shifting priorities as business needs evolve
  • Comfortable with asynchronous communication including slack, email, zoom, etc.

Perks & Benefits:

At Virtru, we believe people do their best work when their wellbeing is put first. This is why we make your wellbeing our priority with a thoughtful and holistic program that encompasses Occupational, Mental, Social, Physical, and Environmental Wellness by offering benefits such as…

  • A Flexible PTO policy — we strongly encourage you to take time off (in addition to 14 holidays) to ensure that you are getting the proper time needed to unplug and recharge.
  • A $1,500 annual Learning & Development Stipend focused on providing you the resources to continually learn and professionally grow.
  • Frequent company-sponsored team celebrations that provide ample opportunities to connect with teammates and be social!
  • Access to an Employee Assistance Program
  • Access to Headspace, a mental health app tailored to your specific needs.
  • A flat 3% contribution to your retirement account
  • A high degree of flexibility — Have an appointment, errand, or family emergency to take care of? Hop to it! We give you the time and space to take care of you and your own first.

In addition to wellbeing, Virtru places a strong emphasis on diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging. Our DB&I Council is dedicated to fostering an inclusive workplace and making the psychological safety of each and every one of our teammates a top priority.

Additional perks include:

  • Competitive compensation
  • Generous parental, medical, and bereavement policies
  • Uncapped commissions for Sales roles
  • 401K contribution and stock options
  • Full medical, dental, and vision benefits
  • New Hire Swag and IT Welcome boxes
  • Structured semi-annual 360° performance reviews

Virtru is committed to building an inclusive environment for people of all backgrounds and everyone is encouraged to apply. Virtru is an Equal Opportunity Employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, gender, religion, disability, national origin, protected veteran status, age, or any other status protected by applicable national, federal, state, or local law.

jobs.description:
Drivetrain is on a mission to empower businesses to make better decisions. Our financial planning & decision-making platform helps companies scale and achieve their targets predictably.
Drivetrain is a remote-first company headquartered in the San Francisco Bay Area. Founded in 2021 by a couple of ex-Googlers, Drivetrain is a fast-growing company on a trajectory for success with backing from leading venture capital firms.
Drivetrain provides a great culture for its employees to thrive in and be happy.
💜 Remote-friendly: Drivetrain brings together the best and the brightest, no matter where they are and provides them a great degree of autonomy. We trust our people.
🗣️ Open & transparent: We know that when our creators have access to all the information they need, their best work will emerge.
👏 Idea-friendly: We provide an environment to explore new ideas, to take risks, to make mistakes, and to learn, so you can succeed. Anyone in the company can come up with great ideas and become a catalyst for positive change. We let the best ideas win.
👥 Customer-centric: We follow a product-led growth strategy, continuously learning from our customers and collaborating to build the amazing software that Drivetrain is.

We're hiring a GTM Operations Associate to support the sales and marketing engine end-to-end — CRM hygiene, pipeline reporting, forecasting support, and the tooling that keeps our GTM team moving fast.

We're flexible on experience: 1–1.5 years in sales ops, GTM ops, or RevOps is ideal, but we're just as open to a sharp fresh graduate who hasn't done this exact job before. What matters more than the resume is how you think — this role rewards people who are naturally structured, curious about "why is this number what it is," and quick to pick up new tools.

What You'll Own

  • CRM & data hygiene: Keep our CRM (HubSpot) clean — deduping records, standardizing fields, enriching account/contact data so pipeline numbers can actually be trusted.

  • Pipeline & funnel reporting: Track stage-wise conversion, drop-offs, pipeline coverage, and rep-level activity; maintain the dashboards leadership pulls up every week.

  • GTM tooling & workflow ops: Administer and configure day-to-day tools in our GTM stack (think HubSpot, Apollo.io, Clay, G2, or similar) — sequences, lead routing rules, list building, enrichment workflows.

  • Forecasting support: Assist Sales/RevOps leadership with pipeline forecasting, weekly forecast calls, and variance tracking against target.

  • Campaign & lead ops: Support Marketing with list segmentation, lead scoring, and routing leads to the right rep at the right time.

  • Sales enablement ops: Keep playbooks, battlecards, and competitor trackers current; help onboard new AEs/SDRs onto the tool stack.

  • Ad hoc analysis: Pull data cuts for exec reviews, QBRs, and board decks on request.

What We're Looking For

Experience

1–1.5 years of experience in sales ops, GTM ops, or RevOps at a B2B SaaS company — or a fresh graduate (any discipline) with a track record of being sharp, structured, and fast to learn. We're genuinely open on this; don't self-select out if you're early in your career.

What "generally smart" means to us

  • You can look at messy data and find the story in it without being told exactly where to look.

  • You're comfortable in spreadsheets — formulas, pivot tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP — and reach for them naturally to answer a question.

  • You ask "why" before "how" — you'd rather understand what a number is telling us than just report it.

  • You pick up new tools fast and don't need hand-holding after the first walkthrough.

AI & automation comfort

As with every role at Drivetrain, we expect AI to be a default part of how you work, not an afterthought:

  • Comfortable using AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, or similar) to draft reports, summarize account/call notes, clean up data, or write formulas and light SQL.

  • Bonus: any exposure to no-code automation (Zapier, n8n, HubSpot workflows) to connect tools and cut manual steps out of a process.

  • We'd rather you spend your energy on the judgment-heavy 20% of the job than the repetitive 80% — so we want someone who looks for ways to automate the boring parts, not someone who takes pride in doing them fast by hand.

Good to Have (not required)

  • Prior internship or work experience in a B2B SaaS GTM, sales, or analytics function.

  • Familiarity with tools like HubSpot, Salesforce, Apollo.io, Clay, or similar.

  • Basic SQL or scripting exposure.

In your application: tell us about a time you used data or a spreadsheet to solve a messy, ambiguous problem — a job, a class project, even something personal. We care more about how you approached it than how polished the outcome was.

jobs.description:
What’s CrowdRiff?

Good visuals are appealing to the eye, but great visuals tell stories that reignite your desire to discover, spark your creative imagination and even influence what we buy, eat, and do. That’s why CrowdRiff exists: to empower destination marketers to showcase their unique destinations through powerful visual storytelling solutions.
✨ CrowdRiff is built around the idea of pushing the boundaries of exploration; and our dedication to finding experiences that feel more authentic and undiscovered make us who we are. We like to think of ourselves as modern-day explorers, who believe in taking action now and thrive in an open, challenging, and encouraging environment.
Our team is a quirky and diverse crew that has one thing in common: our love for great visuals. Picture this. You will contribute to amplifying unique travel experiences like scuba diving in Tahiti 🌊, exploring Napa’s wine country🥂, bungee jumping in Queenstown 🤩and much more while having access to some of our amazing travel perks that allow you to immerse yourselves in local communities and culture.
At CrowdRiff, you have the freedom, autonomy, and resources to set the course of your own future along with an incredible crew. We understand that to feel empowered and to keep forging new paths professionally and personally, we need to pull out all the stops. That’s why we take a proactive approach and set not only professional but also personal goals for all CrowdRiffers. To make this possible, we offer opportunities related to training, tuition, conferences, workshops, or anything else that will help you achieve your goals under our ‘DevDollars’ program.
Every day, we work across departments, time zones, and even oceans to reach our goals and delight our customers - all while being remote. If you are looking to make travel an incredible experience today, and for future generations, and are passionate about visuals & tech, you’re just our type. 💯

Your Role: Senior Field Marketing Manager

CrowdRiff partners with destination marketing organizations, an industry built on relationships, and one that gathers at annual conventions, state conferences, and regional events. This role owns how we show up there: the go/no-go call, the booth, the outreach around it, and the report that says whether it paid off. Most of our growth comes from customers we already have, so a good share of this is deepening relationships rather than chasing new logos.

We care a lot about taste and experience (no tables of branded stress balls 🫠). We'd rather spend the budget on one thing people remember than five hundred things that get left in a hotel room.

You'll travel, but not every other week. Much of this job is setting other people up to represent us well, then making sure the follow-up actually happens. Between events, the focus shifts to high-touch account campaigns. Same instincts, smaller rooms.

What you'll do:

  • Own the event portfolio: evaluate opportunities and turn company goals into an event strategy that drives pipeline, expansion, and retention.
  • Design the experience, then execute it: concept and build booths and activations people remember, and run the on-site logistics end to end.
  • Set the team up to represent us well: decide who attends, prep them, and make sure what they gather on-site lands in HubSpot and gets followed up on.
  • Run the demand engine around each event: pre-event outreach, meeting booking, and post-event follow-up in HubSpot, coordinated with Account Management.
  • Report on performance: spend, meetings, pipeline, expansion, and revenue per event, plus the quarterly rollup.
  • Execute high-touch ABM campaigns: dinners, small-format gatherings, and one-to-few experiences for target accounts, shaped together with the Head of Marketing.
  • Manage vendor and organizer relationships: negotiate sponsorships and hold the fabrication/print/freight bench accountable.
  • Own our owned events: customer receptions, dinners, webinars, and other first-party activations.
  • Manage the budget: forecast the events and field marketing line and make the tradeoff calls inside it.

Ideally, you'll have:

  • Ideas and collaboration: Brings ideas rather than waiting for a brief, and builds well on other people's.
  • Taste and experience design: Has a real point of view on materials, print, and space — and would rather fund one thing people talk about than 500 they throw away.
  • Events execution: 5–7 years running large-scale events with full portfolio ownership; calm and decisive on-site; good at getting other people ready to represent us.
  • HubSpot: Hands-on — lists, workflows, campaigns, attribution, reporting, no hand-holding required.
  • AI fluency: Uses Claude or similar daily, and knows where output needs a human check.
  • ABM and campaign execution: Has run real-world, high-touch account programs — not just email sequences — including plays built for existing customers, not just prospects.
  • Marketing and analysis: Writes clean on-brand copy, is comfortable with a budget, and is curious about how destination marketing actually works.
  • This is a remote role open to candidates based in Canada and legally authorized to work in Canada.

The role

The VPC (Virtual Private Cloud) team builds and operates the core networking layer of our cloud platform. We enable virtual machines to communicate reliably by abstracting them from the underlying physical network, providing seamless IP-based connectivity even as workloads move across the datacenter.

Our team designs secure, isolated private networks for customers, connects them to the public internet, and delivers essential networking services such as load balancers, firewalls, and security groups. Because nearly every cloud application depends on networking, VPC is a foundational service for the entire platform.

Stability and resilience are our top priorities—we engineer systems to remain reliable and operational even when parts of the cloud experience failures.

What we do:

  • Increase service scalability
  • Developing service functionality (e.g. IPv6 support, service endpoints, VPC peering, L7 load balancers and other networking services)

jobs.description:
About Us

Planful is the pioneer of financial performance management cloud software. The Planful platform, which helps businesses drive peak financial performance, is used around the globe to streamline business-wide planning, budgeting, consolidations, reporting, and analytics. Planful empowers finance, accounting, and business users to plan confidently, close faster, and report accurately. More than 1,500 customers, including 23andMe, Bose, Boston Red Sox, Five Guys, and Zappos, rely on Planful to accelerate cycle times, increase productivity, and improve accuracy. Planful is a private company backed by Vector Capital, a leading global private equity firm. Learn more at planful.com.

About the Role

We are seeking a UX Designer & Researcher to help shape the continuing evolution of the Planful platform. This role splits its time between two disciplines. You will uncover what our finance users need through research, then turn those insights into wireframes, flows, and prototypes that reduce friction and make Planful a delight to use.

Reporting to the Team Lead, Product Design, you will work with Product Management, Engineering, and Content to solve complex, data-rich workflow challenges. You will ground your decisions in evidence from users, industry best-practice patterns, and the Planful Design System.

Responsibilities

Research

  • Plan and conduct generative and evaluative research, including customer interviews, contextual inquiry, usability tests, concept tests, and surveys
  • Partner with Product, Customer Success, and Support to recruit participants and maintain an ongoing pipeline of customer conversations
  • Synthesize findings into clear, actionable deliverables such as personas, journey maps, opportunity areas, and insight summaries
  • Measure the impact of shipped designs using usability metrics, behavioral data, and customer feedback, and use the results to guide iteration
  • Build and maintain a shared research repository so insights are discoverable and reused across teams
  • Present findings and recommendations to internal stakeholders and customers, and help shape roadmap priorities with evidence

Design

  • Work with Product to define problem statements, and develop wireframes, user flows, and interaction storyboards that demonstrate end-to-end solutions
  • Design mockups and prototypes that follow the Planful Design System and brand guidelines, and iterate based on user and stakeholder feedback
  • Review competing products, industry conventions, and UX research to ensure solutions are well supported by evidence
  • Work closely with Engineering during development to navigate constraints and ensure the best achievable UX outcomes
  • Contribute to the Planful pattern library and help raise the standard of the team overall
  • Estimate your workload accurately so the team lead can plan and prioritize the backlog
  • Embody Planful’s values and contribute to a culture of having fun together and taking pride in building wonderful products

Requirements

  • 6-8 years of experience in UX research and design, ideally in enterprise or B2B SaaS
  • A portfolio that demonstrates both research and design work, showing how research findings shaped design decisions and outcomes
  • Hands-on experience with qualitative research methods (user interviews, usability testing, needs analysis) and familiarity with quantitative methods (surveys, analytics review)
  • Experience creating user-centered artifacts such as personas, scenarios, journey maps, and information architecture
  • Proficiency in Claude and Figma for wireframing, prototyping, and working within a design system
  • Experience working collaboratively with product managers and engineers throughout the design and development cycle
  • Strong communication and storytelling skills, with the ability to present research and design rationale to varied audiences
  • Working knowledge of HTML/CSS and responsive design principles

Preferred Experience

  • Prior financial domain experience (FP&A, accounting, consolidations, reporting), or at least some finance domain knowledge
  • Experience designing for data-dense products such as grids, dashboards, and reporting tools
  • Experience designing or researching AI-powered or agentic experiences, and comfort using AI tools in your daily design and research workflow
  • Experience with research tools such as UserTesting, Maze, Dovetail, or similar

Why Planful

To foster the best in class work we’re so proud of, we’ve created a best in class culture, including:
  • 2 Volunteer days, Birthday PTO, and quarterly company Wellness Days
  • 13 months’ supply of diapers and meal deliveries for the first month of your Maternity/Paternity leave
  • Company-wide Mentorship program with Executive sponsorship of CFO and Manager-specific monthly training programs
  • Employee Resource Groups such as Women of Planful, Parents of Planful, and many more. We encourage our teammates to bring their authentic selves to the team, and have full support in creating new ERGs & communities along the way

The OTE range for this role is $180,000 - $210,000 USD per year, depending on experience and location. As a part of this role, you are also eligible for benefits and wellbeing resources.

jobs.title: Azure Infrastructure Engineer
jobs.excerpt: Company NameARS-Rescue RooterOverviewThe Azure Infrastructure Engineer is a hands-on infrastructure role that designs, builds, migrates, secures, and operates production Azure infrastructure extending our on-premises VMware and Windows datacenter.
jobs.description:
Company Name

ARS-Rescue Rooter

Overview

The Azure Infrastructure Engineer is a hands-on infrastructure role that designs, builds, migrates, secures, and operates production Azure infrastructure extending our on-premises VMware and Windows datacenter. Focus areas: Azure networking, hybrid connectivity, virtual machines and platform services, disaster recovery, and migration execution.

The role is DevOps-savvy, not DevOps engineering: the engineer uses Infrastructure-as-Code, Git, and pipelines to keep infrastructure repeatable and auditable, following and extending team standards.

The engineer partners with Infrastructure, Networking, Security, Database, and Application Development teams and external consultants.

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

Azure Infrastructure Engineering & Operations

  • Independently design, deploy, and maintain Azure infrastructure: landing zones, management groups, VMs, storage, backup, monitoring, and governance.
  • Troubleshoot connectivity, performance, access, and availability issues across VM, OS, network, DNS, firewall, and identity layers; perform root-cause analysis and implement durable fixes.
  • Develop runbooks and operational standards; participate in incident response, change management (CAB), maintenance windows, and on-call.

Hybrid Networking, DNS & Application Delivery

  • Design and troubleshoot VNets, NSGs, routing/UDRs, hub-and-spoke or Virtual WAN, Azure Firewall, VPN Gateway, and ExpressRoute, including BGP and failover behavior.
  • Design name resolution across Azure and on-premises (Private DNS, DNS Private Resolver, conditional forwarding).
  • Implement private connectivity to PaaS services using private endpoints.
  • Support application delivery with Front Door, Application Gateway, load balancing, and WAF, including TLS certificate lifecycle and failure-mode design when an edge service or policy fails.
  • Work with Networking on firewall rules, IP addressing, NAT, and datacenter, branch, and third-party connectivity.

Migration Execution

  • Plan and execute VMware and Windows migrations to Azure: dependency assessment, Azure Migrate, lift-and-shift, test migrations, cutover, and post-migration support.
  • Produce cutover plans, validation checklists, and rollback criteria; execute off-hours production cutovers.
  • Support Azure infrastructure for SQL Server migrations (Always On to Azure SQL Managed Instance or SQL Server on Azure VMs).
  • Maintain hybrid domain controllers, DNS, and AD integration for Azure workloads.

Resiliency, Backup & Disaster Recovery

  • Design and test DR using Site Recovery, geo-redundant storage, and region/availability-zone design against RTO and RPO targets.
  • Operate Azure Backup and evaluate it against third-party backup and replication platforms for new Azure data stores; document and report recovery test results.

Platform Services Infrastructure

  • Provide infrastructure for App Service, Functions, Logic Apps, Service Bus, and API Management: VNet integration, private endpoints, identity, Key Vault, and monitoring.
  • Support AKS at the platform level (private cluster, CNI, node pools, ingress, managed identity) with Application Development.

Automation & Infrastructure-as-Code

  • Build, modify, and troubleshoot Terraform following team standards: modules, remote state, environment separation, and drift.
  • Use Git pull requests and code review; maintain Azure DevOps infrastructure pipelines, including approval gates and self-hosted agents reaching private endpoints.
  • Automate operations with PowerShell and Azure CLI.

Identity, Security & Governance

  • Apply Entra ID, RBAC, PIM, Conditional Access, and managed identities to enforce least privilege and segregation of duties.
  • Implement guardrails with Azure Policy, management groups, tagging, and Defender for Cloud.
  • Partner with Security, Compliance, and Audit on PCI DSS, NIST, and CIS controls, remediation, and audit evidence.

Observability & Cost Management

  • Build Azure Monitor and Log Analytics alerts, workbooks, and dashboards; tune alert noise and logging volume; use Application Insights for tracing.
  • Right-size and manage cost with Cost Management, Advisor, reservations, and savings plans, after establishing baselines.

Collaboration & Cross-Training

  • Share knowledge both ways: train teammates in Azure and cloud practices, and learn from them in their areas of expertise.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

Note: Candidates must demonstrate each item below with specific examples of work they performed as an individual contributor.

  • Bachelor's degree in IT, Computer Science, Engineering, or related field; equivalent professional experience considered.
  • 5+ years of enterprise infrastructure engineering, including 3+ years of hands-on production Azure.
  • Hybrid networking: hands-on VNets, NSGs, routing, DNS, and ExpressRoute or site-to-site VPN; can explain tradeoffs and failure behavior.
  • On-premises to Azure migrations: direct involvement in preparation, cutover, rollback planning, and post-migration support.
  • Working knowledge of VMware vSphere, Windows Server, Active Directory, DNS, and Group Policy.
  • Resiliency: Azure Backup and Site Recovery (or equivalent DR design) against RTO/RPO targets.
  • Automation: working proficiency with Terraform (state, modules, environments), PowerShell, Git, and Azure DevOps infrastructure pipelines.
  • Identity and governance: Entra ID, RBAC, least privilege, and Azure Policy.
  • Independent troubleshooting and root-cause analysis of complex Azure issues.
  • Experience supporting PCI DSS, NIST, CIS, or similar compliance requirements.

Technical Skills

Working knowledge

  • Platform services: App Service, Functions, Logic Apps, Service Bus, API Management, Azure SQL Managed Instance, SQL Server on Azure VMs.
  • Azure Virtual Desktop/FSLogix, Bicep/ARM, Defender for Cloud, and Sentinel.
  • AKS, Docker, Helm, and Cosmos DB.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Azure certifications (AZ-104, AZ-305, AZ-700, AZ-500, AZ-400) or HashiCorp Terraform Associate; must be current.
  • AKS platform operations, Azure SQL Managed Instance, or IIS/.NET application migrations.
  • PCI DSS audit evidence, CrowdStrike or similar security platforms, and multi-site hybrid environments.
  • Experience mentoring peers and using AI tools to speed scripting and troubleshooting.

Work Details

  • Remote; work day would be in Central Time Zone.
  • Regular business hours with scheduled after-hours maintenance and cutovers, occasional incident response, and on-call as required; participation in change management (CAB).
  • Occasional travel for project work, meetings, or datacenter activities.

Computrition, Inc. is a leading provider of enterprise foodservice, nutrition management, and retail software technology, trusted by more than 1,200 customers across North America, including healthcare systems, military installations, correctional facilities, and higher education institutions. If you're looking to build technology that makes a meaningful impact while growing your career with a stable, innovative company, we'd like to hear from you.

Overview

We are seeking a highly organized and proactive Technical Project Manager to lead strategic cloud technology initiatives from concept through completion, while also contributing to select on-premise software growth initiatives. This role is responsible for managing project scope, timeline, budget, and deliverables while ensuring alignment with strategic organizational objectives. The Project Manager will work cross-functionally with product development, engineering, operations, finance, and executive leadership to deliver solutions on time and within budget.

This role requires experience using AI tools to accelerate the management, tracking, and delivery of technical development, as well as the commercialization of new software initiatives, not just familiarity with AI in the abstract.

This is a full-time position reporting directly to the President of the company.

Key Responsibilities

Project Planning and Execution

  • Develop, implement, and maintain detailed project plans including timelines, milestones, resource allocations, and risk mitigation strategies.
  • Define project scope and objectives, ensuring alignment with business goals and stakeholder expectations.
  • Lead project kickoffs, regular status meetings, post-project reviews, and the swift execution of action items.
  • Track project progress and deliverables through established project management tools and reporting systems.

Strategic Planning and Performance Execution

  • Partner with the President on strategic planning for our cloud growth initiatives and select on-premise innovation initiatives, translating strategic priorities into executable plans with clear ownership and timelines, assisting with on-time delivery within targeted budgets.
  • Track execution against strategic milestones, not just project tasks, surfacing where performance is falling behind intent and driving corrective action.
  • Contribute to the commercial and business planning view of key initiatives, partnering with Product, Engineering, and Sales to connect technical delivery to business outcomes.

Budget and Financial Oversight

  • Establish and manage project budgets, including forecasting, tracking, and reporting variances.
  • Ensure all project expenditures align with approved budgets and company financial policies.
  • Provide quarterly budget summaries and variance analyses to leadership.
  • Identify and operationalize opportunities for enhanced financial performance.

Communication and Reporting

  • Serve as the central point of contact for project related communication across departments.
  • Prepare and present regular progress reports, dashboards, and executive summaries for leadership review.
  • Facilitate quarterly strategic reviews, providing updates on project status, key milestones, risks, and opportunities.
  • Proactively engage with customers and prospects to solicit feedback on offerings and stimulate demand.

Risk and Issue Management

  • Proactively identify project risks, issues, and dependencies, developing mitigation and contingency plans.
  • Escalate critical issues promptly and facilitate resolution with appropriate stakeholders.

Continuous Improvement

  • Contribute to the refinement of project management processes, tools, and best practices.
  • Analyze project outcomes to identify lessons learned and opportunities for future improvement.

Qualifications

Education and Experience

  • Bachelor's degree required, in Engineering, Business Administration, Project Management, or a related field. An MBA, or equivalent business experience translating technical execution into strategic and business outcomes, is considered a strong advantage.
  • 5+ years of experience managing cloud, software product development, or technical projects preferred.
  • Experience working in a cross-functional team environment with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Prior experience working in healthcare foodservice operations or bedside nutrition management is an advantage.

Skills and Competencies

  • Experience using AI tools and workflows to accelerate the planning, tracking, and delivery of technical development initiatives, and to support the commercialization of new technologies from early development through go-to-market execution, is required for this role.
  • Strong understanding of cloud and software product development life cycles.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple complex projects simultaneously.
  • Excellent communication, organization, and presentation skills.
  • Proficiency in project management software such as MS Project, Smartsheet, Asana, or similar tools.
  • Fluency in technical software development terminology and tasks at a high level.

Performance Metrics

  • Budget adherence within approved tolerances.
  • Scope management and change control effectiveness.

  • Stakeholder satisfaction and cross-functional collaboration.

  • Be passionate and determined

📌 More info about culture here in our Culture Book.

In 2024, Kolsquare joined theteam.bluegroup, one of the largest private tech companies in Europe,. Since then, Kolsquare has grown through acquisition, welcoming Storyclash in Austria and Inflead in Italy in 2025.
Today, Kolsquare is also partnering with helloCash, another well-established Austrian SaaS company withinteam.blue, to help professionalize its People function as it scales.

Kolsquare and helloCash together represent 160+ people, mainly across Austria, France, Spain, Italy and other European entities.
You'll split your time 4 days/week with Kolsquare and 1 day/week with helloCash, supporting a population of around 35 people managers group-wide.

You'll report to Tatiana, VP People at Kolsquare, and work closely with Larissa, our People & Culture Manager already on the ground in Austria with Kolsquare & Hellocash, bringing seniority and support on the more complex topics (employee relations, works council, manager coaching).

Much of the HRBP function doesn't exist yet in its target form here. In year one, your main focus will be the Kolsquare–Storyclash integration, and alongside it, making visible progress on a few foundational areas (performance management, manager coaching and succession planning for critical roles).

  • a performance management cycle with manager accountability, and clear development paths across the team

  • measurable progress on engagement and retention

  • the Storyclash integration meaningfully advanced

  • constructive social dialogue with employee representative bodies where they apply

  • Act as a trusted advisor to managers and leadership, translating business needs into HR initiatives, org design, and workforce planning

  • Assess organizational readiness for change and design communication and adoption plans

  • Spot friction early — between teams, processes, and ways of working — and address it before it compounds

  • Build and drive the performance management cycle (goal-setting, calibration, ratings consistency)

  • Coach managers on feedback, underperformance, and team development

  • Facilitate talent reviews and succession planning for critical roles

  • Partner on retention strategies for critical talent, using turnover and risk analysis to target interventions

  • Advise managers on complex employee-relations matters, conflict resolution, and sensitive conversations

  • Serve as the main HR contact for the Austrian Works Council (Betriebsrat) and other employee representative bodies where they apply

  • Balance business needs, fairness, and legal risk, partnering with external counsel where needed

5) Engagement & People Data

  • Interpret engagement survey results and co-create action plans with managers, tailored to each company

  • Use people data (engagement, turnover, performance) to diagnose issues and shape recommendations for leaders

6) Talent Acquisition Support (helloCash)

  • Open and coordinate helloCash role openings (on average 3 job openings per year) in collaboration withteam.blue's central Talent Acquisition team, who lead full-cycle recruiting

  • Partner with hiring managers to define profiles and provide input throughout the process

YOUR PROFILE

  • 5+ years of HRBP experience, ideally in a fast-growing tech or SaaS environment (50-150 employees a strong plus)

  • A generalist grounding across talent, employee relations, performance, and engagement, with experience advising and influencing senior leaders

  • Strong knowledge of Austrian labor law; experience with collective agreements and works councils

  • Comfortable building HR processes and tools from the ground up, not just running an established framework

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management, high emotional intelligence, and real conflict-navigation skills

  • Fluent in German and English (written and spoken); French/spanish is a plus

Nice-to-haves ✌️

  • Experience partnering across a multi-entity or multi-brand group, or in a post-acquisition/integration context

  • Data-driven mindset with experience in HR reporting and people analytics; familiarity with HRIS platforms (e.g. HiBob) and engagement tools (e.g. Culture Amp) is a plus

  • Proven experience managing full-cycle recruiting and supporting hiring managers in defining role profiles

WHAT WE OFFER?

  • Full flexibility: full remote work with European hubs and 400+ coworking spaces worldwide.

  • Monthly and quarterly highlights in person to get together with other Kolsquarians for great team-building events.

  • The stability and resources of a profitable group, with the agility of a scale-up.

  • Continuous training opportunities and career development support.

THE RECRUITMENT PROCESS

Our hiring process consists of 6 steps:

  1. Talent Acquisition interview – 30 min

  2. Tatiana, VP People at Kolsquare – 45 min

  3. Annamarie Zalesak, People Lead at helloCash – 45 min

  4. Alexis, CFO – 30 min

  5. Julia, External Coach – 30 min

  6. Quentin, CEO – 30 min

The process is designed to give you the opportunity to meet key stakeholders across Kolsquare and helloCash and get a good understanding of the role, the team and the broader context.

LOCATION

Remote first in Europe, preferably residing in Spain or Austria.

This role serves as the primary connector between US Medical leadership, HCP-facing medical teams, omnichannel / content / training colleagues, and systems and platform teams to ensure digital solutions for medical are fit for purpose, adopted at scale, compliant, and continuously improved. A core mandate of this role is to drive adoption of systems and enablement solutions that measurably improve the utility and user satisfaction with associated digital tools and reduce administrative burden for medical teams, freeing capacity for high-value scientific exchange with HCPs and improving patient outcomes.

  • Next Best Action Optimization. Leverage AI insights to advance the relevance and uptake of suggestions for tailored and impactful HCP engagement plans.

Represent FME in the identification, business requirements, strategy, prioritization, governance, and adoption of new CRM platform and associated dashboards and reporting tools. Maintain data integrity standards across platforms and AI tools, manage access controls, and support audit readiness for associated data systems.

  • Bachelor's degree in a health science, life science, or business/digital/technology field required with 10+ years' experience
  • Advanced degree in health/life science and/or relevant technology or business field, such as MBA with 7+ years' experience, preferred

We bring together financing for projects through a mix of clean energy tax credits, federal and state grants, and mission-driven capital (loans and PRIs). As our projects and portfolios grow, we’re building the financial foundation to expand that work.

Who You Are

We’re looking for an experienced finance leader to own our finance function. This is a hands-on role with meaningful influence in an early-stage company. You’ll evaluate financial structures, deliver reliable reporting, and help build a scalable company. We want someone who is mission-driven and has experience in the same or a comparable field, brings practical judgment, rolls up their sleeves to build the strategy, and turns recommendations into action, while serving as a key thought partner to the CEO and executive leadership.

You’ll manage outsourced bookkeeping and coordinate specialist advisors. There are currently no direct reports for this position.

What You'll Do

Key Responsibilities:

  • Project finance and portfolio management.
  • Own project and portfolio models covering feasibility, solar and storage economics, tax credits, construction and long-term debt, and operating return.
  • Structure and execute project financing and financing partners, including capital stacks that combine tax credits and other grant funding; review term sheets and transaction documents.
  • Maintain project capital accounts and a consolidated view of financing obligations, available capital, loan repayments, and guarantee exposure.
  • Lead tax credit transfers and Direct Pay filings, tax credit insurance, and financing against expected credit.
  • Oversee begin-construction and safe-harbor documentation, placed-in-service deadline tracking, prevailing wage and apprenticeship records, domestic content, prohibited foreign entity (PFE), material-assistance requirements, and recapture tracking.
  • Evaluate entity structures, SPVs, Development and Holding Cos, including ownership implications Finance and accounting leadership.
  • Own monthly close and consolidated reporting; direct outsourced accounting providers, review their work, and resolve technical matters.
  • Own company budgeting, financial modeling, cash forecasts and variance analysis.
  • Manage liquidity and funding needs across operations and projects, including program-related investments (PRIs) and other foundation capital, debt facilities and SAFE investments.
  • Lead audit preparation and subsequent financial statement and federal grant audits with outside providers.
  • Coordinate corporate/project tax planning and filing.
  • Deliver reporting required by lenders, foundations, investors, and grant programs.
  • Support the CEO’s capital raising through analysis, diligence, data room preparation, and funder discussion.
  • Oversee billing, collections, payments, and the PEO relationship for payroll and benefits.
  • Improve close, reporting, forecasting, and compliance workflows.

What You Bring

  • 6+ years of progressive finance experience, including hands-on project finance or finance leadership in commercial solar, storage, or comparable energy development. Adjacent infrastructure experience is relevant where responsibilities closely match.
  • Experience in clean energy project finance, tax credit sales.
  • Experience in audit preparation.
  • Experience in federal/state grant accounting (including 2 CFR 200).
  • Experience managing multiple sets of books.
  • Experience implementing automation in finance workflows.
  • Experience managing project economics, multiple entities, and construction/long-term financing.
  • Experience delivering results in a growing entrepreneurial business with a small team and outside advisors.
  • Strong command of U.S. GAAP, financial statements, and project accounting; able to review technical work and own the numbers.
  • Advanced Excel and financial modeling skills.
  • Detail-oriented critical thinker and problem solver, with strong communication skills and sound business judgment.
  • Bachelor’s degree in accounting, finance, economics, or a related field.
  • CPA and/or MBA preferred.

What We Offer

Base salary of $150,000–$200,000, plus an annual performance bonus and profit-sharing plan. Placement within the range depends on relevant experience and qualifications.

  • Medical, dental, vision, and 401k

SOLV Energy is a leading provider of infrastructure services to the power industry, designing, building and maintaining utility scale solar, battery storage and high voltage substation projects nationwide.

Job Description Summary:

The Senior Commissioning Manager, Preconstruction, leads and owns Testing & Commissioning (T&Cx) activities for PV, BESS, and HV from Business Development (BD) through Limited Notice to Proceed (LNTP), including commissioning proposal development and preconstruction planning. This commissioning leader brings strong technical expertise and is accountable for PV, BESS, and HV commissioning estimates, contract requirements and exhibit reviews, commissioning scope definition, and leading the creation of a unified baseline commissioning schedule across all project commissioning activities (PV, BESS, HV, SCADA, Performance, and supporting systems). The role works closely with internal and external stakeholders, including Preconstruction, Engineering, OTS, Performance, Field Operations, and customers, to establish clear, executable commitments, ensure conformance to contractual requirements, and transfer an aligned commissioning package to the Operations team.

This role can be fully remote or hybrid, with regular in-office presence in the San Diego, CA Office. Specific location details and expectations will be discussed during the interview process.

Job Description:

*This job description reflects management's assignment of essential functions; it does not prescribe or restrict the tasks that may be assigned.


Position Responsibilities and Duties:

  • Own the commissioning workstream during BD and through contract execution, serving as the primary T&Cx point of contact and coordinating all required technical, commercial, estimating, and planning inputs.
  • Partner closely with the SOLV Preconstruction teams as well as other SMEs in SCADA, Performance Engineering, PV, HV and BESS Commissioning SME’s to integrate commissioning scope, estimates, schedules, and deliverables into overall project development and planning.
  • Represent Testing & Commissioning during EPC contract reviews focused on commissioning and quality exhibits, specifications, owner requirements, SOW, and vendor scopes to identify commissioning obligations, deliverables, acceptance criteria, milestones, and interfaces.
  • Drive and own Commissioning exhibit during contract negotiation process and review commissioning exhibits, scope language, assumptions, clarifications, and exclusions; coordinate proposed revisions and resolution of conflicting or incomplete requirements with Business Development, the SOLV Preconstruction team, Project Management, and Contracts/Legal.
  • Lead the development and presentation of SOLV’s standard commissioning requirements to clients; communicate the technical basis, align expectations, and resolve project-specific deviations with T&Cx leaders and Contracts/Legal.
  • Evaluate the feasibility and cost and schedule implications of proposed testing, energization, performance, reliability, witness, turnover, and warranty-related commissioning requirements with the appropriate technical leaders.
  • Maintain a commissioning requirements register linking contractual obligations to deliverables, responsible parties, due dates, and required evidence of completion; ensure plans, estimates, and schedules reflect those obligations.
  • Own commissioning estimate templates and the documented basis of estimate, including internal labor, subcontracted testing, OEM support, equipment, travel, and identified risk allowances, in close partnership with Estimating and T&Cx leaders.
  • Obtain and evaluate commissioning and testing proposals, validate scope coverage and exclusions, and provide technical and commercial recommendations to Procurement and project teams.
  • Own early commissioning schedule templates and milestone logic, integrating construction readiness, utility and OEM dependencies, energization, testing sequences, resource needs, and contractual completion dates with Scheduling and project teams.
  • Write, review, and maintain project-specific commissioning plans and DOR during BD and LNTP; coordinate technical review with HV, BESS/PV, Field Testing, Engineering, SCADA, OT Infrastructure, Safety, Quality, and Performance Engineering.
  • Ensure commissioning plans define scope, responsibilities, readiness gates, testing approach, documentation, acceptance criteria, and turnover requirements consistent with the contract and approved technical standards.
  • Lead commissioning scope and risk reviews with clients, business units, and internal stakeholders; document decisions, track open items, and escalate unresolved commitments before proposal submission or contract finalization.
  • Lead clear, timely, and professional client communication on commissioning scope, requirements, assumptions, risks, and commitments; explain complex technical issues, confirm mutual understanding, and document agreed decisions and follow-up actions.
  • Assess changes during BD and LNTP and update commissioning scope, estimates, schedules, and plans through established review and approval processes.
  • Lead a documented handoff to CPM & Portfolio Delivery and technical and field-execution leaders, including contractual requirements, approved plans, estimate assumptions, schedule logic, resource needs, open risks, and outstanding decisions.
  • Support execution teams in interpreting commissioning obligations, checking alignment of deliverables with requirements, and evaluating potential scope changes after handoff; the assigned Sr. CPM retains overall project-level execution ownership and coordination.
  • Standardize commissioning exhibits, estimating methods, planning templates, review checklists, and handoff requirements; incorporate actual costs, field feedback, and lessons learned with other T&Cx leaders.
  • Establish priorities and accountability for the commissioning preconstruction function; lead through cross-functional collaboration and drive technical rigor, consistency, and timely completion of deliverables. Ability to assess and prioritize the projects based on the timeline, client, and scope.

Knowledge Skills and Abilities

  • Advanced understanding of utility-scale commissioning from early scope development through energization, performance testing, turnover, and closeout, including PV, BESS, HV, and SCADA interfaces.
  • Strong ability to interpret commissioning contract requirements, evaluate technical and commercial risks, and translate obligations into clear plans, estimates, schedules, and deliverables.
  • Knowledge of commissioning cost drivers, estimating methods, resource planning, subcontractor scope development, schedule dependencies, and acceptance requirements.
  • Ability to author and critically review commissioning plans, exhibits, technical scope documents, and requirements registers with input from discipline specialists.
  • Expertise and understanding of relevant standards such IEC, ASTM, NETA, NEC and more.
  • Knowledge of pertinent PV, BESS and HV test equipment and procedures.
  • Knowledge of applicable electrical safety, testing, utility, OEM, and industry requirements and the ability to coordinate their application with technical leaders.
  • Strong facilitation, negotiation, and stakeholder-management skills, including the ability to resolve scope ambiguity and explain risks to leadership.
  • Excellent client communication skills, with the ability to present commissioning requirements confidently, explain complex technical and contractual issues clearly, listen effectively, and build alignment through concise written and verbal communication.
  • Ability to manage multiple pursuits and projects, meet proposal deadlines, maintain document control, and lead through cross-functional collaboration.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office, estimating tools, P6 or comparable scheduling systems, and document-control platforms.

Safety

  • Maintain a safety-focused approach to commission planning by incorporating applicable safety requirements and safe execution considerations into scope, estimates, schedules, and plans in coordination with Safety and T&Cx leaders.

Minimum Skills or Experience Requirements:

  • A minimum of 8 years of progressive experience in commissioning utility-scale electrical or renewable-energy projects, including responsibility for commissioning planning and technical scope development.
  • Demonstrated experience reviewing EPC contracts, commissioning exhibits, specifications, and acceptance requirements and translating them into executable project commitments.
  • Proven experience developing commissioning estimates, schedules, and plans, including coordination of internal teams, testing providers, OEMs, and project stakeholders.
  • Strong understanding of PV, BESS, HV, and SCADA commissioning interfaces, supported by practical project execution experience.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional teams, identify scope gaps and risks, and drive timely decisions across multiple projects or pursuits.
  • Excellent organizational, analytical, technical writing, and client-facing communication skills.
  • Experience in EPC preconstruction, proposal development, or commissioning contract administration is preferred.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Construction Management, or a related field is preferred; equivalent relevant experience will be considered.
  • Valid driver’s license.

Physical Demands and Environmental Conditions

  • Work is primarily performed in an office or remote work environment, with extended computer use, document review, and meetings.
  • Periodic travel is required for project visits, client meetings, scope reviews, and coordination with project and commissioning teams.
  • Site visits may involve walking on uneven terrain, climbing stairs, and exposure to weather, construction noise, moving equipment, and medium- and high-voltage facilities.
  • Ability to follow site access requirements and use required personal protective equipment.

About GoTab Inc

GoTab, Inc., a Restaurant Commerce Platform (RCP), helps large- and mid-sized restaurants, breweries, bars, hotels and other venues run lean, profitable operations while making guests even more satisfied. GoTab allows patrons to order and pay through a server, order and pay directly from their own mobile phones, or blend the two experiences all on one tab, through its all-in-one POS, mobile ordering and payment features, and kitchen display systems (KDS). The guest never has to download a mobile app or create a password. Founded in 2016 and based in Arlington, Virginia, GoTab serves hundreds of national, regional and local full-service accounts in the United States, Australia, Canada and Puerto Rico.

Fishbowl is GoTab's Guest Relationship Management Platform.

About the role

Fishbowl is looking for a hands-on, customer-obsessed Manager of Customer Success to lead our Account Management and Onboarding team and own the health of our largest restaurant brands. This role is accountable for successful launches, retention, and the overall experience of Fishbowl’s enterprise and multi-unit customers. You will lead and develop a team of 3–5 Account and Onboarding Managers while serving as a strategic partner to customers, GoTab teams, and senior leadership.

The Manager of Customer Success is a true player-coach. You will carry a select portfolio of strategic accounts while setting the standards, process, and operating rhythm for the broader team. You will also be the team’s go-to expert on how the platform works, from loyalty and offers to guest data and POS integrations, and work closely with GoTab’s Customer Success, Onboarding, and Product teams as the two platforms come closer together.

You will succeed in this role if you:

  • Balance team leadership with hands-on customer ownership when it matters most.
  • Are energized by complex launches and getting large brands live on time.
  • Can dig into a technical problem and tell a configuration issue from a product bug.
  • Build and develop high-performing teams with clear accountability and growth paths.
  • Hold a high bar for customer health, proactive communication, and execution.

If you are motivated by launching loyalty and guest marketing programs for some of the best-known restaurant brands, turning hard-won product knowledge into repeatable process, and building a Customer Success team that scales, this role is for you.

Responsibilities

Enterprise Onboarding & Launch Execution (30%)

  • Own onboarding from signed deal to first campaign, including kickoff, POS and integration setup, offer and loyalty configuration, location provisioning, training, and go-live.
  • Keep every client on one named owner and a committed launch date, and recover stalled launches quickly.
  • Run a weekly pipeline review to surface stalls, blockers, and risk early.
  • Keep HubSpot ownership, onboarding stages, and launch timelines accurate and current.

Team Leadership & Development (25%)

  • Directly manage a team of 2–5 Account and Onboarding Managers.
  • Hire, onboard, coach, and performance-manage team members with a focus on skill development and career growth.
  • Set clear role expectations, account coverage, and escalation paths so the team delivers consistently.
  • Conduct regular 1:1s, account reviews, and pipeline inspections to keep the team focused and effective.

Player-Coach Account Ownership (20%)

  • Carry a personal portfolio of strategic, high-value, or high-risk enterprise accounts.
  • Lead executive business reviews, renewal conversations, and escalation calls as needed.
  • Act as the point of escalation for customer issues that exceed the team’s scope or require senior judgment.
  • Identify expansion opportunities into loyalty, mobile apps, and new locations.

Product & Integration Expertise (15%)

  • Serve as the team’s subject matter expert on Fishbowl’s loyalty, promotions, guest data, WiFi, and mobile app products.
  • Diagnose integration issues across POS systems and hand Engineering clear, reproducible tickets.
  • Partner with GoTab’s Customer Success, Onboarding, Support, and Product teams on shared customers and integration rollouts.
