We enable the adaptation and spread of proven and scalable education solutions pioneered in India by Pratham Education Foundation to contexts across the global south through programming and technical assistance tailored to local realities. Today, Pratham reaches approximately 7.5 million children annually across 23 Indian states and union territories and an additional 1 million across 31 countries..

Through the Pratham Shah PraDigi Innovation Centre (PraDigi), Pratham International also seeks to create technology innovations for low-resource communities, and support models aimed at learning for school, work, and life for children and youth. We work on several cutting-edge projects in the domain of Generative AI, Automatic Speech Recognition, and Natural Language Processing.

The team’s innovative technology products include the Anytime Testing Model (ATM), an AI-enabled question generation and grading system that allows learners to be assessed on any topic, anytime; PadhAI: Reading Assessment App, which uses advanced speech recognition to evaluate children’s reading fluency in Hindi and eight Indian languages; and a suite of LLM-powered chatbots designed for diverse learning contexts: from BaalSakhi for early childhood care, to a skilling interview bot for youth employment readiness, and OCR-based analysis tools that digitize and assess student work at scale.

At Pratham International, we build for the long term. Whether it’s ensuring products are truly accessible across rural India and the global south through languages, building datasets to ensure context and accuracy for products, or gathering feedback from the field. Backed by partners like Google.org, Anthropic, and the Gates Foundation, we are committed to building digital public goods that ensure every child is in school and learning well.

Description of the Role
Pratham International, through its wholly-owned subsidiary in India (PULS Pvt. Ltd.), is looking to hire an AI Engineer for the PraDigi Initiative.

As an ASR Engineer, you will lead the development and deployment of speech recognition systems for automated reading assessment across multiple languages. The engineer will work across the full ASR pipeline: from supervising data collection, annotation, data preparation and model training to decoding, alignment, error analysis, and deployment. This is a hands-on role at the intersection of speech recognition, multilingual NLP, and educational assessment.

Key responsibilities include:

Data Collection and Annotation

  • Provide technical inputs to speech data collection design, including sampling across languages, dialects, age groups, reading levels, recording environments, devices, and target items to ensure the dataset is representative and useful for model training and evaluation.
  • Define annotation guidelines and quality checks for transcripts, reading errors, disfluencies, background speech and other phenomena relevant to reading assessment.
  • Work with data and field teams to identify data gaps and annotation inconsistencies through model error analysis, and recommend targeted additional data collection or re-annotation where needed.
  • Help design annotation schemas and inter-annotator quality processes so labels are consistent enough for model training, alignment, and evaluation.

Model Training

  • Train, fine-tune, and evaluate ASR models for children’s read speech across multiple languages and accents.
  • Build pipelines for audio preprocessing, segmentation, normalization, transcription alignment, and model training.
  • Adapt existing ASR architectures such as Whisper, wav2vec 2.0, Conformer, CTC/RNN-T, or similar models for reading assessment.
  • Optimize models for practical deployment environments, including low-bandwidth, store-and-forward, server-based, and potentially offline/mobile inference.

Adopting for Reading Assessment

  • Develop approaches for accurately detecting substitutions, omissions, insertions, repetitions, partial-word attempts, hesitations and self-corrections. Implement forced alignment, phoneme-level alignment, or pronunciation-scoring approaches where required.
  • Conduct systematic error analysis by language, reading level, age, accent, gender, recording conditions, and device.
  • Collaborate with assessment experts and field teams to translate model outputs into measures such as reading accuracy, WCPM, fluency, and reading level.

Benchmarking

  • Define and track ASR metrics relevant to reading assessment, including WER/CER, word-level accuracy, error-detection precision/recall, alignment accuracy, and reading-score agreement with human evaluators.
  • Build reproducible experimentation and model-evaluation pipelines and maintain clear technical documentation.

Desired Experience and Qualification

We are looking for an AI/ML Engineer with ASR expertise that can own the ASR based reading assessment pipeline across multiple languages

  • A Degree in any Mathematics/Computer Science/Data Science or related STEM field
  • 3-5 years of full-time experience; at least 2 working in an AI/ML role
  • Strong experience in automatic speech recognition, speech processing, or spoken-language technologies.
  • Strong Python skills and experience with PyTorch or similar deep-learning frameworks.
  • Experience working with modern ASR architectures and toolkits such as Hugging Face Transformers, NeMo, Kaldi, or equivalent.
  • Understanding of ASR concepts including:

    -acoustic modelling

    -CTC / transducer / encoder-decoder architectures
    -decoding and beam search
    -language models
    -forced alignment
    -phoneme representations
    -WER/CER and ASR error analysis

  • Experience preparing and working with large-scale audio and transcription datasets.
  • Ability to diagnose model errors systematically rather than relying only on aggregate transcription accuracy.

Why join us?

  • Impact at a Global Scale: Your work will directly support the learning journeys of millions of children. With programs active in 31 countries, you will help build Digital Public Goods that bridge the gap for the millions of children across the Global South who still struggle with foundational literacy.
  • Unique Technical Challenges: We apply advanced machine learning where it is needed most. You will solve "last-mile" problems—such as training ASR models on children's voices and optimizing LLMs for offline, low-bandwidth environments—that are rarely addressed in the commercial sector.
  • A Culture of Growth and Evidence: At Pratham, we value rigorous testing and continuous learning. You will have the autonomy to experiment with the latest SOTA models, supported by a 5-year strategic roadmap and funding from partners like the Gates Foundation and Anthropic.
  • High-Calibre, Mission-Driven Team: You will work alongside a global team of experts from institutions like MIT, Harvard, and INSEAD. Our alumni have gone on to lead successful startups and international policy shifts, all while remaining dedicated to the goal of "Every Child in School and Learning Well."
  • Inclusive and Collaborative Environment: Join a diverse team that spans Asia, Africa, and Latin America. We value innovative thinking and local expertise, ensuring that the technology we build is deeply rooted in the realities of the communities we serve.

Employment Details

  • Contract Type: Full-Time Employment
  • Date of Joining: Immediate
  • Work from Anywhere in India: We offer a flexible, remote-first work environment for candidates based anywhere in India. While you have the autonomy to work from where you are most productive, you will have the unique opportunity to travel to our field locations periodically. These visits are essential to see your models in the hands of learners and to gather the real-world feedback that drives our innovation.
  • Competitive Remuneration: Salary is benchmarked against industry standards for AI roles and is commensurate with experience. As a global organization, we are committed to providing a package that recognizes the high-market value of your technical expertise alongside the deep social impact of your work.

To apply

  • Fill out the form attached
  • Shortlisted candidates will be contacted for further rounds
  • Please refer to this Guidance on Candidates AI Usage by Anthropic to understand how to present yourself to Pratham International effectively

Pratham International is an Equal Opportunity Employer
We are dedicated to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace. We welcome applications from all qualified individuals, regardless of race, gender, disability, or any other legally protected status.

jobs.description:
On ouvre le Benelux. On cherche la voix qui va nous y installer.

Trustt est la plateforme SaaS qui permet aux marques cosmétiques, nutrition et pharma de transformer leurs consommateurs en ambassadeurs : avis enrichis, contenus UGC, campagnes d'influence, données first-party. Plus de 150 marques nous font confiance, dont Pierre Fabre, Garancia et Arkopharma.

Nos marques clientes vendent déjà en Belgique et aux Pays-Bas. Notre présence sociale, elle, s'arrête à la frontière : tout ce qu'on publie est en français, pensé pour le marché français. On cherche un(e) community manager freelance, bilingue français-néerlandais, pour porter Trustt sur le marché Benelux, LinkedIn en tête.

Ce n'est pas de la traduction. Un post français traduit en néerlandais se repère en trois mots. On cherche quelqu'un qui écrit le néerlandais comme un natif et qui connaît les codes de la Flandre autant que ceux des Pays-Bas.

Vos missions

Tu portes la voix de Trustt en néerlandais. Adaptation, pas traduction, de notre ligne éditoriale : posts LinkedIn, contenus courts, prises de parole du fondateur. Tu décides de ce qui marche localement.

Tu animes la communauté Benelux. Réponses aux commentaires et aux messages, engagement sur les publications des marques et prospects locaux, veille sur les conversations beauté et nutrition de la région.

Tu construis le calendrier éditorial local. À partir de la ligne FR existante, tu proposes ce qu'on garde, ce qu'on adapte et ce qu'on écarte.

Tu remontes ce que tu vois. Sujets qui prennent, concurrents actifs, comptes à suivre. On veut ton œil sur le marché, pas seulement tes publications.

Vos compétences

2 ans minimum de community management ou de social media en B2B. Le secteur beauté, nutrition ou retail est un plus, le SaaS aussi, mais c'est la qualité de ton néerlandais écrit qui décide.

Ce qu'on cherche :

  • Néerlandais natif ou parfaitement bilingue, à l'écrit comme à l'oral
  • Français courant, l'équipe travaille en français
  • Tu maîtrises LinkedIn en B2B : formats, algorithme, ce qui fait réagir
  • Statut d'indépendant en règle (Belgique, Pays-Bas ou France)
  • Autonome sur 2-3 jours par mois : tu livres sans qu'on ait à relancer

Ce qui fait la différence :

  • Tu as déjà géré un compte B2B sur les deux marchés. Flandre et Pays-Bas, les codes ne sont pas les mêmes
  • Tu sais montrer des chiffres : portée, engagement, croissance d'audience sur un compte que tu as tenu
  • Tu as travaillé avec des marques beauté, nutrition ou pharma

Ce poste n'est pas fait pour toi si :

  • Ton néerlandais est scolaire, ou passe par un outil de traduction
  • Tu cherches un temps plein. C'est une mission récurrente de 2 à 3 jours par mois
  • Tu as besoin d'un brief détaillé pour chaque publication

Avantages

  • Mission freelance récurrente, 2 à 3 jours par mois, 250 à 300 € par jour selon expérience
  • Tu construis la présence Benelux depuis zéro, avec la main sur la ligne éditoriale locale

- Interlocuteur direct : le fondateur

- 100 % à distance

- Démarrage rapide

Pour candidater, envoie-nous : 1) ton CV ou ton profil LinkedIn ; 2) deux posts LinkedIn B2B que tu as écrits en néerlandais, avec leurs chiffres de portée et d'engagement ; 3) ton TJM et ta disponibilité.

Et un exercice court, parce qu'il nous en dira plus que n'importe quel CV. Réécris en néerlandais, pour une audience flamande, ce message : « Vos clients écrivent déjà sur vous. Trustt transforme ces avis en contenus qui vendent. » Trois versions, trois angles.

Pas de lettre de motivation. On veut des faits, pas des formules.

We are seeking an experienced and strategic Senior Medical Economics Analyst to drive data-informed decision-making across our Managed Services Organization (MSO). This role serves as a trusted analytics partner to operational and executive leaders, supporting key business functions including Provider Contracting, Network Development, Compliance, Claims Operations, Accounting, and Finance.


The Senior Medical Economics Analyst will oversee complex analytical initiatives, lead analysts, and transform healthcare data into actionable insights that improve operational efficiency, financial performance, quality outcomes, and total cost of care. This individual combines deep healthcare analytics expertise with leadership, business acumen, and a passion for leveraging data to solve complex organizational challenges.


You will focus on:

Data Analysis & Insights

    • Provider Network
    • Utilization Management
    • Clinical Quality
    • Financial Performance

Data Governance & Process Improvement

  • Promote data integrity, governance standards, and reporting consistency across analytics platforms and solutions.
  • Identify opportunities to automate reporting processes and streamline workflows through innovative analytical approaches.
  • Support enterprise data initiatives and contribute to the development of scalable analytics infrastructure and best practices.

The Skills, Experience & Education You Bring

  • Bachelor's degree in Analytics, Information Systems, Public Health, Healthcare Administration, Statistics, Economics, Computer Science, or a related field.

  • Excellent communication, presentation, stakeholder management, and project leadership skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Knowledge of value-based care, risk adjustment, population health management, and quality measurement programs.
  • Experience with healthcare interoperability standards, clinical data models, and data governance frameworks.

What Success Looks Like

In this role, you will:

  • Deliver trusted analytics that influence executive decision-making.
  • Enable operational teams to improve performance through actionable insights.
  • Drive automation and self-service reporting capabilities.
  • Enhance data quality, governance, and reporting consistency.
  • Contribute to improved financial outcomes, operational efficiency, provider performance, and total cost of care.

The Compensation for this position is $89,250 - $107,100/year


In addition, we provide a competitive compensation package that recognizes your experience, credentials, and education alongside a robust benefits program to meet your needs.

  • Excellent medical, vision, and dental coverage
  • 401k savings plan with a company match
  • Flexible time off and 9 Paid Holidays

You Share Our Mission & Values: 

Compassion

We act with empathy and a deep respect for the challenges faced by physicians and their patients. Our work is driven by a genuine commitment to improving lives and ensuring that care is delivered with dignity, understanding, and humanity.

Community

We foster a culture of collaboration--with physicians, patients across the healthcare ecosystem, and among our teams. By building strong, trusted relationships, we create a unified community focused on advancing patient care and physician well-being.

Excellence

We embrace change as a constant and respond swiftly to the evolving needs of the healthcare industry. With flexibility and forward-thinking, we adapt, innovate, and act decisively to keep physicians at the forefront.

jobs.title: Title Clearance Coordinator - Post Foreclosure
jobs.excerpt: OverviewAs a Title Clearance Coordinator, Post Sale, you are responsible for reviewing post-sale title commitments, identifying title defects or conveyance impediments, and coordinating timely resolution to support good and marketable title for conveyance, claim filing, third-party sale, or other post-foreclosure disposition.
jobs.description:
Overview

As a Title Clearance Coordinator, Post Sale, you are responsible for reviewing post-sale title commitments, identifying title defects or conveyance impediments, and coordinating timely resolution to support good and marketable title for conveyance, claim filing, third-party sale, or other post-foreclosure disposition. This role requires extreme attention to detail, strong follow-up discipline, sound judgment, and a commitment to meeting strict client, investor, agency, and regulatory timelines.

Post-Foreclosure Title Clearance and Conveyance

  • Review post-foreclosure title reports, title commitments, foreclosure deeds, vesting documents, legal descriptions, and related documentation to identify items that must be cleared prior to conveyance, claim submission, sale, or final disposition.
  • Coordinate resolution of title defects, liens, judgments, prior mortgages, deed issues, vesting discrepancies, mobile home issues, probate matters, tax issues, municipal violations, and other exceptions that may impact good and marketable title.
  • Work with attorneys, title vendors, clients, servicers, investors, agencies, property preservation teams, claims teams, and internal business partners to cure post-sale title and conveyance issues.
  • Monitor conveyance timelines and title clearance milestones to help ensure compliance with client, investor, agency, and regulatory requirements.
  • Review, document, and escalate title issues that may cause conveyance delays, reconveyance risk, claim curtailments, or loss of reimbursement eligibility.

Reporting, Pipeline Management, and Quality Assurance

  • Utilize reports, queues, dashboards, client systems, and internal platforms to manage a pipeline of post-foreclosure title clearance and conveyance files.
  • Perform daily follow-up on outstanding title curative items, vendor requests, attorney updates, claim-related documentation, and client or investor requirements.
  • Maintain accurate file notes, status updates, documentation, and audit-ready records reflecting title review findings, clearance efforts, and resolution steps.
  • Review work for accuracy, completeness, and adherence to process requirements before files move to conveyance, claim, sale, or final disposition stages.

Communicate and Collaborate

· Respond to emails, system tasks, vendor requests, and phone inquiries in a timely and professional manner.

· Act as a liaison for clients, servicers, attorneys, title vendors, internal staff, outside agencies, and other stakeholders involved in post-foreclosure title clearance and conveyance.

· Communicate openly and respectfully with clients, team members, vendors, and leaders regarding title status, risks, escalations, and next steps.

· Support client and lender relationships by providing timely updates, accurate information, and proactive issue resolution.

· Additional duties, as assigned.

What you will bring (Qualifications)

  • High School diploma or equivalent
  • 1-5 years of experience in default servicing, title clearance, foreclosure, post-foreclosure, REO, conveyance, claims, mortgage servicing, or related real estate/mortgage operations
  • Working knowledge of real estate titles, foreclosure deeds, post-sale title review, deed preparation, legal descriptions, liens, judgments, and title curative processes
  • Familiarity with investor and agency timelines or requirements, including FHA/HUD, VA, USDA, FNMA, FHLMC, or similar guidelines, preferred
  • Strong customer service focus and ability to communicate effectively with clients, attorneys, vendors, and internal partners
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment, manage competing priorities, and meet strict deadlines
  • Strong attention to detail, follow-up discipline, and documentation accuracy
  • Self-motivated: ability to work with minimal supervision
  • Capability to work both independently and as part of a team
  • Ability to work overtime, as needed
  • Problem-solving mindset with ability to identify risks, escalate issues, and multitask
  • Proficiency with computers, including Microsoft Office and mortgage servicing or title production systems

The Quality Assurance System Tester will support a large-scale agile software development program for the GrantSolutions contract, including both new software capabilities and ongoing support for legacy system functionality. The tester will design and execute manual and automated tests, support developer-led quality practices, analyze defects, verify code changes, and help ensure that new and existing system capabilities meet functional, technical, security, accessibility, and operational requirements before production release.

What You Will Do:

We are seeking a Quality Assurance System Tester with strong software testing, test automation, and application validation experience to support the GrantSolutions software delivery environment. This role will work directly with developers, Product Owners, Scrum Masters, integration engineers, data teams, DevSecOps engineers, vendors, and Federal stakeholders to verify that new software capabilities and supported legacy functionality are reliable, secure, accessible, data-consistent, and ready for incremental release.

The Quality Assurance System Tester will participate across the SDLC by reviewing user stories and technical designs, developing test scenarios, validating software behavior, supporting application and data testing, documenting and retesting defects, and contributing to automated regression testing within CI/CD pipelines. This individual will help strengthen engineering quality, improve release confidence, and reduce production risk across new application components, existing legacy functionality, and system integrations.

  • Participate throughout the software development lifecycle by reviewing user stories, acceptance criteria, technical designs, data mappings, interface specifications, and release plans to define complete and traceable test coverage.

  • Design, execute, and maintain manual and automated test cases for application features, integrations, workflows, reports, database changes, regression scenarios, smoke testing, and user acceptance testing.

  • Develop and maintain automated test scripts, test suites, reusable test data, and regression assets that can be executed consistently across development, test, staging, and release environments.

  • Perform end-to-end software testing across new application components, supported legacy system functionality, data exchanges, background jobs, user workflows, reporting outputs, and role-based access paths.

  • Support integration and database testing by validating data persistence, data transformation logic, error handling, access behavior, and downstream processing outcomes.

  • Document defects clearly with reproducible steps, expected and actual results, test evidence, severity, priority, environment details, and supporting screenshots or logs when appropriate.

  • Collaborate closely with developers during sprint execution to reproduce defects, analyze logs or test results, validate fixes, clarify expected software behavior, and support code promotion and release readiness decisions.

  • Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines where appropriate and support automated test execution, results review, failure analysis, test environment coordination, and maintenance of reusable test data.

  • Support accessibility, security, performance, data quality, and operational readiness testing in coordination with specialized teams and approved program standards.

  • Contribute to continuous improvement of software quality practices, test automation frameworks, defect management, traceability, release validation, and engineering quality metrics.

What You Will Need:

  • Must be able to OBTAIN and MAINTAIN a Federal or DoD "PUBLIC TRUST"; candidates must obtain approved adjudication of their PUBLIC TRUST prior to onboarding with Guidehouse. Candidates with an ACTIVE PUBLIC TRUST or SUITABILITY are preferred.

  • Bachelor’s degree required.

  • Minimum of FOUR (4) years of experience in software quality assurance, software testing, application testing, test automation, systems testing, or related software development lifecycle roles.

  • Hands-on experience designing, executing, and documenting test cases for application features, integrations, database changes, workflows, regression testing, smoke testing, and user acceptance testing.

  • Hands-on experience developing, maintaining, and executing automated test scripts using test automation tools, frameworks, scripting languages, or code-based testing approaches.

  • Experience testing web-based applications, data integrations, interfaces, reports, background processes, and end-to-end business workflows across multiple software environments.

  • Experience with defect tracking, test management, requirements traceability, test evidence capture, test data preparation, release validation, and defect retesting.

  • Understanding of the software development lifecycle, agile delivery, DevSecOps practices, version control, branching and merging concepts, CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and release management.

  • Ability to interpret user stories, acceptance criteria, business rules, interface specifications, data mappings, architecture guidance, and technical design documentation.

  • Ability to troubleshoot test failures, isolate defects, analyze logs, query data when needed, validate fixes, and communicate software quality risks clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Strong documentation skills, including the ability to maintain test plans, test cases, test scripts, traceability matrices, defect records, test evidence, and release readiness summaries.

  • Strong problem-solving, collaboration, and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively as part of a software delivery team that includes Product Owners, developers, integration engineers, data teams, DevSecOps engineers, vendors, security teams, and business stakeholders.

  • Self-motivated, detail-oriented, and able to operate effectively in fast-paced, dynamic environments with competing testing priorities and release timelines.

What Would Be Nice To Have:

  • Experience supporting software development initiatives that include both new application capabilities and ongoing validation of legacy system functionality within enterprise or government environments.

  • Experience supporting federal or government IT programs involving legacy systems, shared services, interoperability, cloud environments, data governance, system integrations, or phased capability delivery.

  • Experience with test automation tools or frameworks such as Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, Cucumber, Postman/Newman, REST Assured, JUnit, TestNG, or similar tools.

  • Quality, agile, testing, automation, cloud, or security certification preferred, such as ISTQB, Certified ScrumMaster, SAFe, AWS Cloud Practitioner, Security+, or similar credentials.

The annual salary range for this position is $85,000.00-$141,000.00. Compensation decisions depend on a wide range of factors, including but not limited to skill sets, experience and training, security clearances, licensure and certifications, and other business and organizational needs.

  • Serve as the country-level regulatory SME point of contact through the life of assigned projects.
  • Ensure all relevant documents are submitted to the Trial Master File (TMF) in compliance with SOPs and Customer requirements.
  • Serve as country level regulatory SME maintaining country intelligence in regulatory intelligence systems, contributing and validating information as the scope of the regulatory intelligence system expands. Completes / contributes to Regulatory Impact Assessments and implements Operational Actions as regulations change.
  • Develop or support the creation of local country regulation training materials.
  • Support training and mentoring more junior Country Regulatory Specialists.
  • When required, provide SME knowledge and support to the Syneos Health Procurement team in managing Ethics/IRB vendors.
  • Ensure continuous improvement of quality in all components at the country level where assigned (submissions, communication to Competent Authorities and ECs, etc.). Provide input to SOPs and WIs.

Qualifications


  • Minimum of a BA or BS preferred
  • 5-6 years minimum experience working in a Clinical Research environment, or an equivalent combination of education and experience that provides the necessary knowledge, skills and abilities to perform this job.

  • Knowledge and interpersonal skills necessary to effectively train and mentor more junior Country Regulatory Specialists.

  • Ability to manage competing priorities and work in a dynamic fast-paced environment.
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently as well as part of a team.

Over the past 5 years, we have worked with 94% of all Novel FDA Approved Drugs, 95% of EMA Authorized Products and over 200 Studies across 73,000 Sites and 675,000+ Trial patients.

No matter what your role is, you’ll take the initiative and challenge the status quo with us in a highly competitive and ever-changing environment. Learn more about Syneos Health.

jobs.excerpt: Position OverviewSBS is seeking a skilled AI Engineer to join its Data & AI / Engineering organization in the UK or EU.
jobs.description:
Position Overview

SBS is seeking a skilled AI Engineer to join its Data & AI / Engineering organization in the UK or EU. This role will focus on designing, building, and deploying AI-driven solutions that enhance SBS products and client offerings.

The ideal candidate will combine strong software engineering fundamentals with applied AI/ML expertise, enabling the development of scalable, production-grade AI systems in a regulated financial services environment.

Location: UK or EU

Hybrid/Remote: Remote (Ocasional travel required)

Responsibilities

AI Solution Development

  • Design, build, and deploy AI/ML models and intelligent applications across SBS platforms
  • Develop solutions leveraging:
  • Machine Learning (ML)
  • Natural Language Processing (NLP)
  • Generative AI (GenAI / LLMs)
  • Translate business requirements into technical AI solutions that deliver measurable impact

Model Deployment & MLOps

  • Implement and manage end-to-end ML pipelines, from data ingestion to model deployment and monitoring
  • Collaborate with DevOps and engineering teams to ensure scalable, reliable production deployment
  • Maintain and optimize model performance, accuracy, and efficiency over time

Product Integration

  • Integrate AI capabilities into core banking, payments, and digital platforms
  • Work closely with Product Managers, Architects, and Developers to embed AI into customer-facing solutions
  • Support API development and microservices architecture for AI-driven features

Data Engineering Collaboration

  • Partner with data engineers to ensure data quality, availability, and pipeline integrity
  • Work with structured and unstructured datasets across large-scale, distributed systems

Innovation & Continuous Improvement

  • Stay current with advancements in AI, GenAI, and emerging technologies
  • Contribute to experimentation, prototyping, and innovation initiatives
  • Identify opportunities to improve automation, efficiency, and decision-making through AI

Qualifications

Software Architecture & Design

  • Application architecture: Strong grasp of clean/hexagonal architecture, dependency injection, SOLID principles, and protocol-based interfaces. Can design well-structured Python services with clear separation of concerns, testable components, and maintainable codebases. This is not optional — the existing system follows these patterns and new code must be consistent.
  • API design: Experience designing and maintaining RESTful API contracts. Understands OpenAPI specifications, versioning strategies, schema evolution, and backward compatibility. Can own the API surface that internal consumers depend on.
  • System design: Distributed systems thinking — understands event-driven patterns, asynchronous communication, eventual consistency, and the trade-offs of different integration approaches. Can reason about how components interact across service boundaries.
  • Data modelling: Can design domain models, define data flows between system components, and make pragmatic schema design decisions. Understands how data structures affect downstream consumers and system evolution.

AI & LLM Application Skills

  • LLM application development: Hands-on experience building production applications powered by LLMs. Must go beyond API calls — RAG pipelines, chain-of-thought reasoning, structured output parsing, multi-step workflows. Candidates who have only fine-tuned models or only called a single provider’s API do not qualify.
  • Model-agnostic design: This is a sovereign AI system. The candidate must design against standardised API interfaces (OpenAI-compatible, LiteLLM, or equivalent abstraction layers), not couple to any single provider. Must understand model routing, fallback strategies, and how to build systems that can swap underlying models without application-layer rewrites. Experience limited to a single commercial API (OpenAI, Google, Anthropic) without abstraction is insufficient.
  • Agentic system design: Demonstrated experience designing multi-step AI systems where the model makes decisions about what to do next. This could be via LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, custom agent loops, or any framework — the underlying patterns (ReAct, plan-and-execute, reflection) matter more than the tool.
  • Prompt engineering depth: Can demonstrate iterative prompt development for complex tasks. Understands few-shot, chain-of-thought, XML/structured prompting, and the behavioural differences between model families and sizes. Critically, understands that prompt strategies must adapt when moving between frontier and smaller OSS models.

Python Engineering

Production Python: Strong async Python with FastAPI or equivalent framework. Comfortable with Pydantic for data validation, SQLAlchemy for data access, and structured logging (structlog). Writes clean, testable, well-documented code with proper type hints. This is a software engineering role that builds AI systems — not a data science role that happens to write Python. Safeguards for hallucinated tools, loops, partial completion, unsafe actions. Understands async trade-offs, batching, streaming, latency accumulation

Engineering Qualities

  • Works within existing systems: The candidate joins a substantial existing codebase and architecture. They must be comfortable reading, understanding, and extending code they did not write — not lobbying to rewrite it.
  • Production mindset: Thinks about error handling, retry logic, graceful degradation, observability, and security as first-class concerns. Understands that agentic autonomy creates new failure modes that must be anticipated.
  • Clear communicator: Can explain technical trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders. Can write clear design documents. Can articulate why an agentic approach is or is not appropriate for a given problem.

 

Company Overview

At SBS, we’re more than just a technology company, we’re a global fintech partner helping banks and financial institutions transform, innovate, and grow. With over 5,000 employees worldwide and clients in more than 80 countries, our solutions power everything from digital banking and lending to payments and core banking systems.

As part of 74Software, we’re backed by a group of leading software companies delivering mission-critical solutions worldwide. Our focus is on delivering long-term value, leveraging cutting-edge technology, and fostering strong client partnerships. Join us and be part of a collaborative, forward-thinking team shaping the future of finance.

Why SBS?

At SBS, we’re committed to supporting our employees in every aspect of their lives, from health and wellbeing to financial security and lifestyle perks.

We offer benefits that allow you to thrive at work and beyond, including health coverage, retirement plans, paid time off, flexible work, career development, competitive pay, and global culture perks.

Equal Opportunity Employer

We are committed to providing equal opportunities and ensuring a fair and inclusive recruitment process. We do not discriminate on the basis of age, disability, gender, sexual orientation, race, religion, or any other protected characteristic.

Overview

About the role

Consilio's Legal Management Consulting team advises corporate legal departments on how to improve their operating models, processes, governance and use of technology.

As Senior Manager, Advisory, you will lead complex, multi-workstream client engagements and serve as a trusted advisor to General Counsel, Heads of Legal Operations and other senior executives. You will translate ambiguous business challenges into clear strategies, practical transformation plans and measurable outcomes.

You will be accountable for engagement quality, client relationships, team performance and commercial outcomes. You will also help shape Consilio's advisory offerings, develop consulting talent, support business development and strengthen the practice's market position.

Responsibilities

What you will do

  • Own and lead complex advisory engagements across legal operations, legal technology, contracting transformation and Legal GenAI, from scoping through executive presentation and implementation planning.
  • Serve as the primary day-to-day advisor to senior client stakeholders, building trusted relationships and aligning diverse legal, procurement, technology, finance and business interests.
  • Define engagement strategy, workplans, governance, deliverables and success measures, and maintain accountability for scope, quality, budget, risks and timelines.
  • Lead current-state assessments across organisation, process, technology, governance, data, service delivery and ways of working, identifying root causes and prioritised opportunities.
  • Design future-state legal operating models, including service delivery, organisational roles, governance, intake and triage, resourcing, process, technology and performance management.

  • Lead legal technology strategy, selection and health-check engagements across CLM, ELM, matter management, intake, workflow, document management and related platforms.

  • Oversee the development of prompt libraries, testing methodologies, evaluation criteria, user guidance and sustainable adoption approaches.

  • Synthesise complex qualitative and quantitative information into executive-level findings, strategic options and practical recommendations.
  • Develop transformation roadmaps that reflect business priorities, investment requirements, dependencies, organisational readiness, risk and available resources.

  • Lead or materially contribute to proposals, RFP responses, statements of work, pricing, scoping and effort estimation.
  • Identify and develop opportunities to expand client relationships, introduce additional capabilities and support revenue growth.
  • Develop methodologies, accelerators, points of view, training materials, whitepapers and other thought leadership that differentiate Consilio in the market.
  • Maintain strong awareness of developments across legal operations, contracting, legal technology and GenAI and translate them into practical implications for clients.

Qualifications

  • 8-10+ years of relevant experience in legal consulting, legal operations, legal technology, contract management, business transformation, professional services or an in-house legal function.
  • A degree in law, business, finance, information technology, information systems, data science or another relevant discipline.
  • Demonstrated success leading complex consulting engagements or enterprise transformation programmes with multiple workstreams and senior stakeholders.
  • Deep understanding of how corporate legal departments operate, including the interplay among people, process, technology, governance, data and service delivery.
  • Strong executive advisory skills, including problem structuring, facilitation, stakeholder alignment, decision support and the development of practical recommendations.
  • Credibility with General Counsel, Heads of Legal Operations and other senior functional leaders, with the judgement to navigate sensitive or ambiguous client situations.
  • Excellent written, verbal and presentation skills, including experience delivering executive-level findings, business cases, roadmaps and strategic recommendations.
  • Strong engagement management capability, including scope, budget, team, priorities, risks, dependencies and client expectations.
  • Experience leading and developing consulting teams, reviewing complex work and maintaining consistent delivery standards.
  • Strong knowledge of the legal technology market and the principal platforms used by corporate legal departments.
  • Practical understanding of GenAI and its application, risks and governance considerations within legal and professional services environments.
  • Experience leading CLM readiness, selection, implementation or contracting transformation engagements.
  • Experience with legal operating model design, legal operations strategy or broader legal transformation programmes.
  • Experience developing business cases, transformation roadmaps, technology strategies or investment recommendations.
  • Commercial acumen, including experience supporting proposals, scoping, pricing and account growth while protecting delivery quality.

Helpful but not essential

  • Experience with Legal GenAI vendor selection, pilots, implementation, governance or adoption programmes.

  • Previous consulting or professional services experience with large multinational organisations.

  • A meaningful role in shaping Consilio’s consulting methodologies, offerings and market propositions.

jobs.description:
Job Title:

Senior Principal, Distribution Optimization

Job Description:

Position Summary

The Senior Principle, Distribution Optimization is responsible for developing and executing the enterprise distribution strategy to improve network efficiency, service performance, inventory flow, labor productivity, scalability, and cost-to-serve across the distribution and fulfillment network. This role leads the design, optimization, and transformation of distribution operations, facilities, processes, systems, and operating models to support current and future business growth.


The position is accountable for evaluating:

  • Distribution network configuration
  • Facility footprint
  • Automation opportunities
  • Third-party logistics (3PL) strategies
  • Outsource versus insource operating models

This leader develops business cases, leads network and facility optimization initiatives, oversees implementation of transformational solutions, and establishes governance frameworks to ensure measurable operational and financial results.


Working closely with operations, supply chain, customer logistics, procurement, finance, and technology stakeholders, the Senior Principle, Distribution Optimization drives continuous improvement and long-term capability development across the distribution network. Responsibility for day-to-day warehouse operations, execution, labor management, customer service delivery, and operational performance remains within the regional logistics operations organizations.


Key Responsibilities:


Distribution Network Strategy

  • Develop and execute the enterprise distribution optimization roadmap.
  • Design and optimize distribution networks to support growth, service, and profitability objectives.
  • Evaluate facility footprint, capacity requirements, inventory positioning, and customer service strategies.
  • Conduct network studies and modeling efforts to optimize service and cost performance.
  • Develop cost-to-serve models supporting strategic distribution decisions.
  • Lead long-range distribution planning initiatives.

Distribution Operating Model Design

  • Evaluate and recommend distribution operating models, including internally managed, outsourced, 3PL, and hybrid solutions.
  • Lead outsource versus insource assessments for warehousing, fulfillment, value-added services, and distribution support functions.
  • Develop business cases supporting network and operating model changes.
  • Establish governance frameworks and performance expectations for strategic distribution partners.
  • Ensure future-state distribution capabilities support business growth and complexity.

Automation & Facility Optimization

  • Develop the enterprise warehouse automation strategy.
  • Evaluate robotics, automated storage and retrieval systems (ASRS), warehouse execution technologies, and material handling solutions.
  • Lead facility optimization and capacity improvement initiatives.
  • Drive implementation of operational technologies that improve productivity and service.
  • Support capital planning and investment prioritization decisions.

Distribution Systems & Technology

  • Establish the distribution technology roadmap.
  • Partner with IT to optimize WMS, automation control systems, inventory visibility, and reporting platforms.
  • Drive system standardization and integration across the network.
  • Identify opportunities to leverage analytics and digital technologies to improve performance.

Continuous Improvement & Analytics

  • Develop distribution KPI frameworks and executive reporting.
  • Lead continuous improvement initiatives focused on labor productivity, inventory flow, service performance, and facility utilization.
  • Conduct network and facility performance analyses.
  • Identify opportunities to reduce operating costs while improving customer service.
  • Measure and communicate benefits achieved from optimization programs.

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Partner with Operations, Customer Logistics, Procurement, Finance, Planning, and IT.
  • Lead cross-functional network optimization and transformation projects.
  • Present strategic recommendations and business cases to executive leadership.
  • Drive change management and organizational adoption of new capabilities and processes.
  • Build long-term distribution optimization capabilities across the organization.

Qualifications:


Required

  • Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Logistics, Engineering, Operations Management, Business, or related field.
  • 15+ years of progressive leadership experience in distribution, warehousing, fulfillment, logistics, supply chain, network design, or related disciplines.
  • Demonstrated experience leading distribution network and facility optimization initiatives.
  • Experience evaluating and implementing 3PL operating models, automation technologies, and distribution systems.
  • Strong analytical, financial, and business case development capabilities.
  • Proven success leading large-scale cross-functional transformation initiatives.

Preferred

  • Master's degree in Supply Chain, Engineering, Operations, Logistics, or Business Administration.
  • APICS/ASCM CSCP, CPIM, CLTD, Lean Six Sigma Green Belt, Black Belt, or equivalent professional certifications.
  • Experience leading enterprise-wide optimization, transformation, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Experience operating within complex, multi-site, global supply chain networks.

Compensation: The pay range for this role is: $170,000-$220,000/yr with pay commensurate upon the candidate's experience.

Workforce Operations | Shift Coordination | Scheduling | Client Operations

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring an Operations Specialist to oversee day-to-day workforce operations and ensure seamless execution across a live scheduling platform.

This is not an administrative support role.

You’ll own the complete shift lifecycle—from workforce onboarding and scheduling to real-time issue resolution and client communication—ensuring every shift is filled, every professional is supported, and every client receives exceptional service.

You’ll work across:

  • Workforce coordination
  • Shift fulfillment
  • Scheduling
  • Attendance monitoring
  • Client communication
  • Live operations
  • Process improvement

If you thrive in fast-paced operational environments, enjoy solving problems in real time, and take ownership from start to finish, this role is built for you.

What You’ll Own

Shift Fulfillment & Scheduling

  • Own the end-to-end shift fulfillment process.
  • Respond quickly to incoming client staffing requests.
  • Assign professionals to shifts based on availability and qualifications.
  • Confirm attendance and workforce availability before every shift.
  • Ensure shifts are filled efficiently while maintaining service quality.
  • Monitor fulfillment metrics and staffing performance.

Workforce Onboarding & Engagement

Live Operations & Issue Resolution

  • Respond immediately to:
    • Late arrivals
    • No-shows
    • Shift cancellations
    • Scheduling conflicts
  • Coordinate replacement coverage when needed.
  • Communicate directly with clients, on-site managers, and workforce professionals.
  • Resolve operational issues while maintaining a high level of customer service.

Operations & Process Improvement

  • Maintain organized operational records and tracking systems.
  • Keep attendance, fulfillment, and scheduling documentation accurate and up to date.
  • Identify recurring operational bottlenecks.
  • Recommend workflow improvements that increase speed, reliability, and service quality.
  • Support continuous improvement initiatives across operations.

Must-Have Qualifications

    • Staffing
    • Scheduling
    • Client operations

Core Skills

  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.

  • Experience coordinating multiple priorities simultaneously.
  • Strong stakeholder management and relationship-building skills.
  • Comfortable working with live scheduling platforms and operational systems.
  • Reliable computer setup and high-speed internet connection.

  • Experience working in:
    • Staffing companies
    • Workforce marketplaces
    • Startup environments
  • Experience with:
    • Shift-based workforce operations
    • Attendance monitoring
    • Clock-in management
    • Workforce scheduling
    • Fulfillment KPIs
  • Background in:
    • Healthcare
    • Hospitality
    • Logistics
    • Staffing
    • On-demand workforce management
  • Experience improving operational workflows and efficiency.

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • Highly organized and execution-focused.
  • Calm and solutions-oriented under pressure.
  • Comfortable managing multiple live operational priorities.
  • Strong communicator with clients and workforce professionals.
  • Proactive and ownership-driven.
  • Adaptable, resourceful, and process-oriented.
  • Able to anticipate problems before they escalate.

What a Typical Day Looks Like

  • Review incoming staffing requests and prioritize fulfillment.
  • Contact workforce professionals to confirm availability.
  • Monitor active shifts and attendance in real time.
  • Resolve scheduling conflicts and secure replacement coverage.
  • Coordinate with clients and on-site managers throughout the day.
  • Update operational systems and documentation.
  • Identify opportunities to improve scheduling and operational workflows.

In short: You keep daily workforce operations running smoothly by ensuring every shift is filled, every issue is resolved quickly, and every client receives reliable, high-quality service.

Key Metrics for Success (KPIs)

  • Shift fill rate.
  • Time-to-fill open shifts.
  • Attendance reliability and reduced no-show rates.
  • Response time to operational and client requests.
  • Resolution time for live operational issues.
  • Accuracy of scheduling and operational documentation.
  • Client satisfaction and workforce reliability.

Why This Role Stands Out

  • High-impact operational role at the center of daily business execution.
  • Direct ownership of workforce operations and client success.
  • Fast-paced environment with measurable performance.
  • Opportunity to improve systems and operational processes.
  • Fully remote with long-term growth opportunities.
  • Clear career progression into:

    • Workforce Operations Lead

Interview Process

  1. Application Review
  2. Spark Hire Intro Video (3–5 minutes)

  4. Scenario-Based Operations Interview
  5. Final Client Interview
  6. Offer & Background Verification

What Happens After You Apply

Right after you apply, you’ll receive an email invitation from Spark Hire to record your Intro Video. This short, self-recorded video is the final step that completes your application and can be recorded whenever it’s convenient for you.

Instead of repeating yourself across multiple screening calls, you’ll introduce yourself once, and your video will be shared with the hiring team. This helps hiring managers evaluate your communication style early, making future interviews more meaningful and reducing unnecessary interview rounds.

Don’t overthink it—you can record your video as many times as you’d like before submitting it. Only your final submission will be reviewed.

Please keep an eye on both your inbox and spam folder for your Spark Hire invitation after submitting your application.

Apply Now

If you’re an organized operations professional who thrives in fast-moving environments, enjoys coordinating people and processes, and takes ownership of execution from start to finish, we’d love to hear from you. Apply today and help deliver reliable workforce operations that keep clients and teams running smoothly.

jobs.excerpt: Job DescriptionThe OpportunityThe College of Business (COB) at Embry-Riddle Aeronautical University Worldwide (ERAU-W) is seeking a Full Time Tenure-Track Faculty to join the COB and Department of Business Administration as Assistant/Associate Professor in Aviation Commercial Management.
jobs.description:
Job Description

The Opportunity

The College of Business (COB) at Embry-Riddle Aeronautical University Worldwide (ERAU-W) is seeking a Full Time Tenure-Track Faculty to join the COB and Department of Business Administration as Assistant/Associate Professor in Aviation Commercial Management.

This is a remote position and will require an at home office. The successful candidate will teach graduate and undergraduate commercial management courses. The typical teaching load is 24 credit hours per academic year, which extends from 1 August to 31 May. The role represents a great opportunity to work alongside dedicated colleagues committed to making a difference to industry and features key lifestyle benefits such as the opportunity to work at home, paid holidays in addition to summer release (June-July off), exceptional health benefits, generous retirement contributions and Embry-Riddle tuition waivers for faculty and their family members. Faculty will teach with innovative academic technologies and delivery platforms almost entirely online. Courses reside within the College of Business and have a strong business and commercial aviation focus.

Responsibilities:

  • Teach primarily commercial aviation business courses

  • Develop, maintain, and assess courses, particularly those that feature on the College’s M.S. Airline and Airport and Air Mobility-related degree programs

  • Develop and update curricula as needed

  • Demonstrate a strong commitment to teaching, staying current in the profession, and providing service to the department, college, university, and profession

  • Limited travel for meetings and conferences will be required

About the College of Business

Embry-Riddle Aeronautical University (ERAU) is the world’s largest, fully accredited university specializing in aviation, aerospace, and related fields. ERAU is a nonprofit, independent institution offering more than 80 baccalaureate, master’s, and Ph.D. degree programs. The Worldwide campus has an enrollment of over 20,500 students. Courses are delivered online via Canvas, synchronously via Zoom, and face-to-face around the globe in the United States, Europe, Asia, South America, and the Middle East. Over the last decade Embry-Riddle Worldwide has earned high rankings as one of the Best Online Bachelors programs from US News and World Report often ranked in the top 5. In 2026, the ranking was 11.

The Worldwide College of Business is a highly entrepreneurial organization with a broad reach in the aviation industry. COB values and supports activities that are directed at solving business challenges, especially in the broader aviation sector. The college offers two Associate’s Degrees (Aviation Business Administration and Technical Management), six Bachelor’s degrees (Aviation Business Administration, Business Analytics, Leadership, Logistics and Supply Chain Management, Project Management and Technical Management), and eight Master’s degrees (Business Administration in Aviation, Engineering Management, Information Security & Assurance, Leadership, Logistics and Supply Chain Management, Management, Management Information Systems, and Project Management). Virtually all COB programs have industry affiliations, including with ISM, PMI, SAP, SAS, ASEM, RAeS and others.

Departments in the COB are Business Administration, Decision Sciences and Analytics, and Management. The successful candidate would be assigned to the Department of Management (DM). The DM houses the Associate in Technical Management, Bachelor of Science in Technical Management, Masters in Management, Masters in Leadership, Masters in Airline Management, and Masters in Airport and Air Mobility Management. A mixture of undergraduate minors, majors, professional education, and graduate certificates are also managed by the DM.

Embry-Riddle: Celebrating 100 Years of Leadership in Aviation and Aerospace

As Embry-Riddle Aeronautical University marks its Centennial, we proudly celebrate 100 years of advancing the future of flight and aerospace education. With vibrant residential campuses in Daytona Beach, FL, and Prescott, AZ — and a Worldwide network spanningnearly 120global locations — Embry-Riddle stands as the world’s largest aviation and aerospace university.

For a century, we have led innovation in STEM education, serving more than 30,000 students around the globe. Ourcutting-edgeprograms in Applied Science, Aviation, Business, Technology, Engineering, Safety, Security, and Space empower the next generation of leaders to shape the future of flight, exploration, and discovery.

As we launch our next century, weremaincommitted to excellence, innovation, and preparing graduates who will transform industries and redefine what is possible.

Perks Await You at Embry-Riddle!

  • Generous Time Off: Enjoy 9+ paid holidays, including the day after Thanksgiving and the week between Christmas Eve and New Year’s Day.
  • Tuition Coverage: Get 100% tuition coverage for yourself for one undergraduate and one graduate degree, and discounted rates for your spouse and dependent children up to age 26.
  • Retirement Contributions: ERAU contributes 6% of your base salary to your retirement plan and offers a 4% matching contribution – with no vesting period.

Qualifications

Required Education and Qualifications:

  • At Assistant level a relevant Masters from an accredited institution is required, while a doctorate is preferred. At Associate level a doctorate is required. Preferred candidates will have commercial management experience from the airline, airport or related commercial aviation supplier sector. Candidates with direct and demonstrable knowledge in the management of customer experience, brand and marketing strategies, revenue generation and cost management, sales and distribution, route and network evaluations and planning, or partnerships and sponsorship strategies are particularly encouraged to apply.
  • The successful candidate should show excellence in teaching and demonstrate strong research potential/pipeline at the Assistant level and through publications and an ongoing pipeline at Associate level, that would include working papers or papers under review.
  • Candidates must have excellent teaching evaluations in related fields.
  • Experience in higher education teaching (web-based courses preferred), participation in university committees, industry boards or related community organizations, participation in state/national professional organizations, and past successful professional experience with diverse groups.
  • Strong written and communication skills
  • A clearly defined teaching philosophy
  • Demonstrated ability to engage and mentor students from diverse backgrounds (in a remote setting preferred)
  • Willingness to travel as necessary for the position (approximately 5-10%)
  • Experience in course design and development for online course delivery is preferred
  • Experience with online learning management systems is preferred

Candidates should be collegial professionals passionate about teaching and the aviation industry, treating them both as a hobby and a profession, and have a keen interest in all aspects of aviation business. The candidate will adhere to the COB-W values of: (a) integrity, (b) collaboration/collegiality, (c) student- centricity, (d) respect, and (e) innovation.


Personal attributes:

The ideal candidate is a dynamic team player who values collaboration and solution-focused approaches as well as possessing strong listening skills, an open and positive mindset, flexibility to adapt to rapid changes, prioritizes effectively even when resources are scarce, is adept at juggling multiple responsibilities simultaneously, welcomes constructive feedback and is committed to continuous improvement and personal growth.


Application process/requirements

Review of applications will begin immediately and will continue until the position is filled. The start date will be based off the candidate's availability.


To submit your application for this opportunity, please visit the Embry-Riddle Career Site and search for requisition number R312255. Please attach all relevant materials to your application when you apply online. Complete submissions include:

  • A cover letter describing your interest in the position and qualifications for the role
  • A current curriculum vitae
  • Contact information for three professional references
  • Summary of evidence of teaching effectiveness (i.e., course evaluations, teaching portfolio, etc.) and industry engagement/involvement
  • For Associate Professor level a statement of research contributions to date and future aspirations (up to a page in length)

Current Embry-Riddle employees: Please apply directly through the ERAU Employee Hub Central application within Workday.

jobs.description:
This position will be fully remote and can be hired anywhere in the continental U.S.


The GRC Analyst delivers recurring governance, risk, and compliance operational support within a managed-services environment. The role performs access reporting, account reconciliation, activity and audit-trail review, evidence handling, compliance tracking, audit support, and GRC and third-party risk workflow administration using approved systems, procedures, and review criteria.


This is a client-dedicated role assigned to support designated managed-services clients and their defined GRC service requirements. The role works in client-owned or client-approved systems during applicable client-aligned service windows established for assigned engagements.

This is an operational GRC delivery role accountable for accurate, timely, and traceable execution of assigned activities. The analyst supports control owners, risk owners, auditors, and service leadership while escalating exceptions and decisions outside assigned authority.


How you’ll make an impact

Access, Account & Permissions Governance

  • Generate user access and permissions reports using approved systems, report parameters, and procedures.
  • Reconcile non-user and inactive accounts across in-scope systems; document discrepancies and route exceptions for review and resolution.
  • Maintain records related to staffing, assigned duties, access, and changes that affect required access or control reviews.
  • Support elevated-access reviews and exception handling by collecting records, maintaining status, updating approved risk register or exception records, and escalating unresolved items.

System Activity, Audit Trail & Evidence Review

  • Review system activity logs and audit trails according to defined review criteria and schedules; document the review performed and route identified exceptions.
  • Archive, organize, and review security- and audit-related email reports and associated records in approved repositories.
  • Check assigned evidence for completeness, accuracy, applicable period, source, and retrievability before routing it for review.
  • Maintain traceable records of source, review status, disposition, owner, exception, escalation, and completion date.

Compliance & Audit Support

  • Complete compliance forms, review trackers, attestations, and supporting records using approved source information.
  • Assist in preparing audit reports and supporting evidence needed for regulatory and other assigned reviews.
  • Perform accuracy, completeness, consistency, and traceability checks before routing deliverables for review or submission.
  • Respond to assigned evidence or information requests within established priorities; document completion, dependencies, and exceptions.

GRC & Third-Party Risk Workflow Support

  • Manage report queues and request tracking for GRC and third-party risk workflows using approved systems and procedures.
  • Record request scope, ownership, status, due dates, dependencies, disposition, and supporting documentation accurately and consistently.
  • Monitor aging items, follow up for missing information, and escalate blockers, overdue requests, or matters outside assigned authority.
  • Coordinate with stakeholders to clarify requests and support timely completion without independently performing a third-party risk assessment, approving a third party, or accepting risk unless specifically delegated.

Service Delivery, Quality & Information Handling

  • Perform assigned work using client-owned or client-approved systems and platforms during applicable client-aligned service windows.
  • Follow approved procedures, access restrictions, data-handling requirements, naming conventions, and evidence-retention practices.
  • Protect confidential, security-sensitive, employee, and access-related information and immediately escalate suspected handling or access issues.
  • Prepare status and operational metrics for assigned work, including timeliness, aging, completion, exceptions, and quality.
  • Identify recurring process or data-quality issues and recommend procedure clarifications without changing approved controls or processes without authorization.

Decision Authority & Accountability

  • Execute assigned GRC activities within documented procedures, approved access, defined review criteria, and established service priorities.
  • Make routine record-maintenance, queue-management, and evidence-organization decisions that comply with approved standards.
  • Do not independently approve access or third parties, accept risk, interpret legal or regulatory requirements, design controls, determine control effectiveness, approve control exceptions, or make material process changes unless specifically delegated.
  • Escalate suspected control failures, anomalous activity, unresolved reconciliation issues, missing audit evidence, access concerns, overdue work, and decisions outside assigned authority.

Core Competencies

  • Access reporting, account reconciliation, elevated-access review support, and exception tracking
  • System activity, audit-trail, and security-report review using defined criteria
  • Evidence quality, organization, retention, and traceability
  • Compliance-form, review-tracker, audit-report, and request-queue administration
  • Data reconciliation, aging analysis, discrepancy identification, and operational reporting
  • Confidential information handling, escalation, and professional judgment
  • Clear written communication, follow-through, and stakeholder coordination

What we’re looking for

  • At least 2 years of relevant experience in GRC, audit support, access governance, compliance operations, cybersecurity, risk management, third-party risk operations, or a related control function.
  • Working knowledge of access governance, account status and ownership, elevated access, exception handling, evidence quality, record retention, and escalation practices.
  • Familiarity with foundational audit and compliance concepts, including source evidence, review criteria, populations, findings, management responses, and remediation records.
  • Demonstrated ability to review structured records, reconcile data across systems, identify discrepancies, maintain evidence, and follow defined procedures.
  • Proficiency with spreadsheet analysis and reporting, including filtering, lookups, reconciliation, and pivot tables, plus experience with workflow systems, email-based reports, and document repositories.
  • Ability to manage recurring and request-driven work, meet deadlines, maintain accurate trackers, and escalate exceptions promptly.
  • Ability to handle confidential and security-sensitive information with discretion and comply with applicable access, privacy, and data-handling requirements.
  • Ability to communicate clearly with technical and nontechnical stakeholders and document work so that it is reviewable and auditable.
  • Bachelor’s degree in cybersecurity, information systems, risk management, business, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education, training, certifications, military service, and relevant practical experience.
  • Experience with access reporting, elevated-access reviews, inactive-account reconciliation, review trackers, evidence repositories, and exception records.
  • Experience preparing audit evidence, compliance reports, or regulatory support materials under established review criteria.
  • Experience supporting GRC or third-party risk workflows in a managed-services environment.
  • Experience with spreadsheet, workflow, document-repository, GRC, or identity-governance platforms.
  • Familiarity with recognized frameworks or assurance models such as NIST Cybersecurity Framework, NIST SP 800-53, ISO/IEC 27001, SOC 2, or applicable regulatory requirements.
  • Relevant training or certification such as Security+, CISA, CRISC, CGRC, or comparable coursework (preferred).

What you can expect from Optiv

POSITION DETAILS

Job Title: Senior Manager, Procurement

Location: Remote / Hybrid (Full Time)

Reports To: Senior Director of Supply Chain

Status: Full Time

Compensation: $125,000 - $145,000

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are seeking a strategic and analytical Senior Manager of Procurement to lead our end-to-end sourcing, supplier ecosystems, and commercialization operations within the CPG hair care category. In this role, you will own raw material and packaging categories, drive aggressive margin expansion, and partner cross-functionally with R&D, Marketing, and Operations to commercialize high-growth product pipelines. The ideal candidate brings deep domain expertise in personal care contract manufacturing, technical formulation components, and robust operational governance from PO issuance to ERP data architecture.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Vendor Lifecycle Management

  • Establish and execute comprehensive supplier evaluation scorecards, quarterly business reviews (QBRs), and performance metrics across suppliers and contract manufacturers (CMOs), packaging vendors, and to drive accountability and operational excellence.
  • Mitigate supply chain risks by performing financial, quality, and operational health checks on key component suppliers and co-packers, maintaining robust dual-sourcing and contingency plans.
  • Negotiate Master Service Agreements (MSAs), Quality Management Agreements (QMAs), and pricing terms in close collaboration with legal, finance, and technical teams.

Strategic Sourcing & COGS Optimization

  • Develop and execute multi-year category strategies covering hair care raw materials (surfactants, active ingredients, botanical extracts), custom/stock primary packaging (bottles, pumps, tubes, jars), secondary packaging, and external contract manufacturing services (liquids, hot-fills, aerosols).
  • Conduct competitive RFPs, global market analyses, and benchmark costing (toll manufacturing vs. turnkey co-packing models) to optimize total cost of ownership
  • Lead continuous cost-reduction initiatives through alternate packaging, alternative ingredient sourcing, and CMO throughput/yield optimization.
  • Model and track savings pipelines across raw materials, packaging, and manufacturing conversion costs, balancing margin targets with strict brand and quality standards.
  • Partner with R&D and sustainability leads to source post-consumer recycled (PCR) resins, FSC-certified paper, clean-beauty compliant ingredients, and environmentally responsible co-manufacturing facilities.
  • Track, maintain, and audit capital tooling investments (injection molds, blow molds, custom line equipment) hosted at supplier and co-packer facilities.

NPD Project Management & Commercialization

  • Own the procurement and manufacturing workstreams for New Product Development (NPD), managing the seamless transition of formulas and packaging from lab scale to CMO pilot trials and full-scale commercial production runs.
  • Partner with R&D, Brand Marketing, and co-packer engineering teams to resolve technical transfer challenges, manage long-lead components, and guarantee on-time commercial launches.
  • Drive daily cross-functional project timelines, set sample review milestones, and coordinate testing schedules between R&D, Quality, brand teams, and external co-packers.

Purchase Order Management & Procure-to-Pay (P2P)

  • Oversee day-to-day procurement operations, including issuing and managing purchase orders for raw ingredients, packaging components, and CMO finished good production runs in accordance with approval matrices.
  • Partner with Accounts Payable and logistics to manage consigned inventory, turnkey billings, and resolve 3-way invoice matching discrepancies efficiently.

Item Master & Bill of Materials (BOM) Structure

  • Govern ERP data integrity by managing SKU setups, attribute configurations, vendor item numbers, and multi-level BOM structures
  • Ensure accurate cost roll-ups, standard cost updates, and smooth MRP (Material Requirements Planning) execution across internal systems and external manufacturing partners.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Minimum Experience: 7–10 years of progressive experience in strategic sourcing, procurement, or supply chain management within the Consumer Packaged Goods (CPG) industry.
  • Required Industry Experience: Direct sourcing experience within Beauty, Personal Care, or specifically Hair Care (shampoos, conditioners, styling formulations, treatments).
  • Required Functional Experience: Demonstrated expertise managing contract manufacturing organizations (CMOs/CDMOs), leading cross-functional NPD commercialization, and structuring complex supplier contracts.
  • Required Systems & Tools: Advanced proficiency in ERP systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle, NetSuite preferred) and strong data analysis capabilities (Advanced Excel / SQL).
  • Core Competencies & Skills:
    • Technical literacy in cosmetic chemistry, raw material grade specifications, and packaging mechanics (pumps, dispensers, closures), preferred.
    • High-level negotiation, contract drafting, and financial modeling skills.
    • Exceptional project management capability with acute attention to detail in BOM structures and item master setups.

Education: Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Chemistry, Materials Science, or packaging engineering preferred

Certifications: CPSM, CSCP, or APICS certification is strongly preferred.

EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY

Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Reasonable accommodations are available for qualified applicants and employees in accordance with applicable law.

You will lead the development of enterprise data pipelines, lakehouse architecture, and governance frameworks while partnering closely with AI/ML, platform engineering, and security teams. The ideal candidate combines deep expertise in data engineering, data modeling, cloud-based architectures, and data governance with a strong focus on reliability, observability, and regulatory compliance.

Lead Data Engineer | Day-to-Day

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable lakehouse architectures and enterprise data platforms that support analytics, reporting, and AI-driven solutions.
  • Develop and manage secure data ingestion frameworks, including CDC, batch, API, and file-based integrations from operational and transactional source systems.
  • Create and maintain data models, semantic layers, and governed metrics that enable consistent, trusted, and business-ready data consumption.
  • Implement data quality, reconciliation, observability, and monitoring processes to ensure reliable, recoverable, and high-performing data pipelines.
  • Partner with AI/ML, platform engineering, and security teams to deliver governed data products, support regulatory compliance requirements, and ensure proper data classification and access controls.
  • Establish and enforce data governance standards, lineage documentation, data contracts, quality thresholds, and operational procedures while supporting onboarding of new data sources and environments.

Lead Data Engineer | Skills & Experience
